words.en: A thorough action or activity is one that is done very carefully and in a detailed way so that nothing is forgotten.

words.ex: He overcame his fear of speaking in public.
words.ex_cn: 他克服了当众演讲的恐惧。
words.en: If you overcome a problem or a feeling, you successfully deal with it and control it.

words.ex: He bought a repair kit for his bike.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一套自行车维修工具。
words.en: A kit is a group of items that are kept together, often in the same container, because they are all used for similar purposes.

words.ex: The weather bureau issued a storm warning.
words.ex_cn: 气象局发布了风暴预警。
words.en: A bureau is an office, organization, or government department that collects and distributes information.

words.tr:
n. 腐烂；衰落；
v. 腐烂；
words.ex: The fruit began to show signs of decay.
words.ex_cn: 这水果开始出现腐烂的迹象。
words.en: To decay means to be slowly destroyed by a natural process or to become gradually worse in quality, condition, or strength.

words.ex: The duration of the movie is two hours.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影的持续时间是两小时。
words.en: The duration of an event or state is the time during which it happens or exists.

words.ex: He likes coffee, whereas she prefers tea.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢咖啡，然而她更喜欢茶。
words.en: You use whereas to introduce a comment which contrasts with what is said in the main clause.

words.ex: The country expanded its territory after the war.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家在战争后扩大了它的领土。
words.en: An area of land that is controlled by a particular country, ruler, or military force.

words.ex: The company wants to innovate its production process.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司想改革它的生产流程。
words.en: To innovate means to introduce changes and new ideas in the way something is done or made.

words.tr: n. 官僚主义；官僚机构
words.ex: He hates the bureaucracy in government offices.
words.ex_cn: 他讨厌政府办公室里的官僚主义。
words.en: Bureaucracy refers to a system of government or business that has many complicated rules and ways of doing things.

words.ex: The apple will rot if left in the sun.
words.ex_cn: 如果把苹果放在太阳下，它会腐烂。
words.en: If something rots, or if it is left to rot, it decays and falls apart because of natural processes. Rot can also refer to a state of decay or decomposition.

words.tr:
adj. 手工的；体力的；
n. 说明书；
words.ex: He made a manual copy of the letter.
words.ex_cn: 他手工抄写了一封信。
words.en: A manual is a book which tells you how to do something or how a piece of machinery works.

words.ex: The cat creeps slowly toward the bird.
words.ex_cn: 猫蹑手蹑脚地向鸟靠近。
words.en: To move slowly and quietly, especially in a way that does not attract attention.

words.ex: The army tried to invade the neighboring country.
words.ex_cn: 军队试图侵犯邻国。
words.en: To enter a country, town, or region by force in order to take control of it.

words.tr: adj. 最终的；最后的；极端的；
words.ex: This is the ultimate solution to the problem.
words.ex_cn: 这是这个问题的最终解决方案。
words.en: You use ultimate to describe the final result or aim of a long series of events.

words.ex: The local company is an affiliate of the big global brand.
words.ex_cn: 这家本地公司是这个全球大品牌的分公司。
words.en: If an organization is affiliated with another larger organization, it is officially connected with the larger organization or is a member of it.

words.tr: v. 侵蚀；腐蚀；逐渐丧失；削弱
words.ex: The wind erodes the sand slowly.
words.ex_cn: 风慢慢侵蚀着沙子。
words.en: If rock or soil erodes or is eroded by the weather, sea, or wind, it cracks and breaks so that it is gradually destroyed.

words.ex: Good teachers motivate students to learn.
words.ex_cn: 好老师激励学生学习。
words.en: To motivate someone means to provide them with a reason for doing something, especially something that requires effort.

words.tr:
v. 大步行走；跨一大步
n. 大步；步伐
words.ex: He takes a long stride when he walks.
words.ex_cn: 他走路时迈着大步。
words.en: To walk with long, decisive steps in a specified direction.

words.ex: He does not want to intrude on their conversation.
words.ex_cn: 他不想插话他们的谈话。
words.en: To intrude means to enter somewhere or become involved in a situation where you are not wanted or are not supposed to be.

words.ex: He showed the utmost care when handling the fragile glass.
words.ex_cn: 他在处理易碎的玻璃时表现出了最大的小心。
words.en: The greatest or highest degree of something.

words.tr: v. 代表；表现；体现；相当于；
words.ex: He represents his country in the competition.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中代表他的国家。
words.en: If someone represents a person or group of people, they act on behalf of that person or group.

words.ex: The old bike has rust on its chain.
words.ex_cn: 这辆旧自行车的链条上有锈。
words.en: Rust is a reddish-brown substance that forms on the surface of iron or steel when they are exposed to air and moisture, causing them to corrode.

words.ex: His motive was to help his family.
words.ex_cn: 他的动机是帮助家人。
words.en: Your motive for doing something is your reason for doing it.

words.ex: He likes to wander in the park after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢晚饭后在公园里徘徊。
words.en: If you wander in a place, you walk around there in a casual way, often without intending to go in any particular direction or to any particular place.

words.ex: He went to his grandfather's funeral.
words.ex_cn: 他去参加了他祖父的葬礼。
words.en: A funeral is a ceremony that is held because someone has died.

words.ex: He is a genius in math.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学方面是个天才。
words.en: Someone who is a genius is a person who is exceptionally intelligent or talented, especially in a particular field.

words.tr:
n. 代表；典型事物；
adj. 典型的；有代表性的；代议制的；
words.ex: He is the representative of our class.
words.ex_cn: 他是我们班的代表。
words.en: A representative is a person who has been chosen to act or make decisions on behalf of another person or a group of people.

words.ex: The shopkeeper will evaluate the old watch.
words.ex_cn: 店主将估价这块旧手表。
words.en: If you evaluate something or someone, you consider them in order to make a judgment about them, for example about how good or bad they are.

words.ex: The room was in chaos after the party.
words.ex_cn: 派对之后，房间一片混乱。
words.en: A state of complete disorder and confusion.

words.tr:
v. 踩；踏；践踏
n. 脚步声；胎面
words.ex: He tread carefully on the icy path.
words.ex_cn: 他小心地走在结冰的小路上。
words.en: If you tread on something, you put your foot on it when you are walking. The tread of a tyre is the pattern of lines on its surface that prevent it from slipping.

words.tr: n. 损失；伤亡人数；通行费；
words.ex: The war caused a heavy toll on innocent people.
words.ex_cn: 战争给平民带来了巨大的损失。
words.en: A toll is a small sum of money that you have to pay in order to use a particular bridge or road. / A toll is the total number of deaths, accidents, or disasters that occur in a particular period of time. / When a bell tolls, it rings slowly and repeatedly, often as a sign that someone has died.

words.ex: He has a gene that makes him tall.
words.ex_cn: 他有一个让他长高的基因。
words.en: A gene is the basic physical and functional unit of heredity. Genes, which are made up of DNA, act as instructions to make molecules called proteins.

words.ex: People vote in democracy to choose their leaders.
words.ex_cn: 人们在民主制度下投票选择他们的领导人。
words.en: A system of government by the whole population or all the eligible members of a state, typically through elected representatives.

words.ex: She added cinnamon spice to the cake.
words.ex_cn: 她往蛋糕里加了肉桂香料。
words.en: Spice refers to a substance used to flavor food, which is usually made from parts of plants, especially their seeds, fruits, or roots. It can also mean something that adds interest or excitement.

words.tr:
n. 脏乱；杂乱；
v. 弄糟；
words.ex: The room was a mess after the party.
words.ex_cn: 派对后房间一片狼藉。
words.en: A mess is a situation that is confused and full of problems, or something that is dirty or untidy.

words.tr:
v. 闲逛；散步；漫步；
n. 闲逛；散步；漫步；
words.ex: They stroll in the park after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他们晚饭后在公园里闲逛。
words.en: If you stroll somewhere, you walk there in a slow, relaxed way.

words.ex: The lamp illuminate the dark room.
words.ex_cn: 这盏灯照亮了黑暗的房间。
words.en: To illuminate something means to shine light on it and to make it brighter and more visible.

words.ex: The scientist studied genetic traits in plants.
words.ex_cn: 科学家研究了植物的基因特征。
words.en: relating to genes or heredity

words.ex: The song evokes happy memories of childhood.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌唤起了对童年的美好回忆。
words.en: To evoke a particular memory, idea, emotion, or response means to cause it to occur.

words.ex: He gave the rope a sudden jerk to pull it up.
words.ex_cn: 他猛地一拉绳子，把它拉了上来。
words.en: If you jerk something or someone in a particular direction, or they jerk in a particular direction, they move a short distance very suddenly and quickly.

words.tr:
n. 婴儿；
adj. 初期的；
words.ex: The infant is sleeping in the crib.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿正在婴儿床里睡觉。
words.en: An infant is a baby or very young child.

words.tr:
v. 快步；小跑；骑马小跑
n. 小跑；快步走
words.ex: The horse trots slowly on the path.
words.ex_cn: 马在小路上慢跑。
words.en: To trot means to move at a pace faster than a walk, with the legs moving in diagonal pairs, but not as fast as a gallop.

words.ex: The mirror creates an illusion of a bigger room.
words.ex_cn: 镜子制造出房间更大的错觉。
words.en: An illusion is a false idea or belief, especially about yourself or your situation.

words.ex: He is stubborn and won't change his mind.
words.ex_cn: 他很顽固，不肯改变主意。
words.en: Someone who is stubborn is determined to do what they want and is very unwilling to change their mind.

words.ex: Please stir the soup before serving.
words.ex_cn: 请在上菜前搅拌一下汤。
words.en: To mix a substance or move it around using a spoon or other object; to cause to move or act; to arouse or excite.

words.tr: adj. 鲁莽的；不计后果的；
words.ex: He drove reckless and got into an accident.
words.ex_cn: 他开车鲁莽，结果出了事故。
words.en: If you say that someone is reckless, you mean that they act in a way which shows that they do not care about danger or the effect their behaviour will have on other people.

words.tr: adj. 母亲的；母性的；母系的；
words.ex: Her maternal love kept the family strong.
words.ex_cn: 她的母爱让家庭保持坚强。
words.en: Maternal feelings or actions are typical of a kind, loving mother.

words.tr:
v. 弯腰；俯身；卑屈；俯冲
n. 弯腰；屈背；屈服；俯冲
words.ex: He must stoop to enter the small door.
words.ex_cn: 他必须弯腰才能进入那扇小门。
words.en: If someone stoops, they bend their body forwards and downwards.

words.tr: adj. 真正的；真实的；真迹的；可靠的；
words.ex: This is an authentic painting by Picasso.
words.ex_cn: 这是一幅毕加索的真迹。
words.en: If something is authentic, it is real, true, or what people say it is.

words.tr:
v. 成为三倍；使增至三倍；
n. 三倍的数；三个一组；
adj. 三部分的；
words.ex: The company's profits tripled last year.
words.ex_cn: 该公司去年的利润增长了三倍。
words.en: To triple something means to make it three times as much in size or number.

words.ex: The traffic came to a standstill during the rush hour.
words.ex_cn: 高峰期交通陷入了停滞。
words.en: A situation in which all activity or movement has stopped.

words.ex: The loud music distract me from my homework.
words.ex_cn: 嘈杂的音乐让我无法专心做作业。
words.en: If something distracts you or your attention, it makes you stop concentrating on what you are doing.

words.tr:
v. 屠杀 
n. 大屠杀
words.ex: The soldiers committed a massacre in the village.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们在村庄里进行了大屠杀。
words.en: The indiscriminate killing of a large number of people.

words.ex: I clicked the button to undo my mistake.
words.ex_cn: 我点击了按钮来撤销我的错误。
words.en: To undo something means to reverse the effect of a previous action or to untie or unfasten something.

words.ex: His viewpoint is different from mine.
words.ex_cn: 他的观点与我的不同。
words.en: A viewpoint is a particular way of thinking about something, especially one that is influenced by your experiences or beliefs.

words.ex: The triangle has three sides.
words.ex_cn: 这个三角形有三条边。
words.en: A triangle is a shape consisting of three straight lines and three angles.

words.ex: The car remained static at the red light.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在红灯前静止不动。
words.en: Something that is static does not move or change.

words.ex: Drugs can alleviate pain.
words.ex_cn: 药物可以减轻疼痛。
words.en: To make something less severe or intense.

words.tr:
v. 屠宰；屠杀
n. 屠宰；屠杀
words.ex: Farmers slaughter pigs for meat.
words.ex_cn: 农民宰猪取肉。
words.en: The killing of animals for food; the killing of a large number of people in a cruel or violent way.

words.ex: He wore a scary mask at the Halloween party.
words.ex_cn: 他在万圣节派对上戴了一个可怕的面具。
words.en: A mask is a piece of cloth or other material that you wear over your face to hide or protect it.

words.ex: The teacher will distribute the books to students.
words.ex_cn: 老师将把书分发给学生。
words.en: If you distribute things, you hand them or deliver them to a number of people.

words.ex: The climbers reached the summit of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 登山者到达了山顶。
words.en: The highest point of a hill or mountain; a meeting between heads of government.

words.tr: n. 一束；一串；一群；大量
words.ex: A bunch of birds flew over the tree.
words.ex_cn: 一群鸟飞过树顶。
words.en: A bunch of things is a group of them. A bunch of people is a group of them who are together or who are connected in some way.

words.ex: The town is near the frontier of the country.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇靠近国家的边境。
words.en: A frontier is a border between two countries or the area close to it. It can also refer to the limit of knowledge or the most advanced or recent stage in the development of something.

words.ex: A fraction of the students passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 只有一小部分学生通过了考试。
words.en: A fraction is a small part or amount of something.

words.ex: The rope is slack and hangs loosely.
words.ex_cn: 绳子是松弛的，垂挂着。
words.en: If something is slack, it is loose and not firmly stretched or tightly in position. It can also describe a period of low activity or a lack of effort in work or activity.

words.ex: The constitution protects the rights of all citizens.
words.ex_cn: 宪法保护所有公民的权利。
words.en: The constitution of a country or organization is the system of laws which formally states people's rights and duties.

words.tr:
n. 高峰；顶峰；
v. 达到高峰；达到最高值；
words.ex: The mountain peak is covered with snow.
words.ex_cn: 这座山的高峰被雪覆盖。
words.en: The highest point or level of something; the pointed top of a mountain.

words.tr:
n. 捆；束；包
v. 匆匆送走
words.ex: He bought a bundle of newspapers.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一捆报纸。
words.en: A bundle is a number of things that are tied or wrapped together so that they can be carried or stored easily.

words.ex: She looked at herself in the mirror.
words.ex_cn: 她对着镜子看自己。
words.en: A mirror is a flat piece of glass which reflects light, so that when you look at it you can see yourself reflected in it.

words.ex: He will flee from the burning house.
words.ex_cn: 他会从着火的房子里逃走。
words.en: If you flee from something or someone, you leave them quickly because you are afraid of them or because you do not want to be involved with them.

words.tr: adj. 一年一次的；每年的；
words.ex: The school holds an annual sports day.
words.ex_cn: 学校每年举行一次运动会。
words.en: An annual event happens once every year.

words.tr: n. 代表大会；议会；国会；
words.ex: The congress met to discuss new laws.
words.ex_cn: 代表大会召开以讨论新法律。
words.en: A congress is a formal meeting of representatives, as of various nations, to discuss problems or to make decisions.

words.tr: prep. 关于； v. 看待；“regard”的现在分词；
words.ex: He sent me an email regarding the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他给我发了一封关于会议的邮件。
words.en: You can use regarding to indicate the subject that is being talked or written about.

words.ex: The band is playing music.
words.ex_cn: 这个乐队在演奏音乐。
words.en: A band is a group of musicians who play music together, especially popular music. It can also refer to a strip of material used for binding or decoration, or a range of frequencies or wavelengths in a spectrum.

words.tr:
adj. 成熟的；
v. 成熟；
words.ex: He is a mature student who works full-time.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位成熟的学生，全职工作。
words.en: When something or someone matures, they become fully grown or developed. In finance, a mature investment is one that has reached the end of its term and is ready to be paid out.

words.ex: The captive man sat quietly in his cell.
words.ex_cn: 那个被监禁的人安静地坐在牢房里。
words.en: A captive is someone who is being kept as a prisoner or in a confined space, or something that is held or confined.

words.ex: They celebrated their wedding anniversary with dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他们用晚餐庆祝结婚纪念日。
words.en: An anniversary is a date which is remembered or celebrated because a special event happened on that date in a previous year.

words.tr:
n. 否决；否决权
v. 否决
words.ex: The president used his veto to stop the law.
words.ex_cn: 总统行使否决权阻止了这项法律。
words.en: If someone in authority vetoes something, they forbid it, or they stop it from being put into action.

words.tr: v. 自夸；夸耀；自豪地拥有
words.ex: He boasts about his new car.
words.ex_cn: 他夸耀自己的新车。
words.en: If someone boasts about something that they have done or that they own, they talk about it very proudly, in a way that other people may find irritating or offensive.

words.tr: adj. 独自的；单独的；孤寂的；
words.ex: He lives in a solitary house far from the town.
words.ex_cn: 他住在离城镇很远的独自一人的房子里。
words.en: A solitary person or thing is the only one in a place.

words.ex: The two houses are adjacent to each other.
words.ex_cn: 这两栋房子彼此相邻。
words.en: If one thing is adjacent to another, it is next to it or adjoining it.

words.tr:
v. 禁止；
n. 禁止；
words.ex: The school bans phones in class.
words.ex_cn: 学校禁止在课堂上使用手机。
words.en: If there is a ban on something, it is not allowed. If something is banned, it is not allowed to be done, shown, or used.

words.ex: I am awaiting the bus.
words.ex_cn: 我正在等公交车。
words.en: If you await someone or something, you wait for them.

words.ex: He paid off his debt last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月还清了债务。
words.en: A debt is a sum of money that you owe someone.

words.ex: He exaggerates his achievements to impress others.
words.ex_cn: 他夸张自己的成就来给别人留下印象。
words.en: If you exaggerate, you indicate that something is, for example, worse or more important than it really is.

words.tr:
v. 夺取；一把抓住
n. 夺取；一把抓住；音乐片段
words.ex: He tried to snatch the bag from her hand.
words.ex_cn: 他试图从她手中抢走包。
words.en: If you snatch something, or if you snatch at it, you take it or pull it away quickly.

words.tr:
n. 纪律；学科；科目；训练；惩戒；
v. 约束自己；
words.ex: The teacher enforced discipline in the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 老师在教室里维持纪律。
words.en: Discipline is the practice of making people obey rules or standards of behaviour, and punishing them when they do not.

words.ex: He tried to bribe the officer with money.
words.ex_cn: 他试图用钱贿赂官员。
words.en: A bribe is a sum of money or something valuable that one person offers or gives to another in order to persuade them to do something, usually something dishonest.

words.ex: They plant trees to commemorate the fallen soldiers.
words.ex_cn: 他们种树以纪念阵亡的士兵。
words.en: To commemorate an important event or person means to remember them by means of a special action, ceremony, or specially created object.

words.tr: v. 给予（药物或治疗）；管理；实施；
words.ex: The nurse will administer the medicine to the patient.
words.ex_cn: 护士会给病人服药。
words.en: To administer means to manage or oversee the execution, use, or conduct of something; to dispense or apply (a remedy or drug).

words.tr:
adv. 径直；直接；直；
adj. 直的；
words.ex: He walked straight to the door.
words.ex_cn: 他径直走向门。
words.en: extending or moving uniformly in one direction only; without a curve or bend.

words.tr:
adv. 向前；前进；
v. 促进；转交；
adj. 向前的；前进的；
words.ex: He walked forward to meet the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他向前走去见老师。
words.en: If you move or look forward, you move or look in a direction that is in front of you. In British English, you can also say that you are looking forward to something that is going to happen.

words.ex: He grabbed the ball quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速抓住了球。
words.en: If you grab something, you take it or pick it up suddenly and roughly.

words.ex: He made a proposition to lower taxes.
words.ex_cn: 他提出了降低税收的建议。
words.en: A proposition is a statement or an idea that people can consider or discuss to decide whether it is true.

words.ex: The ship carries a large cargo of rice.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船运载了大量大米货物。
words.en: Cargo refers to the goods carried by a ship, aircraft, or other large vehicle.

words.ex: The sun shone with great glory at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 黎明时分，太阳闪耀着辉煌的光辉。
words.en: High renown or honor won by notable achievements; magnificence or great beauty.

words.ex: The administration of the school is very organized.
words.ex_cn: 学校的行政管理非常有条理。
words.en: The process or activity of running a business, organization, etc., or the people who run it.

words.ex: He gave a sincere apology.
words.ex_cn: 他真诚地道歉了。
words.en: If you say that someone is sincere, you approve of them because they really mean the things they say.

words.tr:
n. 紧握；掌握；控制；
v. 紧握；掌握；
words.ex: He has a strong grip on the handle.
words.ex_cn: 他紧紧握住把手。
words.en: To grip something means to hold it tightly. It can also mean to hold someone's attention completely.

words.ex: The experiment demonstrates that water boils at 100°C.
words.ex_cn: 这个实验证明水在100摄氏度时沸腾。
words.en: To demonstrate means to show something clearly by giving proof or evidence.

words.ex: The passengers are aboard the plane.
words.ex_cn: 乘客们在飞机上。
words.en: On or onto a ship, aircraft, bus, or train.

words.tr:
n. 规模；等级；比例（尺）；刻度；秤；
v. 改变…大小；
words.ex: The scale of the project surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目的规模让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: A scale is a set of levels or numbers which are used in a particular system of measuring things or are used when comparing things.

words.ex: The ministry of education controls schools.
words.ex_cn: 教育部管理学校。
words.en: A ministry is a government department, especially in Britain, which is responsible for a particular area of administration, such as health or education.

words.tr: adv. 似乎；看似；表面上看；
words.ex: He is seemingly calm, but he is nervous inside.
words.ex_cn: 他似乎很平静，但内心很紧张。
words.en: appearing to be true or real but not necessarily so

words.ex: Eating vegetables gives you good nutrition.
words.ex_cn: 吃蔬菜能提供良好的营养。
words.en: The process of providing or obtaining the food necessary for health and growth.

words.tr:
adj. 明白表示的；证实的；公然表示情绪的
n. 指示词
words.ex: He is demonstrative with his love for his family.
words.ex_cn: 他对家人表达爱意时很外露。
words.en: If you are demonstrative, you show your feelings or behave in a way that shows your love for someone.

words.ex: The sailors slept in the cabin during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 水手们在风暴期间睡在船舱里。
words.en: A cabin is a small room or compartment, especially one on a ship or an aircraft.

words.ex: The police will detain the suspect for questioning.
words.ex_cn: 警察将扣留嫌疑人进行审问。
words.en: If someone is detained, they are officially held in a place, especially a prison, and are not allowed to leave.

words.ex: The king governed the land for 50 years.
words.ex_cn: 国王统治这个国家50年。
words.en: To govern a country or an organization means to officially control and manage its affairs.

words.tr: v. 诱惑；引诱；怂恿；劝诱；
words.ex: The smell of cookies tempted him to eat one.
words.ex_cn: 饼干的香味诱惑他吃了一块。
words.en: If something tempts you, it makes you want to have it or do it, even though you know you should not.

words.ex: His recipe for success is hard work and patience.
words.ex_cn: 他成功的秘诀是努力工作和耐心。
words.en: A recipe is a list of ingredients and a set of instructions that tell you how to cook something.

words.ex: The team was unanimous in choosing the new leader.
words.ex_cn: 团队在选择新领导时意见完全一致。
words.en: When a group of people are unanimous, they all agree about something or all vote for the same thing.

words.ex: The workers unload the boxes from the truck.
words.ex_cn: 工人们从卡车上卸下箱子。
words.en: To remove goods from a vehicle, ship, container, etc.

words.ex: The doctor ran a trial to test the new medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生进行了试验来测试这种新药。
words.en: A trial is a formal meeting in a law court, at which a judge and jury listen to evidence and decide whether a person is guilty of a crime.

words.ex: People discuss politics on this forum.
words.ex_cn: 人们在这个论坛上讨论政治。
words.en: A forum is a place, situation, or group in which people exchange ideas and discuss issues, especially important public issues.

words.tr:
v. 吸引；诱惑；引诱
n. 诱惑；诱饵；吸引力
words.ex: The bright colors lure the birds to the feeder.
words.ex_cn: 鲜艳的颜色吸引鸟类来到喂食器。
words.en: If you lure someone, you tempt them to do something or to go somewhere, especially by offering some form of reward.

words.ex: He is chewing gum loudly.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大声地嚼口香糖。
words.en: To chew means to bite and grind food in your mouth so it becomes soft enough to swallow.

words.tr:
v. 拍动；摆动；
n. 薄片；
words.ex: The bird flaps its wings to fly.
words.ex_cn: 鸟拍动翅膀飞翔。
words.en: A flap is a piece of cloth, paper, skin etc that is fixed at one edge to a surface, which you can lift up easily. If something such as a piece of cloth or paper flaps or if you flap it, it moves quickly up and down or from side to side.

words.ex: The polar bear lives in the Arctic.
words.ex_cn: 北极熊生活在北极。
words.en: relating to the North or South Pole or to the region around it; having opposite extremes or characteristics.

words.ex: He made a gamble on the horse race.
words.ex_cn: 他在这场赛马上赌了一把。
words.en: If you gamble on something, you take a risky action or decision in the hope of gaining something.

words.ex: The theme of the essay is friendship.
words.ex_cn: 这篇作文的题目是友谊。
words.en: The subject or main idea in a talk, piece of writing, or work of art.

words.ex: The court will prosecute him for theft.
words.ex_cn: 法院将因盗窃罪起诉他。
words.en: To prosecute means to institute legal proceedings against someone or to carry on a legal action against a defendant in a court of law. It also means to continue with or carry on an activity or enterprise.

words.ex: He went to the dental clinic for a check-up.
words.ex_cn: 他去牙科诊所做检查。
words.en: Relating to the teeth or to the work of a dentist.

words.tr:
v. 振翼；颤动；飘动；挥动
n. 鼓翼；飘扬；激动不安
words.ex: The flag is fluttering in the wind.
words.ex_cn: 旗帜在风中飘扬。
words.en: If something thin or light flutters, or if you flutter it, it moves up and down or from side to side with a lot of quick, light movements.

words.tr:
n. 倒塌；崩溃；暴跌；
v. 倒塌；崩溃；
words.ex: The collapse of the old bridge caused many problems.
words.ex_cn: 这座旧桥的倒塌引起了诸多问题。
words.en: If a building or other structure collapses, it falls down very suddenly.

words.ex: The senate voted to pass the new law.
words.ex_cn: 参议院投票通过了这项新法律。
words.en: The Senate is the smaller and more important of the two parts of the parliament in some countries, for example in the United States and Australia.

words.ex: The animals found refuge in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这些动物在森林中找到了避难所。
words.en: A place or state of safety or shelter from danger, trouble, or difficulty.

words.tr: adj. 天真无邪的；无辜的；
words.ex: The innocent child smiled at the stranger.
words.ex_cn: 那个天真无邪的孩子对陌生人笑了。
words.en: If someone is innocent, they did not commit a crime which they have been accused of.

words.ex: He has an appetite for spicy food.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢辛辣食物。
words.en: A desire or liking for something, especially food.

words.tr:
n. 遇难船只；残骸；
v. 破坏；毁坏；
words.ex: The wreck lies at the bottom of the sea.
words.ex_cn: 这艘遇难船只沉在海底。
words.en: If something such as a ship or a plane is wrecked, it is damaged so much that it cannot be repaired or it is completely destroyed.

words.ex: The volcano erupts suddenly.
words.ex_cn: 火山突然喷发。
words.en: If a volcano erupts, it throws out smoke, fire, and melted rocks.

words.ex: The students handed in a petition to the principal.
words.ex_cn: 学生们向校长递交了一份请愿书。
words.en: A petition is a document signed by a lot of people which asks a government or other official group to do a particular thing.

words.ex: We took the ferry to cross the river.
words.ex_cn: 我们乘渡船过河。
words.en: A ferry is a boat that transports passengers and sometimes also vehicles, usually across rivers or short stretches of sea.

words.tr:
n. 远足；
v. 远足；
words.ex: We went on a long hike in the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 我们去山里进行了一次长途远足。
words.en: A hike is a long walk in the country, especially one that you go on for pleasure. It can also refer to an increase in the cost or amount of something.

words.ex: The stomach digests food into nutrients.
words.ex_cn: 胃将食物消化成营养物质。
words.en: To digest means to break down food in the stomach and intestines into substances that can be absorbed by the body. It can also mean to understand or assimilate information. As a noun, it refers to a compilation or summary of information.

words.ex: The ship dropped its anchor in the harbor.
words.ex_cn: 船在港口放下了锚。
words.en: An anchor is a heavy object that is dropped from a boat or a ship into the water to prevent the vessel from moving.

words.ex: The price of oil soared last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月石油价格骤升。
words.en: To rise or increase dramatically in amount or level.

words.tr:
n. 长条；条状；
v. 剥去；剥夺；
words.ex: He cut a strip of paper to wrap the gift.
words.ex_cn: 他剪了一条纸来包装礼物。
words.en: To remove a layer from something, or to take off your clothes.

words.ex: The teacher showed a chart of temperatures.
words.ex_cn: 老师展示了一张温度图表。
words.en: A chart is a graphical representation of data, in which the data is represented by symbols, such as bars in a bar chart, lines in a line chart, or slices in a pie chart.

words.tr:
v. 剩下；留下；依然不变；
n. 遗迹；残余；遗体；
words.ex: Only two cookies remains on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌上只剩下两块饼干了。
words.en: The parts left over after other parts have been removed, used, or destroyed.

words.ex: The elephant is enormous.
words.ex_cn: 这头大象非常巨大。
words.en: If you describe something as enormous, you are emphasizing that it is extremely large in size or amount.

words.ex: The ship docked at the harbor.
words.ex_cn: 船停靠在海港。
words.en: A harbor is a place on the coast where ships may moor in shelter, especially one protected from rough water by piers, jetties, and other artificial structures.

words.ex: The bird hovers above the flowers.
words.ex_cn: 鸟在花上空盘旋。
words.en: To remain in one place in the air, or to stay close to someone or something.

words.tr: v. 接着发生；因而产生
words.ex: The storm ended, and peace ensued.
words.ex_cn: 风暴结束后，和平随之而来。
words.en: If something ensues, it happens immediately after another event, usually as a result of it.

words.tr: n. 全体人员；人事部；职员；
words.ex: The company hired new personnel last month.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司上个月雇佣了新员工。
words.en: The people who are employed in a company or organization.

words.ex: He yearns for a better life.
words.ex_cn: 他渴望更好的生活。
words.en: If you yearn for something, you want it very much.

words.tr:
adj. 巨大的；伟大的；
n. 巨人；伟人；
words.ex: The giant elephant stood near the tree.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的大象站在树旁。
words.en: A giant is an imaginary person who is very big and strong, especially one mentioned in old stories. In everyday language, a giant can also refer to a very large and successful company or organization.

words.tr:
v. 追逐；
n. 追逐；
words.ex: The dog chases the cat every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗每天早上追逐猫。
words.en: To chase someone or something means to quickly follow them or it in order to catch them.

words.ex: The teacher will notify the students about the test.
words.ex_cn: 老师会通知学生们关于考试的事。
words.en: If you notify someone of something, you officially inform them about it.

words.tr:
v. 进行无记名投票 
n. 无记名投票
words.ex: He cast his ballot in the election.
words.ex_cn: 他在选举中投了票。
words.en: A ballot is a process of voting, in writing and typically in secret. It is also the piece of paper on which you mark your vote.

words.tr:
n. 青少年；
adj. 青少年的；
words.ex: The adolescent walked to school with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 这个青少年和朋友们一起走路去上学。
words.en: An adolescent is a young person who is developing into an adult.

words.ex: He strives to finish his homework every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天努力完成作业。
words.en: If you strive to do something or strive for something, you make a great effort to do it or get it.

words.ex: The elephant is gigantic compared to a dog.
words.ex_cn: 这头大象相比狗来说是巨大的。
words.en: If you describe something as gigantic, you are emphasizing that it is extremely large in size, amount, or degree.

words.ex: The pirate sailed the sea with a black flag.
words.ex_cn: 海盗带着黑旗在海上航行。
words.en: A pirate is someone who attacks and robs ships at sea. The term can also refer to someone who illegally copies and distributes software, music, or films.

words.ex: He tried to loosen the tight screw.
words.ex_cn: 他试图拧松那颗紧的螺丝。
words.en: If you loosen something or if it loosens, it becomes less tight, less firmly fixed, or less strongly attached.

words.ex: The jury decided the man was innocent.
words.ex_cn: 陪审团裁定这个人无罪。
words.en: A jury is a group of people who are chosen to decide whether someone is guilty or not guilty of a crime in a court of law.

words.ex: The poll showed that most people support the new law.
words.ex_cn: 这项民意调查表明，大多数人支持这项新法律。
words.en: A poll is a survey in which people are asked their opinions about something, usually in order to find out how popular something is or what people intend to do in the future.

words.ex: He is taking sociology at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学里学习社会学。
words.en: Sociology is the study of society, patterns of social relationships, social interaction, and culture that surrounds everyday life.

words.tr: adj. 家庭的；国内的；驯养的；
words.ex: She prefers domestic chores over going out.
words.ex_cn: 她更喜欢做家务而不是外出。
words.en: Domestic means relating to the home, family, or household affairs. It can also refer to something that is made or produced within a country and not imported.

words.tr: n. 事件；一集；一段经历；
words.ex: The accident was a sad episode in his life.
words.ex_cn: 那场事故是他生命中的一件悲伤的事。
words.en: An episode is a part of a story that is broadcast on television or radio as one of a series, or a single event or group of related events.

words.tr: n. 人性；人类；人道；仁慈；
words.ex: Kindness shows the best of humanity.
words.ex_cn: 善良展现了人性中最美好的一面。
words.en: Humanity refers to all human beings collectively or the qualities that make us human, such as kindness, compassion, and the ability to reason.

words.ex: The doctor gave him proper treatment for the infection.
words.ex_cn: 医生给他提供了针对感染的适当治疗。
words.en: The act or manner of treating someone or something, especially in a medical context.

words.ex: The government changed its education policy.
words.ex_cn: 政府改变了它的教育政策。
words.en: A policy is a set of ideas or plans that is used as a basis for making decisions, especially in politics, economics, or business.

words.ex: It was futile to try to fix the broken clock.
words.ex_cn: 试图修理坏掉的钟表是徒劳的。
words.en: If you say that something is futile, you mean there is no point in doing it, usually because it has no chance of succeeding.

words.ex: The ball is a perfect sphere.
words.ex_cn: 这个球是一个完美的球体。
words.en: A sphere is a perfectly round three-dimensional shape, like a ball. It can also refer to a particular area of interest, activity, or knowledge.

words.ex: There is a big statue in the city center.
words.ex_cn: 城市中心有一座巨大的雕像。
words.en: A statue is a large sculpture of a person or an animal, made of stone or metal.

words.tr: adj. 人道主义的；慈善的；
words.ex: The humanitarian aid helped the hungry children.
words.ex_cn: 人道主义援助帮助了饥饿的孩子们。
words.en: A humanitarian is someone who is involved in or connected with improving people's lives and reducing suffering.

words.ex: The teacher gave me feedback on my essay.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我关于我作文的反馈。
words.en: Feedback is comments in the form of opinions about and reactions to something, intended to provide useful information for future decisions and development.

words.ex: He cheated on the test by copying answers.
words.ex_cn: 他通过抄答案来作弊。
words.en: To cheat means to act dishonestly or unfairly in order to gain an advantage, especially in a game or examination.

words.ex: He decided to discard his old habits.
words.ex_cn: 他决定抛开旧习惯。
words.en: To discard something means to get rid of it because you no longer want it or need it.

words.ex: The Earth is divided into two hemispheres: north and south.
words.ex_cn: 地球被分为两个半球：北半球和南半球。
words.en: A hemisphere is one half of the earth, especially the northern or southern half above or below the equator, or the eastern or western half.

words.ex: The painter portrays a happy family in the photo.
words.ex_cn: 这位画家在画中描绘了一个幸福的家庭。
words.en: To portray someone or something means to show or represent them in a painting, film, book, or other artistic work.

words.ex: The charity helps poor children get food and education.
words.ex_cn: 这个慈善团体帮助贫困儿童获得食物和教育。
words.en: An organization that helps people in need, or the act of giving money, food, or help to those who need it.

words.tr:
n. 锻造车间；
v. 建立（联系等）；
words.ex: The blacksmith works in the forge every morning.
words.ex_cn: 铁匠每天早上都在锻造车间工作。
words.en: To forge something means to create it, especially by using considerable effort or skill. It can also mean to make or produce something, especially with some difficulty or effort. Additionally, it refers to the act of making a copy or imitation of something with the intent to deceive.

words.tr: v. 背叛；出卖；泄露；暴露
words.ex: He betrays his friend by telling the secret.
words.ex_cn: 他通过泄露秘密背叛了朋友。
words.en: If you betray someone who loves or trusts you, your actions hurt and disappoint them.

words.tr: adj. 刻板的；坚硬的；严格的；
words.ex: He has a rigid attitude toward rules.
words.ex_cn: 他对规则的态度很刻板。
words.en: not able to be changed or adapted; not able to be bent or moved; stiff

words.ex: He lives in a tropical island near the equator.
words.ex_cn: 他住在赤道附近的一个热带岛屿上。
words.en: relating to or situated in or characteristic of the tropics (the region on either side of the equator)

words.tr: n. 受公众注意的程度；简介；轮廓；
words.ex: The celebrity's profile rose after the TV interview.
words.ex_cn: 这位名人经过电视采访后，受公众注意的程度提高了。
words.en: A profile is a side view of something, especially a person's face, or a brief description of someone or something.

words.ex: The tree has a hollow trunk.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树的树干是中空的。
words.en: If something is hollow, it has an empty space inside it.

words.tr:
n. 纠纷；争端；
v. 对（某事）有异议；
words.ex: The dispute between the two neighbors was about the fence.
words.ex_cn: 两个邻居之间的纠纷是关于篱笆的。
words.en: A dispute is a disagreement or argument about something important.

words.ex: The new tool enables him to finish work faster.
words.ex_cn: 这个新工具使他能够更快地完成工作。
words.en: If someone or something enables you to do a particular thing, they give you the opportunity or means to do it.

words.ex: His neck was stiff after sleeping wrong.
words.ex_cn: 他睡姿不对，脖子变得僵硬。
words.en: If something is stiff, it is firm and does not bend easily. It can also describe a person who is not relaxed or friendly.

words.ex: He sent the message via email.
words.ex_cn: 他通过电子邮件发送了这条消息。
words.en: If you go somewhere via a particular place, you go through that place on the way to your destination.

words.tr:
adj. 精心制作的；详尽的；
v. 精心制作；详尽阐述；
words.ex: She wore an elaborate dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一件精心制作的裙子去参加派对。
words.en: To elaborate means to add more details to something that has already been said or written, making it more complex or detailed. As an adjective, it describes something that is very complex and detailed.

words.ex: The monetary policy affects prices.
words.ex_cn: 货币政策影响价格。
words.en: Monetary means relating to money, especially the total amount of money in a country.

words.ex: He asked for permission to leave early.
words.ex_cn: 他请求允许早点离开。
words.en: If someone who has authority over you gives you permission to do something, they say that they will allow you to do it.

words.ex: The road was diverted around the park.
words.ex_cn: 这条路被改道绕过公园。
words.en: If you divert someone or something, you cause them to change direction or to go somewhere different.

words.tr:
n. 功能；职责；
v. 起作用；
words.ex: The function of this button is to turn on the light.
words.ex_cn: 这个按钮的功能是打开灯。
words.en: A function is the purpose that something is designed to have or the job that someone is employed to do. It can also refer to a mathematical relationship or a social event.

words.tr:
v. 实施；传导（电、热）；
n. 行为；举止；
words.ex: The company will conduct a survey next week.
words.ex_cn: 公司将在下周进行一项调查。
words.en: To organize and carry out a particular activity.

words.ex: The painting depicts a quiet village at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画描绘了一个宁静的村庄在日落时分的景象。
words.en: To depict someone or something means to show or represent them in a work of art such as a drawing or painting.

words.tr:
n. 基金；资金；
v. 提供资金；
words.ex: The school raised a fund for new books.
words.ex_cn: 学校为购买新书筹集了一笔基金。
words.en: A sum of money saved or made available for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The staff at the hotel are very friendly.
words.ex_cn: 酒店的职员非常友好。
words.en: The people who work for a particular organization or company, or a group of officers assisting a commanding officer.

words.ex: The loud music was a diversion from his worries.
words.ex_cn: 那嘈杂的音乐分散了他对烦恼的注意力。
words.en: A diversion is an action or event that attracts your attention away from what you are doing or should be doing.

words.ex: The layout of the room makes it feel bigger.
words.ex_cn: 房间的布局让它显得更大。
words.en: The way in which the parts of something are arranged or laid out.

words.tr:
n. 结构；建筑物；
v. 组织；
words.ex: The structure of the bridge is very strong.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥的结构非常坚固。
words.en: The arrangement of and relations between the parts or elements of something complex.

words.ex: There are a lot of books on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 书架上有许多书。
words.en: A lot refers to a large number or amount of something. It can also mean a piece of land or someone's fate or destiny.

words.tr: n. 养老金；退休金；抚恤金；
words.ex: He receives a monthly pension after retiring.
words.ex_cn: 他退休后每月领取养老金。
words.en: A pension is a sum of money which a retired, widowed, or disabled person regularly receives from the state or from a former employer.

words.ex: The crowd cheered loudly at the stadium.
words.ex_cn: 观众在体育场里大声欢呼。
words.en: A stadium is a large structure for open-air sports or entertainments, consisting of a field or stage surrounded partly or completely by a tiered structure designed to allow spectators to stand or sit and view the event.

words.ex: The essence of love is caring for others.
words.ex_cn: 爱的本质是关心他人。
words.en: The essence of something is its basic and most important characteristic which gives it its individual identity.

words.ex: His belief in honesty never changed.
words.ex_cn: 他对诚实的信念从未改变。
words.en: A belief is a strong feeling that something is true or exists.

words.ex: He looked at the catalog to find the book.
words.ex_cn: 他翻看目录来找那本书。
words.en: A catalog is a list of things, such as the goods you can buy from a particular company, the objects in a museum, or the books in a library.

words.tr:
n. 草图；素描；概述
v. 草拟；速写；简述
words.ex: He made a quick sketch of the house.
words.ex_cn: 他快速画出了房子的草图。
words.en: A sketch is a simple, quickly-made drawing that does not have many details. It can also mean a short description or account of something.

words.ex: The two parties formed a coalition to win the election.
words.ex_cn: 这两个政党联合起来以赢得选举。
words.en: A coalition is a temporary alliance for combined action, especially of political parties forming a government.

words.tr:
n. 凝视；注视；
v. 凝视；注视；
words.ex: His gaze fixed on the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 他的凝视固定在日落上。
words.en: If you gaze at someone or something, you look steadily at them for a long time, for example because you find them attractive or interesting, or because you are thinking about something else.

words.ex: The garden has fragrant flowers.
words.ex_cn: 这个花园里有芳香的花。
words.en: Having a pleasant or sweet smell.

words.tr:
adj. 恶毒的；
n. 邪恶；罪恶；
words.ex: The evil king punished innocent people.
words.ex_cn: 这个恶毒的国王惩罚了无辜的人。
words.en: Evil is a powerful force that some people believe to exist, and which causes wicked and bad things to happen.

words.ex: The index of 2 in 2^3 is 3.
words.ex_cn: 2^3 中 2 的指数是 3。
words.en: An index is a system by which changes in the value of something and the rate at which it changes can be recorded, measured, or interpreted.

words.tr: n. 雕刻（术）；雕塑品；雕刻品；
words.ex: He made a beautiful sculpture from clay.
words.ex_cn: 他用黏土做了一件精美的雕刻。
words.en: Sculpture is the art of making two- or three-dimensional representative or abstract forms, especially by carving stone or wood or by casting metal or plaster.

words.tr:
n. 批准；允许；认可；制裁；处罚
v. 批准；认可；制裁；处罚
words.ex: The company got official sanction to open a new branch.
words.ex_cn: 该公司获得了开设新分公司的正式批准。
words.en: A sanction is a penalty for disobeying a law or rule, or an official permission or approval for an action.

words.ex: The food at this restaurant is superb.
words.ex_cn: 这家餐厅的食物极佳。
words.en: If something is superb, its quality is very good indeed.

words.ex: She bought a new perfume for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为派对买了一瓶新香水。
words.en: A perfume is a pleasant-smelling liquid which people put on their skin to make themselves smell nice.

words.ex: The children stood in awe at the sight of the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们看到山时感到敬畏。
words.en: A feeling of reverential respect mixed with fear or wonder.

words.tr:
n. 屏幕；屏风；掩蔽物；
v. 筛查；掩蔽；
words.ex: The movie is playing on the screen.
words.ex_cn: 电影正在屏幕上播放。
words.en: A screen is a flat surface on which pictures or words are shown, such as the one on a television or computer. It can also refer to a partition used to divide or protect an area. As a verb, to screen means to examine something in order to decide whether it is suitable for a particular purpose, or to protect someone or something from something harmful or unpleasant.

words.ex: The attraction of the city draws many tourists.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市的吸引力吸引了许多游客。
words.en: An attraction is something that makes people want to go to a place or do a particular thing because they are interested in it.

words.ex: The president may be impeached for lying.
words.ex_cn: 总统可能因撒谎而被弹劾。
words.en: If a government official is impeached, they are formally charged with a serious crime in a special government court.

words.tr: n. 要洗的衣物；洗衣店；
words.ex: I put the dirty laundry in the washing machine.
words.ex_cn: 我把脏衣服放进洗衣机里。
words.en: Laundry refers to the clothes and linens that need to be washed or that have just been washed. It can also refer to the place or business where clothes and linens are washed and ironed.

words.tr: v. 繁荣兴旺；茁壮成长；
words.ex: The business flourishes in the new market.
words.ex_cn: 这家企业在新市场中繁荣兴旺。
words.en: If something flourishes, it is successful, active, or common, and developing quickly and strongly.

words.tr: adj. 逻辑上的；合乎逻辑的；
words.ex: His argument is logical and easy to understand.
words.ex_cn: 他的论点合乎逻辑，容易理解。
words.en: In accordance with the principles of logic; reasonable.

words.ex: The knight held up his shield to block the arrow.
words.ex_cn: 骑士举起盾牌来挡箭。
words.en: A shield is a piece of armor held in the hand or worn on the arm to protect the body from missiles or blows. It can also refer to something that protects or defends someone or something from harm or danger.

words.ex: She adores her little brother.
words.ex_cn: 她非常喜爱她的弟弟。
words.en: If you adore someone, you feel great love and admiration for them.

words.tr: v. 逐渐削弱；暗中损害；
words.ex: Constant criticism can undermine your confidence.
words.ex_cn: 不断的批评会逐渐削弱你的信心。
words.en: To undermine something means to weaken it or make it less effective, often in a gradual or sneaky way.

words.tr: n. 令人讨厌的或繁重的工作；
words.ex: Washing dishes is a boring chore.
words.ex_cn: 洗碗是一件烦人的琐事。
words.en: A chore is a task or piece of work that is often boring or unpleasant but needs to be done regularly.

words.ex: The roses are in bloom in spring.
words.ex_cn: 玫瑰在春天开花。
words.en: When a plant or tree blooms, it produces flowers. The period during which a plant or tree produces flowers is also known as its bloom.

words.ex: It is rational to save money for the future.
words.ex_cn: 为未来存钱是合理的。
words.en: Based on or in accordance with reason or logic.

words.ex: She is flexible with her schedule.
words.ex_cn: 她的日程安排很灵活。
words.en: Able to change or be changed easily according to the situation.

words.tr:
n. 崇拜；崇敬；礼拜；
v. 崇拜；尊崇；做礼拜；
words.ex: The ancient people showed worship to the sun.
words.ex_cn: 古人对太阳进行崇拜。
words.en: The feeling or expression of reverence and adoration for a deity.

words.ex: The cat is underneath the table.
words.ex_cn: 猫在桌子下面。
words.en: If one thing is underneath another, it is directly under it, often so that it is hidden by it.

words.ex: His rude words provoked her anger.
words.ex_cn: 他粗鲁的话激怒了她。
words.en: If you provoke someone, you deliberately annoy them and try to make them behave aggressively.

words.tr:
n. （果树的）花朵；
v. 开花；
words.ex: The apple tree is full of blossom in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天时，苹果树上开满了花。
words.en: When a tree or plant blossoms, it produces flowers before producing fruit that can be eaten.

words.ex: He can deduce the answer from the clues.
words.ex_cn: 他能从线索中推断出答案。
words.en: If you deduce something or deduce that something is true, you reach that conclusion because of other things that you know to be true.

words.tr: v. 复制；复印；再做一次；
words.ex: He duplicated the file to save a copy.
words.ex_cn: 他复制了该文件以保存一份副本。
words.en: To duplicate something means to make an exact copy of it.

words.ex: The repetition of the same words made the lesson boring.
words.ex_cn: 相同词语的重复让这堂课变得无聊。
words.en: The act of repeating something that has already been said or written.

words.ex: He concluded that the experiment failed.
words.ex_cn: 他得出结论说实验失败了。
words.en: If you conclude that something is true, you decide that it is true using the facts you know as a basis.

words.ex: The child's curiosity made him ask many questions.
words.ex_cn: 孩子的好奇心让他问了很多问题。
words.en: A desire to know or learn about something; something that is interesting because it is unusual or strange.

words.ex: He eats cereal with milk every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃谷类食品配牛奶。
words.en: A cereal is a grass that is cultivated for the edible components of its grain, composed of the endosperm, germ, and bran.

words.ex: He deducts tax from his salary every month.
words.ex_cn: 他每月从工资中扣除税款。
words.en: If you deduct an amount from a total, you subtract it from the total.

words.tr:
adj. 三部分的；三方的；三倍的
n. 三倍；最高音部；高音
v. 成为三倍；使增至三倍
words.ex: The pie has a treble layer of chocolate.
words.ex_cn: 这个派有三层巧克力。
words.en: Treble can be used as an adjective to describe something that is three times as much or as many, as a noun to refer to the highest range of musical notes, or as a verb to mean to make or become three times as much or as many.

words.ex: He inferred that she was tired from her yawns.
words.ex_cn: 他从她的哈欠推断出她很累。
words.en: If you infer that something is the case, you decide that it is true on the basis of information that you already have.

words.ex: After the experiment, we reached a conclusion.
words.ex_cn: 实验结束后，我们得出了一个结论。
words.en: A conclusion is the last part of something, its end or result.

words.tr:
n. 厄运；毁灭；死亡
v. 注定；判决
words.ex: The old prophecy spoke of doom for the kingdom.
words.ex_cn: 古老的预言说这个王国将遭遇厄运。
words.en: Doom is a terrible fate or destiny that you cannot avoid, especially death or destruction.

words.ex: The farm has a surplus of apples this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年农场苹果过剩。
words.en: A surplus is an amount of something that is extra or more than what is needed.

words.ex: Subtract 5 from 10 to get 5.
words.ex_cn: 从10中减去5得到5。
words.en: If you subtract one number from another, you take the first number away from the second.

words.tr:
n. 时距；跨度；
v. 跨越；
words.ex: The span of his career was 40 years.
words.ex_cn: 他职业生涯的时距是40年。
words.en: The extent or measure of space between two points or extremities, as of a bridge or a roof; the full extent, stretch, or reach of anything.

words.ex: From the clues, he made a logical inference.
words.ex_cn: 从线索中，他做出了一个合理的推论。
words.en: An inference is a conclusion that you draw about something by using information that you already have about it.

words.tr: n. 结束；结局； v. 结束；“end”的现在分词；
words.ex: The ending of the movie was surprising.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影的结束令人惊讶。
words.en: The final part of something, especially a story, movie, or play.

words.ex: He believed his destiny was to become a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他相信自己的命运是成为一名医生。
words.en: Destiny is the force which some people believe controls the things that happen to you in your life.

words.ex: He dumped the trash into the bin.
words.ex_cn: 他把垃圾倒进了垃圾桶。
words.en: To dump something means to get rid of it quickly and without care, often because it is no longer wanted or needed. It can also refer to the place where waste is left.

words.ex: He ate a moderate amount of food.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了适量的食物。
words.en: If you moderate something or if it moderates, it becomes less extreme or violent, or if you moderate a discussion, you help the people in it to reach an agreement.

words.ex: The child's recovery was a miracle.
words.ex_cn: 孩子的康复是个奇迹。
words.en: A miracle is an event that cannot be explained by the laws of nature and is therefore considered to be the work of a divine agency.

words.tr: adj. 人道的；仁慈的；人文的
words.ex: The shelter treats animals in a humane way.
words.ex_cn: 这个收容所以人道的方式对待动物。
words.en: If you describe something as humane, you mean that it is good and kind, especially because it decreases suffering.

words.ex: She wore a white veil on her wedding day.
words.ex_cn: 她在婚礼那天戴了一条白色的面纱。
words.en: A veil is a piece of thin soft cloth that women sometimes wear over their heads and which can also cover their face.

words.ex: The train's destination is Beijing.
words.ex_cn: 这列火车的目的地是北京。
words.en: The place to which someone or something is going or being sent.

words.ex: The teacher gave me guidance on how to write the essay.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我写论文的指导。
words.en: Guidance is help and advice that is given to someone about their work, education, or personal life.

words.ex: The teacher instructed the students to open their books.
words.ex_cn: 老师指示学生打开书。
words.en: To instruct someone means to tell or teach them to do something, especially in a formal or official way.

words.ex: The ancient temple has a tall stone column.
words.ex_cn: 这座古庙有一根高大的石柱。
words.en: A column is a tall solid upright stone post used to support a building or as a monument.

words.ex: He reads a science journal every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周读一本科学期刊。
words.en: A journal is a newspaper or magazine that deals with a particular subject or professional activity.

words.tr:
n. （鸟或羊）群；（人）群；
v. 聚集；群集；
words.ex: A flock of birds flew over the field.
words.ex_cn: 一群鸟飞过田野。
words.en: A flock is a group of birds, sheep, or goats, or a large group of people. It can also refer to a soft material for stuffing cushions, quilts, etc., made from wool or cotton. As a verb, it means to gather or move in a flock.

words.tr:
n. 兽群；
v. 放牧；
words.ex: The herd of cows walked slowly to the pasture.
words.ex_cn: 一群牛缓缓走向牧场。
words.en: A herd is a large group of animals of one kind that live together.

words.tr:
adj. 浅的
n. 浅水处；鱼群；一大群
v. （使）变浅
words.ex: The boat ran aground on the shoal.
words.ex_cn: 船在浅水处搁浅了。
words.en: A shoal is a large number of fish swimming together. It can also refer to a shallow place in a body of water.

words.tr:
n. 一群；一帮；一伙
v. 成群结队；结成一伙；合伙攻击
words.ex: The gang stole a car last night.
words.ex_cn: 那群人昨晚偷了一辆车。
words.en: A gang is a group of people, especially young people, who go around together and often deliberately cause trouble.

words.tr:
n. 群；蜂群
v. 云集；充满
words.ex: Bees swarm around the flower.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂围绕着花朵成群飞舞。
words.en: A swarm is a large group of insects, especially bees, moving together. As a verb, it means to move in or form a swarm.

words.tr:
v. 意思是说；表示…的意思；
n. 手段；方法；收入；
words.ex: This sign means you cannot park here.
words.ex_cn: 这个标志意思是说这里不能停车。
words.en: Means refers to a method or way of doing something, or the resources or assets available for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The corporate office is in New York.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司的总部在纽约。
words.en: Corporate relates to large companies or to a particular large company.

words.ex: The new plan incorporates feedback from students.
words.ex_cn: 新计划包含了学生的反馈。
words.en: If one thing incorporates another thing, it includes the other thing.

words.ex: They will liberate the prisoners tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他们明天会释放这些囚犯。
words.en: To liberate a place or the people in it means to free them from the political or military control of another country, area, or group of people.

words.tr:
adj. 开明的；自由主义的；
n. 自由党党员；
words.ex: He is a liberal teacher who listens to students.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位开明的老师，会倾听学生的声音。
words.en: A liberal person, system, or policy is one that is in favour of allowing people a lot of freedom in their behaviour or opinions.

words.tr:
n. 目标；对象；
v. 以…为目标；
words.ex: His target is to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他的目标是按时完成项目。
words.en: A target is something at which someone is aiming a weapon or other object.

words.ex: The law will emancipate slaves.
words.ex_cn: 法律将解放奴隶。
words.en: To emancipate someone means to set them free from something that restricts their freedom to do what they want.

words.ex: The toy store sells many novelty items for children.
words.ex_cn: 玩具店出售许多为儿童设计的新奇物品。
words.en: The quality of being new, original, or unusual; something new, original, or unusual.

words.tr: n. 图像；形象；画面；影像；
words.ex: The photo shows a clear image of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 这张照片展示了山脉的清晰图像。
words.en: An image is a picture that you have in your mind, especially about what someone or something is like or the way they look.

words.ex: The weather is mild today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天气温和。
words.en: Mild is used to describe something that is not extreme, severe, or strong, such as weather, taste, or behavior.

words.tr:
adj. 周期的；定期的
n. 期刊
words.ex: The plant has a periodical blooming cycle.
words.ex_cn: 这种植物有周期性的开花周期。
words.en: A periodical is a magazine, especially one that is published regularly, or something that happens at regular intervals.

words.tr:
n. 后部；
v. 饲养；抚养；
adj. 后面的；
words.ex: The rear of the car was damaged in the accident.
words.ex_cn: 汽车的后部在事故中受损了。
words.en: The back part of something, especially a building or vehicle; to bring up and care for a child until they are fully grown.

words.tr:
n. 平衡；天平；秤；
v. （使）相抵；（使）平衡；
words.ex: She maintains a good balance between work and rest.
words.ex_cn: 她在工作和休息之间保持良好的平衡。
words.en: Balance is the ability to remain steady when you are standing up. Also, it refers to the state of having your weight spread equally so that you do not fall. In finance, it refers to the amount of money you have in a bank account.

words.ex: He has a clear notion of right and wrong.
words.ex_cn: 他对对错有清晰的概念。
words.en: A notion is an idea or belief about something.

words.ex: She knit a warm scarf for her brother.
words.ex_cn: 她为她的弟弟织了一条暖和的围巾。
words.en: If you knit something, especially an article of clothing, you make it from wool or a similar thread by using two knitting needles or a machine.

words.ex: The earthquake caused tremendous damage.
words.ex_cn: 地震造成了巨大的破坏。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as tremendous, you mean that they are very great in amount, extent, or intensity.

words.tr:
v. 发抖；打颤；战栗；焦虑
n. 震颤；发抖；战栗
words.ex: The old man tremble in the cold wind.
words.ex_cn: 老人在寒风中发抖。
words.en: If you tremble, you shake slightly because you are frightened or cold.

words.tr:
v. 拥抱；紧抱；抱有；挨着
n. 拥抱；搂抱
words.ex: She gave him a big hug when he arrived.
words.ex_cn: 他到达时，她给了他一个大大的拥抱。
words.en: To hug someone means to put your arms around them and hold them tightly, for example because you like them or are pleased to see them.

words.ex: He finally embraced the new idea.
words.ex_cn: 他最终接受了这个新想法。
words.en: To take someone into your arms as a sign of love or affection, or to accept something enthusiastically.

words.tr:
n. 轻拍；
v. 轻拍；
words.ex: He gave the dog a gentle pat on the head.
words.ex_cn: 他轻轻拍了拍狗的头。
words.en: To gently touch someone or something with your hand flat.

words.tr:
adj. 最重要的；
adv. 首要地；
words.ex: He is the foremost expert in this field.
words.ex_cn: 他是这个领域最重要的专家。
words.en: Most important or prominent; leading.

words.ex: The external wall of the house is painted blue.
words.ex_cn: 房子的外墙被刷成了蓝色。
words.en: External is used to indicate that something is on the outside of a surface or body, or that it exists, happens, or comes from outside.

words.ex: The forest is dense with trees.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林树木茂密。
words.en: Something that is dense contains a lot of things or people in a small area.

words.ex: She has a feminine voice.
words.ex_cn: 她的声音很女性化。
words.en: having qualities or an appearance traditionally associated with women, especially delicacy and prettiness.

words.ex: He has a masculine voice and strong build.
words.ex_cn: 他声音低沉，身材强壮。
words.en: Having qualities or appearance traditionally associated with men.

words.ex: He earned the esteem of his colleagues through hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他通过努力工作赢得了同事们的尊重。
words.en: If you esteem someone or something, you respect or admire them.

words.ex: He despises lying.
words.ex_cn: 他鄙视撒谎。
words.en: If you despise something or someone, you dislike them and have a very low opinion of them.

words.ex: He looked at the lie with contempt.
words.ex_cn: 他轻蔑地看着这个谎言。
words.en: If you have contempt for someone or something, you have no respect for them or think that they are unimportant.

words.ex: He showed disdain for the lazy students.
words.ex_cn: 他对那些懒惰的学生表现出蔑视。
words.en: If you feel disdain for someone or something, you dislike them because you think that they are inferior or unimportant.

words.tr: adj. 恒定的；不变的；持续的；
words.ex: The temperature is constant in this room.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间的温度是恒定的。
words.en: Something that is constant happens all the time or is always there.

words.tr: adj. 古怪的；难以解释的
words.ex: He is queer and proud of who he is.
words.ex_cn: 他是同性恋，并为自己是谁而自豪。
words.en: Queer is used to describe something that is strange or unusual, or someone who is homosexual.

words.tr: adj. 奇怪的；奇数的；余的；
words.ex: He wore an odd hat to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他戴了一顶奇怪的帽子去参加派对。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as odd, you mean that they are strange or unusual.

words.ex: He showed courtesy by holding the door open.
words.ex_cn: 他为别人扶着门，表现得很礼貌。
words.en: Courtesy is polite behavior, or a polite action or remark.

words.ex: He wore a formal suit to the wedding.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了一套正式的西装去参加婚礼。
words.en: Something that is formal is done or said according to an established or conventional way, especially in an official or serious situation.

words.ex: He loves watching stars and learning astronomy.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢看星星并学习天文学。
words.en: Astronomy is the scientific study of celestial objects, space, and the physical universe as a whole.

words.ex: They shouted, 'Welcome home!' when he walked through the door.
words.ex_cn: 当他走进门时，他们大喊：‘欢迎回家！’
words.en: A greeting used to express pleasure at someone's return to their home.

words.tr:
n. 滞后；延迟；
v. 落后；缓慢移动；
words.ex: There is a lag between the signal and the response.
words.ex_cn: 信号和响应之间有滞后。
words.en: If one thing or person lags behind another thing or person, their progress is slower than that of the other.

words.ex: He gave a bold speech in front of the crowd.
words.ex_cn: 他在众人面前发表了大胆的演讲。
words.en: Someone who is bold is not afraid to do things which involve risk or danger.

words.tr: adj. 可疑的；怀疑的；拿不准的；
words.ex: The deal seemed dubious to me.
words.ex_cn: 这个交易在我看来很可疑。
words.en: If you describe something as dubious, you mean that you do not consider it to be completely honest, safe, or reliable.

words.tr:
v. 建造；构造；
n. 概念；
words.ex: They construct houses with bricks.
words.ex_cn: 他们用砖块建造房屋。
words.en: To construct something means to build or create it, usually something large such as a building, road, or machine.

words.ex: The teacher showed a specimen of a butterfly.
words.ex_cn: 老师展示了一个蝴蝶标本。
words.en: A specimen is a single thing or example of something, especially one that is used to represent the whole group or type.

words.tr:
n. 样品；样本；
v. 抽样；
words.ex: The scientist tested the sample from the river.
words.ex_cn: 科学家测试了来自河流的样品。
words.en: A sample is a small quantity of a product, especially food, given to customers so that they can try it before buying it.

words.ex: The transit of goods takes three days.
words.ex_cn: 货物的运输需要三天。
words.en: The act or process of passing through or across; the conveyance of people or goods from one place to another.

words.ex: The transition from school to work was hard for him.
words.ex_cn: 从学校到工作的转变对他来说很难。
words.en: The process or a period of changing from one state or condition to another.

words.ex: The marine birds fly over the sea.
words.ex_cn: 这些海鸟在海面上飞翔。
words.en: Marine is used to describe things relating to the sea or to the ships and boats which sail on it.

words.ex: The child gave a naive smile when he believed the story.
words.ex_cn: 当孩子相信这个故事时，他露出了天真的微笑。
words.en: If you describe someone as naïve, you think they lack experience and so expect things to be easy or people to be honest or kind.

words.ex: The ship uses GPS for navigation.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船使用GPS进行导航。
words.en: The process or activity of accurately ascertaining one's position and planning and following a route.

words.ex: The government will implement new rules next month.
words.ex_cn: 政府下个月将实施新规定。
words.en: To implement something means to ensure that what has been planned is done.

words.ex: He used an analogy to explain how the heart works.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一个类比来解释心脏是如何工作的。
words.en: If you make or draw an analogy between two things, you show that they are similar in some way.

words.tr:
v. 引用；报价；
n. 引用；引文；报价；
words.ex: He quoted Shakespeare in his speech.
words.ex_cn: 他在演讲中引用了莎士比亚的话。
words.en: To repeat or copy out (a group of words from a text or speech), typically with an indication that one is not the original author or speaker.

words.ex: The ice melts in the sun.
words.ex_cn: 冰在阳光下融化。
words.en: If a solid substance melts or if you melt it, it changes to a liquid, usually because it has been heated.

words.tr: v. 取代；迫使…离开家园；
words.ex: The new robot will displace the workers on the assembly line.
words.ex_cn: 这个新机器人将取代装配线上的工人。
words.en: To displace something or someone means to take their place or to force them to leave their usual place or role.

words.ex: The fairy tale features a dwarf who lives in a small house.
words.ex_cn: 这个童话故事中有一个住在小房子里的侏儒。
words.en: A dwarf is a person, animal, or plant that is much smaller than the usual size of its species. As a verb, to dwarf means to make someone or something seem small or insignificant in comparison.

words.ex: He was rude to the waiter.
words.ex_cn: 他对服务员很无礼。
words.en: If someone is rude, they behave in a way that is not polite and upsets other people.

words.tr:
v. 绑架；劫持；诱拐
n. 绑架罪
words.ex: The man tried to kidnap the little girl.
words.ex_cn: 这个人试图绑架那个小女孩。
words.en: To take someone away illegally by force, typically to obtain a ransom.

words.ex: The terrorists hijacked a plane and flew it to another country.
words.ex_cn: 恐怖分子劫持了一架飞机，飞到了另一个国家。
words.en: To hijack a vehicle or aircraft is to take control of it by force, often in order to steal it or to use it for a purpose other than its intended one.

words.ex: The kidnappers asked for a ransom of $1 million.
words.ex_cn: 绑匪要求一百万美元的赎金。
words.en: A ransom is the money that is demanded for the release of a person who has been kidnapped.

words.ex: He is always punctual for class.
words.ex_cn: 他上课总是准时。
words.en: If you are punctual, you do something or arrive somewhere at the right time and are not late.

words.ex: He punched the wall in anger.
words.ex_cn: 他生气地打了墙一拳。
words.en: To punch means to hit someone or something hard with your fist, or to make a hole in something using a tool.

words.tr:
n. 刺穿；刺孔
v. 刺穿；削弱
words.ex: The bike tire has a puncture.
words.ex_cn: 自行车轮胎有一个漏气孔。
words.en: A puncture is a small hole made by a sharp object, especially in a tire. To puncture something means to make a hole in it with a sharp object.

words.ex: They have mutual respect for each other.
words.ex_cn: 他们彼此相互尊重。
words.en: Mutual is used to describe a situation, feeling, or action that is experienced, felt, or done by each of two or more parties towards the other or others.

words.ex: He posted an anonymous comment online.
words.ex_cn: 他在网上发布了一条匿名评论。
words.en: If you remain anonymous when you do something, you do not let people know that you were the person who did it.

words.ex: They have a reciprocal agreement to help each other.
words.ex_cn: 他们有一个互相帮助的互惠协议。
words.en: A reciprocal action or agreement involves two people or groups who do the same thing to each other or agree to help each other in a similar way.

words.ex: People are increasingly using smartphones.
words.ex_cn: 人们日益使用智能手机。
words.en: More and more; gradually becoming greater in amount or degree.

words.ex: She bought a warm wrap for the winter.
words.ex_cn: 她买了一件保暖的包裹（披肩）过冬。
words.en: To cover or enclose something in paper, cloth, or other material.

words.ex: The magic trick will astonish you.
words.ex_cn: 这个魔术会让你惊讶。
words.en: If something or someone astonishes you, they surprise you very much.

words.ex: She tied a red ribbon around the box.
words.ex_cn: 她把一条红色的带状物系在盒子上。
words.en: A ribbon is a long, narrow piece of cloth that you use for tying things together or as a decoration.

words.ex: The loud noise stunned him.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音让他震惊了。
words.en: To stun someone means to shock or surprise them very much.

words.ex: She weaves a basket from reeds.
words.ex_cn: 她用芦苇编织一个篮子。
words.en: If you weave cloth or a carpet, you make it by crossing threads over and under each other using a machine or a frame called a loom.

words.ex: The magic trick astounded the children.
words.ex_cn: 这个魔术让孩子们惊呆了。
words.en: If something astounds you, it surprises or shocks you very much.

words.ex: The foundation gives money to poor students.
words.ex_cn: 这个基金会向贫困学生提供资金。
words.en: The foundation of something such as a belief or way of life is the things on which it is based.

words.ex: The violent news appalls her.
words.ex_cn: 这起暴力新闻令她震惊。
words.en: to fill with horror or dismay; shock deeply

words.tr:
n. 计划；方案；项目；课题；
v. 投射；预计；
words.ex: He presented his school project to the class.
words.ex_cn: 他向全班展示了他的学校计划。
words.en: A project is a piece of work that is planned or intended, or a large piece of work that is done by a group of people.

words.tr: n. 群体；殖民地；聚居地；
words.ex: A colony of ants moved quickly across the ground.
words.ex_cn: 一群蚂蚁迅速从地上爬过。
words.en: A colony is a country or area that is under the political control of another country, usually one that is far away, and where people from that country live.

words.tr: n. 定居点；定居（过程）；协议；
words.ex: The small settlement near the river has five houses.
words.ex_cn: 河边的小定居点有五所房子。
words.en: A settlement is an official agreement intended to resolve a dispute or conflict.

words.tr:
v. 派遣；调遣；发送
n. 快信；发送；派遣
words.ex: He will dispatch the package tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会寄出这个包裹。
words.en: To send someone or something to a particular place for a particular purpose.

words.tr: adj. 破旧的；肮脏破烂的；衣衫褴褛的
words.ex: He wore a shabby coat to school.
words.ex_cn: 他穿着一件破旧的外套去学校。
words.en: If you describe something as shabby, you mean that it looks old and is in poor condition.

words.tr:
v. 使脱落；去除；
n. 棚屋；
words.ex: The tree sheds its leaves in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树在秋天落叶。
words.en: A shed is a small building, usually made of wood, used for storing things such as garden tools. When something sheds, it loses its covering, such as leaves or hair, or it gets rid of something it no longer needs.

words.ex: He wore a rag to clean the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他用一块破布擦地板。
words.en: A rag is a piece of old cloth which you can use to clean or wipe things. As a verb, to rag means to tease or mock someone persistently.

words.ex: His sentiment about the new policy is positive.
words.ex_cn: 他对新政策的看法是积极的。
words.en: A sentiment is a thought, opinion, or idea based on a feeling about a situation, or a way of thinking about something.

words.ex: The heavy workload became a burden for her.
words.ex_cn: 繁重的工作量成了她的负担。
words.en: A burden is a heavy load that is difficult to carry, or a duty or responsibility that is hard to bear.

words.ex: He felt great distress when he lost his job.
words.ex_cn: 当他失去工作时，他感到非常忧虑。
words.en: Distress is a feeling of extreme worry, sadness, or pain.

words.ex: He tried to suppress his anger.
words.ex_cn: 他试图抑制自己的愤怒。
words.en: To suppress something means to prevent it from being expressed, known, or continuing.

words.tr: n. 恶作剧；淘气；伤害；损害
words.ex: The boy caused mischief by letting the cats out.
words.ex_cn: 那个男孩放出了猫，惹了麻烦。
words.en: Mischief is behavior, especially by children, that is slightly bad but is not intended to cause serious harm or damage.

words.ex: He was frank about his mistakes.
words.ex_cn: 他坦率地承认了自己的错误。
words.en: If someone is frank, they state or express things in an open and honest way.

words.tr:
adj. 不锋利的；耿直的
v. 使变钝
words.ex: The knife is blunt and cannot cut paper.
words.ex_cn: 这把刀不锋利，切不动纸。
words.en: If you are blunt, you say exactly what you think without trying to be polite.

words.ex: He gave a thumbs-up with his thumb.
words.ex_cn: 他用大拇指比了个赞。
words.en: The thick short digit on the hand that is opposite to the fingers and can be moved to be opposite any of the other fingers.

words.ex: He stepped aside to let the bus pass.
words.ex_cn: 他走到一旁，让公交车通过。
words.en: If you move something aside, you move it to one side of you, usually because it is in the way.

words.ex: The teacher will classify the students by age.
words.ex_cn: 老师将按年龄对学生进行分类。
words.en: To classify things means to divide them into groups or types so that things with similar characteristics are in the same group.

words.tr:
adj. 哑的；无声的
n. 哑巴；沉默的人
v. 减弱…的声音
words.ex: He stayed mute during the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议期间保持沉默。
words.en: If someone is mute, they are unable to speak.

words.tr: v. 使相混；使联结；交际
words.ex: He mingled the two colors to make a new one.
words.ex_cn: 他把两种颜色混合在一起，创造出一种新颜色。
words.en: If things such as sounds, smells, or feelings mingle, they mix or combine with each other, or if people mingle, they talk to each other at a social event.

words.ex: The magic show amazed the children.
words.ex_cn: 魔术表演让孩子们感到惊奇。
words.en: To amaze someone means to surprise them very much.

words.ex: He used the sun to orient himself.
words.ex_cn: 他用太阳来确定方向。
words.en: To orient means to align or position something in relation to the points of a compass or other specified positions, or to familiarize someone with a new situation or environment.

words.ex: He crossed the threshold of adulthood at 18.
words.ex_cn: 他在18岁时进入了成年的起始点。
words.en: The threshold of something is the point at which it begins or changes.

words.tr: n. 来源；出处；源泉；源头；提供资料者；
words.ex: The river's source is in the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这条河的源头在山里。
words.en: The place, person, or thing from which something comes or can be obtained.

words.tr:
n. 跛子；（身体部分或全部肢体）有缺陷的人
v. 使成瘸子；严重损坏（削弱）
words.ex: The cripple walked slowly with a cane.
words.ex_cn: 那个跛子拄着拐杖慢慢走。
words.en: If someone is crippled by an injury, it is so serious that they can never move their body properly again. A cripple is a person who is severely disabled or unable to walk because of damage to their body.

words.tr:
n. 低语声；嘟哝
v. 低语；咕哝；私下抱怨
words.ex: I heard a murmur from the next room.
words.ex_cn: 我听到隔壁房间传来低语声。
words.en: A murmur is a low, indistinct, continuous sound, as of a stream or of voices.

words.ex: The mountain scenery is very beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 山景非常美丽。
words.en: The natural features of a landscape considered in terms of their appearance, especially when picturesque.

words.ex: The tiger has black stripes on its orange fur.
words.ex_cn: 老虎的橙色皮毛上有黑色条纹。
words.en: A stripe is a long, narrow band or strip differing in color or texture from the surface on either side of it.

words.ex: After a short break, he resumed his work.
words.ex_cn: 短暂休息后，他继续工作。
words.en: If you resume an activity or if it resumes, it begins again or continues after an interruption.

words.tr:
n. 鱼饵；诱惑物
v. 下诱饵
words.ex: He used bread as bait to catch fish.
words.ex_cn: 他用面包当诱饵来钓鱼。
words.en: Bait is something which is used to attract fish or animals so that they can be caught. It can also refer to something that is offered to someone to persuade them to do something.

words.tr:
n. 残疾；障碍；阻碍；不利
v. 妨碍；使不利
words.ex: He has a physical handicap but still runs every day.
words.ex_cn: 他有身体残疾，但仍然每天跑步。
words.en: A handicap is a condition that markedly restricts a person's ability to function physically, mentally, or socially.

words.tr:
n. 针脚；缝线；一针
v. 缝；缝合
words.ex: She sews a stitch to fix the tear.
words.ex_cn: 她缝一针来补破洞。
words.en: A stitch is a piece of thread that has been used to sew the edges of a wound together. It can also refer to a loop of thread or yarn resulting from a single pass or movement of the needle in sewing, knitting, or crocheting.

words.ex: The landscape after the rain is very beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 雨后的景色非常美丽。
words.en: A landscape is all the visible features of an area of land, often considered in terms of their aesthetic appeal.

words.ex: He fastened the strap around his wrist.
words.ex_cn: 他把带子系在手腕上。
words.en: A strap is a narrow piece of leather, cloth, or other material that is used to fasten, secure, or carry something, or to hold onto something.

words.tr:
n. 原木；航海日志；
v. （正式地）记载；
words.ex: The fire burned brightly with a large log.
words.ex_cn: 大火用一根大原木烧得很旺。
words.en: A log is a piece of a thick branch or trunk of a tree that has been cut so that it can be used for fuel or for making things. A log is also a written record of events, often on a ship or aircraft.

words.ex: The judge will summon him tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 法官明天将传唤他。
words.en: If you summon someone, you order them to come to you.

words.tr:
adj. 瘸的；跛的；站不住脚的；无说服力的
v. 变跛；瘸行
words.ex: The lame dog walked slowly on three legs.
words.ex_cn: 那只瘸狗用三条腿慢慢走。
words.en: If someone is lame, they are unable to walk properly because of damage to one or both of their legs. A lame excuse, explanation, etc. is one that is weak and difficult to believe.

words.ex: She rolled out the paste for the pie crust.
words.ex_cn: 她把面团擀平做派皮。
words.en: Paste is a soft, wet, sticky mixture of a powder and a liquid, which can be spread easily. It is also used to refer to the action of sticking something onto a surface using a sticky substance.

words.ex: He unfolded the map on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他把地图在桌子上展开。
words.en: To open or spread out something that is folded; to develop or be revealed.

words.ex: The dress has a beautiful lace at the bottom.
words.ex_cn: 这条裙子的底部有漂亮的花边。
words.en: Lace is a very delicate cloth which is made with a lot of holes in it. It is made by twisting together very fine threads of cotton to form patterns.

words.ex: He decided to embark on a new career.
words.ex_cn: 他决定从事一份新职业。
words.en: To embark on something means to start it, especially something new, difficult, or exciting.

words.ex: He used a pretext to leave the meeting early.
words.ex_cn: 他找了个借口提前离开了会议。
words.en: A pretext is a false reason that you give for doing something, usually something bad, in order to hide the real reason.

words.tr: adj. 悲惨的；不幸的；难过的；恶劣的
words.ex: He felt wretched after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后感到很悲惨。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as wretched, you mean that they are in a very bad or unfortunate situation.

words.ex: The clown amuses the children with funny tricks.
words.ex_cn: 小丑用滑稽的把戏娱乐孩子们。
words.en: If something amuses you, it makes you want to laugh or smile.

words.tr:
adj. 壮丽的；堂皇的；重大的；总的；
n. 大钢琴；
words.ex: The grand castle stood on the hill.
words.ex_cn: 壮丽的城堡矗立在山上。
words.en: If you describe a building or a piece of scenery as grand, you mean that its size or appearance is very impressive.

words.tr:
adj. 古老的；
n. 古董；
words.ex: He bought an antique chair from the old market.
words.ex_cn: 他从旧市场买了一把古老的椅子。
words.en: Something that is antique is old and often valuable because it is rare or well made.

words.ex: The king was sent into exile after the revolution.
words.ex_cn: 革命后，国王被流放了。
words.en: Exile is the state of being sent away from one's home country or place of residence, often for political or punitive reasons.

words.ex: His testimony proved the suspect was innocent.
words.ex_cn: 他的证词证明了嫌疑人是无辜的。
