words.en: A relay is a race between teams in which each team member runs or swims one section of the race. In electronics, a relay is a device that allows a small electrical current to control a larger one.

words.ex: The child was naked in the bathtub.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在浴缸里是裸体的。
words.en: If something is naked, it is not covered by anything such as clothes or paint.

words.tr:
v. 刺；竖起 
n. 刺痛；刺
words.ex: The thorn pricked her finger.
words.ex_cn: 刺扎了她的手指。
words.en: To prick means to make a small hole in something with a sharp point, or to cause a sharp, sudden pain. It can also refer to the act of piercing or the sensation of being pierced.

words.tr: v. 弥补；兑换；付清；赎回；履行
words.ex: He worked hard to redeem his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作来弥补自己的错误。
words.en: To redeem something means to get it back by paying a sum of money or by doing something to compensate for a fault or mistake.

words.tr:
n. 全体演员；
v. 投掷；扔；投射；
words.ex: The cast of the play performed very well.
words.ex_cn: 这部剧的全体演员表演得非常好。
words.en: To cast something means to throw it forcefully in a particular direction.

words.tr:
n. 核；核心；重点；
adj. 核心的；
words.ex: The core of the apple is not edible.
words.ex_cn: 苹果的核心不能吃。
words.en: The central or most important part of something.

words.tr: adj. 陡峭的；急剧升降的；
words.ex: The mountain has a steep path.
words.ex_cn: 这座山有一条陡峭的小路。
words.en: A steep slope or hill is one that is at a sharp angle, rather than being flat or gradual.

words.tr: adj. 秃头的；不加修饰的；赤裸裸的
words.ex: The old man is bald.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人是秃头的。
words.en: Someone who is bald has little or no hair on the top of their head.

words.ex: The rocket's thrust lifted it into the sky.
words.ex_cn: 火箭的推力将它送上了天空。
words.en: To thrust something somewhere means to push it there quickly and forcefully. A thrust is also a powerful push or movement.

words.tr:
n. 保释（金）
v. 保释；（往外）舀水
words.ex: He paid bail to get out of jail.
words.ex_cn: 他交了保释金以便出狱。
words.en: Bail is a sum of money that a person who has been accused of a crime pays to a law court so that they can be released until their trial. The payment is a way of making sure that the accused will return to court for trial.

words.ex: The baker used a metal mold to shape the cake.
words.ex_cn: 面包师用一个金属模具来塑造蛋糕。
words.en: A mold is a hollow container used to give shape to molten or hot liquid material when it cools and hardens. It can also refer to a fungus that grows on food or damp surfaces.

words.ex: The apple's flesh is sweet and juicy.
words.ex_cn: 苹果的果肉又甜又多汁。
words.en: The soft substance consisting of muscle and fat that is found between the skin and bones of an animal or a human.

words.tr:
n. 魔术；魔法；
adj. 魔术（似）的；神奇的；
words.ex: He performed magic at the birthday party.
words.ex_cn: 他在生日聚会上表演了魔术。
words.en: Magic is the power to use supernatural forces to make impossible things happen, such as making people disappear or controlling events in nature.

words.tr: adj. 不足的；欠缺的；微小的；
words.ex: There is scant evidence to support the claim.
words.ex_cn: 支持这一说法的证据不足。
words.en: If you describe something as scant, you mean that there is not enough of it or that it is not as much as it should be.

words.tr:
v. 戳；刺；捅
n. 戳；刺；捅
words.ex: He poked the fire with a stick.
words.ex_cn: 他用一根棍子戳了戳火。
words.en: To poke means to prod or jab someone or something with a finger or a pointed object, or to move something in a particular direction with a sharp movement. It can also refer to the act of making a hole or opening in something by pushing a pointed object into it.

words.ex: The editor abridged the long story for children.
words.ex_cn: 编辑删节了这个长故事，以便适合儿童阅读。
words.en: To abridge a book, play, or other text means to make it shorter by leaving parts out.

words.tr: n. 营业额；人员流动率；周转率；
words.ex: The store's turnover increased last month.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店上个月的营业额增加了。
words.en: The amount of money taken by a business in a particular period.

words.ex: He wore a big grin after winning the game.
words.ex_cn: 他赢得比赛后露出了灿烂的咧嘴笑容。
words.en: If you grin, you smile broadly, usually showing your teeth.

words.ex: The floor is slippery after it rains.
words.ex_cn: 下雨后地板很滑。
words.en: Something that is slippery is smooth, wet, or oily and is therefore difficult to walk on or to hold.

words.ex: He picked up the paddle and rowed the boat.
words.ex_cn: 他拿起桨划船。
words.en: A paddle is a short pole with a wide flat part at one end or both ends, used to move a small boat through water.

words.ex: The needle will pierce the skin.
words.ex_cn: 针会刺穿皮肤。
words.en: If a sharp object pierces something, or if you pierce something with a sharp object, the object goes into it and makes a hole in it.

words.ex: He surmounted his fears to speak in public.
words.ex_cn: 他克服了恐惧，在公众面前发言。
words.en: If you surmount a problem or difficulty, you deal successfully with it.

words.tr:
n. 输入；
v. 输入；
words.ex: The computer needs user input to work.
words.ex_cn: 计算机需要用户输入才能工作。
words.en: Input is information that is put into a system or machine so that it can operate.

words.tr:
n. 回声；
v. 回响；
words.ex: The echo came back from the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 回声从山上反弹回来。
words.en: An echo is a sound which is caused by a noise being reflected off a surface such as a wall.

words.ex: His calm temperament helps him stay peaceful in stress.
words.ex_cn: 他平静的性情让他在压力下保持平和。
words.en: Your temperament is your basic nature, especially as it is shown in the way that you react to situations or to other people.

words.tr: v. 兜售；沿街叫卖； 散播
words.ex: He tries to peddle fake watches on the street.
words.ex_cn: 他试图在街上兜售假手表。
words.en: To peddle goods or ideas means to try to sell them or make them accepted by going from place to place.

words.tr:
v. 交叠；使部分重叠；
n. 重叠部分；
words.ex: The two colors overlap on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 两种颜色在墙上交叠。
words.en: If one thing overlaps another, or if you overlap them, a part of the first thing occupies the same area as a part of the other thing. You can also say that two things overlap.

words.tr: v. 不断骚扰；打扰；侵扰；
words.ex: The neighbors harry the old man with loud music every night.
words.ex_cn: 邻居们每晚用吵闹的音乐不断骚扰那位老人。
words.en: To harry someone means to repeatedly attack them or to cause them problems.

words.tr:
n. 阶段；时期；
v. 分阶段进行；
words.ex: The project is in its final phase.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目正处于最后阶段。
words.en: A phase is a particular stage in a process or in the gradual development of something.

words.ex: The baby suck milk from the bottle.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿从奶瓶里吮吸牛奶。
words.en: To draw something into the mouth by creating a partial vacuum with the lips and tongue; to be very bad or unpleasant.

words.ex: The chair is stationary and does not move.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子是固定的，不会移动。
words.en: not moving or not intended to be moved

words.ex: He pressed the pedal to speed up the bike.
words.ex_cn: 他踩下踏板让自行车加速。
words.en: A pedal is a lever that you press with your foot in order to control a vehicle or machine.

words.ex: The two lines intersect at point A.
words.ex_cn: 两条线在点A相交。
words.en: If two or more lines or roads intersect, they meet or cross each other.

words.tr:
n. 发酵；酵素；动乱
v. （使）发酵；动乱
words.ex: The ferment of yeast makes bread rise.
words.ex_cn: 酵母的发酵使面包膨胀。
words.en: If a substance ferments or if it is fermented, it changes chemically because of the action of yeast or bacteria, often producing alcohol.

words.ex: The health sector needs more funding.
words.ex_cn: 医疗部门需要更多资金。
words.en: A particular area of activity, especially one that is part of a larger area of activity or one that is considered separately from other areas.

words.tr:
v. 舔；（火焰）掠过；克服
n. 舔；少许
words.ex: The dog licks its paw.
words.ex_cn: 狗舔它的爪子。
words.en: To pass the tongue over something; to defeat someone easily.

words.ex: He bought new stationery for school.
words.ex_cn: 他为学校买了新的文具。
words.en: Stationery refers to the materials used for writing, such as paper, pens, and envelopes.

words.ex: They persecute people for their beliefs.
words.ex_cn: 他们因人们的信仰而迫害他们。
words.en: If someone is persecuted, they are treated cruelly and unfairly, often because of their race, religion, or political beliefs.

words.ex: There is a five-minute interval between the two classes.
words.ex_cn: 两节课之间有五分钟的间隔。
words.en: An interval is a period of time between two events or dates.

words.ex: The police intercepted the stolen car.
words.ex_cn: 警察拦截了那辆被盗的汽车。
words.en: If you intercept someone or something that is going from one place to another, you stop them before they get there.

words.ex: This book has five sections.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有五个部分。
words.en: A section of something is one of the parts into which it is divided or from which it is formed.

words.ex: I am grateful for your help.
words.ex_cn: 我感激你的帮助。
words.en: If you are grateful for something that someone has given you or done for you, you have warm, friendly feelings towards them and wish to thank them.

words.ex: He said farewell to his friends before leaving.
words.ex_cn: 他离开前向朋友们道别。
words.en: Farewell is an expression of good wishes at parting, often used to say goodbye.

words.ex: He missed three consecutive days of school.
words.ex_cn: 他连续三天没上学。
words.en: Consecutive events, numbers, etc. follow one after another without an interruption.

words.ex: He sneaked out of the house at night.
words.ex_cn: 他晚上偷偷溜出了房子。
words.en: To move quietly and secretly in order to avoid being noticed.

words.tr: adj. 可触摸的；实际的；有形的；确凿的；
words.ex: The statue is tangible and can be touched.
words.ex_cn: 这座雕像可以触摸，是实实在在的。
words.en: Something that is tangible is clear enough or definite enough to be easily seen, felt, or noticed.

words.tr:
v. 摇摆；摇动；
n. 影响；支配；
words.ex: The tree branches sway in the wind.
words.ex_cn: 树的枝条在风中摇摆。
words.en: To sway means to move slowly or rhythmically backwards and forwards or from side to side. It can also mean to influence someone or something.

words.ex: He showed gratitude for the help.
words.ex_cn: 他表达了对帮助的感激。
words.en: Gratitude is the feeling of being thankful and appreciative.

words.tr: v. 开创；为（某人）举行就职典礼；为…举行开幕仪式
words.ex: The president will inaugurate the new hospital next week.
words.ex_cn: 总统将于下周为新医院举行揭幕仪式。
words.en: If you inaugurate a new system, service, or project, you start it or introduce it officially.

words.ex: I envisage a world without war.
words.ex_cn: 我设想一个没有战争的世界。
words.en: If you envisage something, you imagine that it is true, real, or likely to happen.

words.ex: The door opens on a metal hinge.
words.ex_cn: 这扇门装在一个金属枢纽上。
words.en: A hinge is a piece of metal, wood, or plastic that is used to join two things together so that one of them can swing or move freely.

words.ex: The sun scorch the ground in summer.
words.ex_cn: 夏天阳光灼烧地面。
words.en: To burn the surface of something so as to discolour or damage it.

words.tr:
n. 琐事；少量
v. 玩弄；轻视
words.ex: He threw away a trifle of money on candy.
words.ex_cn: 他花了一点钱买糖果。
words.en: A trifle is something that is considered to have little importance, value, or significance. It can also refer to a small amount of something. As a verb, to trifle means to treat someone or something without seriousness or respect.

words.ex: They rejoice when the sun comes out.
words.ex_cn: 当太阳出来时，他们欢呼。
words.en: To feel or show great joy or delight.

words.ex: He made a pledge to help the poor.
words.ex_cn: 他做出了帮助穷人的保证。
words.en: A pledge is a serious promise or agreement, especially one made publicly or officially. It can also refer to something given as security for the fulfillment of a contract or the payment of a debt.

words.ex: The old wall began to crumble after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 旧墙在雨后开始坍塌。
words.en: If something crumbles, or if you crumble it, it breaks into a lot of small pieces.

words.ex: The hustle of the market filled the morning air.
words.ex_cn: 市场的熙攘充满了清晨的空气。
words.en: If you hustle, you work hard to do something quickly, especially in order to earn money.

words.tr:
n. 烤架；铁格子
v. 烧烤；拷问
words.ex: He cooked the burgers on the grill.
words.ex_cn: 他用烤架烤了汉堡。
words.en: To cook food on a metal frame over a fire, or a metal frame used for cooking food in this way.

words.ex: There's no need to make a fuss about a small mistake.
words.ex_cn: 一个小错误没必要大惊小怪。
words.en: If you make a fuss or kick up a fuss about something, you become angry or excited about it and complain.

words.tr:
n. 螺丝钉；
v. 拧紧；
words.ex: He tightened the screw with a screwdriver.
words.ex_cn: 他用螺丝刀拧紧了螺丝钉。
words.en: A screw is a metal object similar to a nail, with a raised spiral line around it. Screws are used to fasten things together.

words.ex: He swore he didn't steal the money.
words.ex_cn: 他发誓他没有偷钱。
words.en: If someone swears, they use language that is considered to be rude or offensive, usually because they are angry.

words.ex: The government decided to abolish the old law.
words.ex_cn: 政府决定废除这项旧法律。
words.en: If someone in authority abolishes a system or practice, they formally put an end to it.

words.tr:
v. 费力地做；苦干；跋涉
n. 苦工；劳累的工作
words.ex: He toils in the field every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天在田里辛苦劳作。
words.en: If you toil, you work very hard doing something that is difficult or tiring.

words.tr:
v. 钩住；拴住；急拉；搭便车
n. 故障；障碍；勾住；急拉
words.ex: The hook hitched the rope to the tree.
words.ex_cn: 钩子钩住了系在树上的绳子。
words.en: If you hitch, or hitch a ride, you hitchhike. If you hitch something to something else, you fasten it there.

words.tr: v. 设置；放；“set”的现在分词； n. 环境；背景；
words.ex: He is setting the alarm for 6 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 他正在把闹钟设置为早上6点。
words.en: The context and environment in which something is set or takes place.

words.tr: adj. 即将发生（或出版等）的；准备好的；
words.ex: The forthcoming book will be released next month.
words.ex_cn: 即将出版的这本书将在下个月发布。
words.en: If something is forthcoming, it is happening or coming soon.

words.tr:
n. 誓言；誓约
v. 发誓；起誓
words.ex: He made a vow to quit smoking.
words.ex_cn: 他发誓戒烟。
words.en: A vow is a serious promise or decision to do something.

words.tr:
v. （使）纠缠；使陷入；使混乱
n. 纠缠；混乱；纠纷
words.ex: The cat got into a tangle with the yarn.
words.ex_cn: 猫和毛线缠在一起了。
words.en: If something is tangled or tangles, it becomes twisted together in an untidy way.

words.tr:
n. 痛苦；折磨；令人痛苦的东西
v. 折磨；使痛苦；烦扰；纠缠；戏弄
words.ex: The loss of his dog was a deep torment.
words.ex_cn: 失去他的狗是一种深深的痛苦。
words.en: Torment refers to severe physical or mental suffering, or to cause someone to experience such suffering.

words.tr: v. 搭便车旅游；沿途搭乘别人车旅行
words.ex: He wants to hitchhike across the country.
words.ex_cn: 他想搭便车横跨全国。
words.en: To travel by getting free rides from passing vehicles.

words.tr:
v. 使安静；使肃静
n. 安静
words.ex: Please hush, the baby is sleeping.
words.ex_cn: 请安静，宝宝在睡觉。
words.en: If you hush someone or if they hush, they stop speaking or making a noise.

words.tr:
n. 旷野地；荒野；高沼
v. （使）停泊；系泊
words.ex: The sheep graze on the moor near the village.
words.ex_cn: 羊在村庄附近的旷野地上吃草。
words.en: A moor is an area of open land, often with poor soil, that is covered with grass, heather, and low bushes. It can also refer to the act of securing a ship or boat to a fixed object or the land.

words.ex: His legacy includes many charity schools.
words.ex_cn: 他的遗产包括许多慈善学校。
words.en: Something handed down from an ancestor or a predecessor or from the past.

words.tr:
n. 元帅；高级军官；典礼官；消防局长
v. 整理；集结
words.ex: The marshal led the army into battle.
words.ex_cn: 元帅率领军队上战场。
words.en: A marshal is a high-ranking officer in the armed forces, especially in the army or air force, or a person who arranges or directs a public event.

words.tr:
v. 诋毁；诽谤；中伤
n. 诋毁；诽谤；中伤
words.ex: He spread slander about his neighbor.
words.ex_cn: 他散布了关于他邻居的诽谤。
words.en: Slander is the action or crime of making a false spoken statement damaging to a person's reputation.

words.ex: The sponge lives in the ocean and filters water for food.
words.ex_cn: 这种海绵动物生活在海洋中，通过过滤水来获取食物。
words.en: A sponge is a piece of a soft, light, porous substance originally from the skeletons of marine creatures, used for washing, cleaning, or padding. As a verb, it means to wipe, rub, or clean with a sponge or to absorb something.

words.tr: v. 使声音降低；压抑（声音）；蒙住；裹
words.ex: He muffled his laugh with a pillow.
words.ex_cn: 他用枕头捂住笑声。
words.en: To muffle a sound is to make it quieter or less clear, often by covering it or wrapping it in something.

words.ex: The cows graze in the pasture.
words.ex_cn: 牛在牧场上吃草。
words.en: Pasture is land covered with grass where animals such as cows and sheep can graze.

words.ex: The judge will overrule the objection.
words.ex_cn: 法官将驳回这个异议。
words.en: If someone in authority overrules a decision or order, they officially decide that it is wrong and change it.

words.tr:
n. 绷带
v. 用绷带包扎
words.ex: He put a bandage on his cut finger.
words.ex_cn: 他在他割伤的手指上贴了绷带。
words.en: A bandage is a piece of material used to cover a wound or to support an injured part of the body.

words.tr:
v. 涂抹；弄脏；中伤；诽谤
n. 污迹；污渍；丑化；诽谤
words.ex: He smeared butter on the bread.
words.ex_cn: 他在面包上涂抹了黄油。
words.en: To spread a liquid or a thick substance over a surface, or to damage someone's reputation by telling lies about them.

words.tr:
n. 钉；支柱
v. 钉（木桩等）以固定；限定
words.ex: He hung the hat on a peg.
words.ex_cn: 他把帽子挂在了一个钉子上。
words.en: A peg is a small device, usually made of wood or metal, that is used to fasten things or to hang things on.

words.ex: A shudder ran through her when she saw the snake.
words.ex_cn: 当她看到蛇时，全身战栗了一下。
words.en: If you shudder, you shake with fear, horror, or disgust, or because you are cold.

words.ex: The hikers walked through a deep gorge.
words.ex_cn: 徒步者走过一个深峡谷。
words.en: A gorge is a deep, narrow valley with steep sides, often carved by a river. It can also refer to the act of eating greedily.

words.tr:
n. 一条（面包）
v. 游荡；虚度光阴
words.ex: He bought a loaf of bread from the bakery.
words.ex_cn: 他从面包店买了一条面包。
words.en: A loaf is a quantity of bread that is shaped and baked in one piece and usually sliced before being eaten. As a verb, to loaf means to spend time in a lazy way, doing nothing in particular.

words.ex: The workers used dynamite to break the rocks.
words.ex_cn: 工人们使用炸药来炸开岩石。
words.en: Dynamite is a type of explosive that is used in mining and construction. It is also used metaphorically to describe something that is highly effective or potentially dangerous.

words.ex: A hawk flew over the field.
words.ex_cn: 一只鹰飞过田野。
words.en: A hawk is a bird of prey with a strong beak and sharp claws, known for its keen vision and swift flight. As a verb, to hawk means to sell goods aggressively, often in public places.

words.ex: The old mill stands by the river.
words.ex_cn: 旧磨坊坐落在河边。
words.en: A mill is a building in which grain is crushed to make flour. It can also refer to a factory where certain materials are processed or manufactured.

words.tr:
v. （使）发痒；胳肢；逗乐
n. 痒；胳肢；呵痒
words.ex: The feather tickles my arm.
words.ex_cn: 羽毛挠得我手臂发痒。
words.en: If something tickles you, it touches you in a way that makes you laugh or feel slightly uncomfortable, usually because it is touching a sensitive part of your body. If something tickles you, it also makes you feel amused or pleased.

words.tr: v. 使复活；使苏醒；使有生气；使恢复精神
words.ex: The old song revivifies my memories.
words.ex_cn: 那首老歌唤起了我的回忆。
words.en: To bring something back to life, to make it lively or vigorous again.

words.tr:
n. 薄片；小片
v. 使成薄片；（成小薄片）脱落
words.ex: A flake fell from the ceiling.
words.ex_cn: 一片碎屑从天花板上掉了下来。
words.en: A flake is a small, thin piece of something that has broken off from a larger piece, or a person who is considered unreliable or eccentric.

words.tr: v. 参军；入伍；谋求（某人的帮助）
words.ex: He wants to enlist in the army.
words.ex_cn: 他想参军。
words.en: To enlist means to join the military, or to get someone else to join the military. It can also mean to get support or help from someone for a particular purpose.

words.tr:
n. 雄鹿；公羊；雄兔；美元
v. （马等）猛然弓背跃起；抵制
words.ex: The buck ran through the forest.
words.ex_cn: 雄鹿在森林中奔跑。
words.en: A buck is a male deer, antelope, rabbit, or hare. It can also refer to a dollar in American slang. As a verb, it means to jump or to resist something.

words.ex: He scooped soup with a spoon.
words.ex_cn: 他用勺子舀汤。
words.en: A scoop is a tool like a large spoon which is used for picking up substances such as ice cream or an amount of a substance that is held in a scoop. It can also refer to an important or exciting news story that is reported in a newspaper, magazine, or news broadcast before anyone else reports it.

words.tr:
n. 浮标；浮筒
v. 使浮起；支撑；鼓励
words.ex: The buoy floats on the water.
words.ex_cn: 浮标漂浮在水面上。
words.en: A buoy is a floating object that is anchored in water to mark a location, warn of danger, or indicate a navigational channel.

words.ex: The city plan will revitalize the old town.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市计划将使老城区复兴。
words.en: To revitalize something means to give it new life or energy.

words.ex: She added a mint leaf to her drink.
words.ex_cn: 她在饮料里加了一片薄荷叶。
words.en: Mint is a plant with fresh-tasting leaves. It is also the place where coins are made, or the act of making coins.

words.tr:
n. 小规模战斗；小争斗；小冲突
v. 进行一场小冲突
words.ex: The two boys had a small skirmish over the ball.
words.ex_cn: 两个男孩为了球发生了一场小冲突。
words.en: A skirmish is a minor battle or fight, often one that is part of a larger conflict.

words.ex: A bug crawled on the leaf.
words.ex_cn: 一只小虫子爬在叶子上。
words.en: A bug is a small insect, or it can refer to a fault in a computer program or system.

words.ex: They unearthed an old coin in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 他们在花园里挖出了一枚旧硬币。
words.en: To unearth something means to find it by digging in the ground or to discover something that was hidden or unknown.

words.tr:
v. 使发昏；使迷乱
n. 恍惚； 晕眩
words.ex: The loud noise dazed him for a moment.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音让他一时发昏。
words.en: If someone is in a daze, they are feeling confused and unable to think clearly, often because they have had a shock or surprise.

words.tr: v. （使）变直；（使）变平；（使）变整齐；
words.ex: He straightened the crooked picture on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他把墙上歪斜的画扶直了。
words.en: To make something straight or to put something in order.

words.ex: She ate a prune for a healthy snack.
words.ex_cn: 她吃了一颗梅干作为健康零食。
words.en: To prune means to cut off some of the branches of a tree or bush to make it grow better. It can also mean to reduce the extent of something by removing superfluous or unwanted parts.

words.tr:
n. 定量；配给量
v. 配给；定量供应
words.ex: He gets a small ration of food each day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天得到少量的食物配给。
words.en: A ration is a fixed amount of something such as food or fuel that is officially allowed to each person, especially when there is not enough of it available.

words.tr:
n. 半身像；胸部；搜捕
v. 打碎；搜捕
adj. 破产的；打碎的
words.ex: The museum has a marble bust of the ancient king.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆里有一座古代国王的大理石半身像。
words.en: A bust is a sculpture of a person's head, shoulders, and chest. As a verb, to bust means to break something, to arrest someone, or to go bankrupt.

words.tr:
n. 摊位；
v. 故意拖延；
words.ex: He sells fruits at a stall in the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场的一个摊位上卖水果。
words.en: A stall is a small open-fronted shop or a compartment for one animal in a stable or barn. As a verb, it means to stop or cause to stop making progress.

words.tr: v. 砰地关上；猛地一动；抨击
words.ex: He slammed the door angrily.
words.ex_cn: 他生气地把门砰地关上。
words.en: If you slam a door or window, or if it slams, it shuts noisily and with great force.

words.ex: He read the preface before starting the book.
words.ex_cn: 他在开始读这本书之前读了序言。
words.en: A preface is an introduction at the beginning of a book, which explains what the book is about or why it was written.

words.ex: The lemon tastes sour.
words.ex_cn: 这个柠檬尝起来是酸的。
words.en: Having a sharp, acidic taste; not sweet.

words.ex: We had dinner at a buffet with many dishes to choose from.
words.ex_cn: 我们在自助餐吃了晚饭，有很多菜可以选。
words.en: A buffet is a meal consisting of several dishes from which guests serve themselves. As a verb, to buffet means to strike repeatedly and violently.

words.tr:
n. 毛孔；小孔
v. 细看；钻研；凝视
words.ex: Sweat comes out through the pores of the skin.
words.ex_cn: 汗水通过皮肤上的毛孔排出。
words.en: A pore is a tiny opening in a surface that allows liquids or gases to pass through. As a verb, to pore means to read or study something very carefully.

words.ex: The roof has a sharp slant.
words.ex_cn: 屋顶有一个陡峭的倾斜。
words.en: If something slants or if you slant it, it is at an angle rather than being straight up and down or straight from side to side.

words.ex: The factory buys lumber to make furniture.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂购买木材来制造家具。
words.en: Lumber refers to wood that has been processed into beams and planks, a stage in the process of wood production. It is also used to describe the action of moving in a slow, heavy, awkward way.

words.tr:
n. 编年史；年代记
v. 按时间顺序记录
words.ex: He writes a chronicle of his daily life.
words.ex_cn: 他记录自己每天的生活。
words.en: A chronicle is a historical account of events arranged in chronological order, typically without analysis or interpretation.

words.ex: He caught a crab at the beach.
words.ex_cn: 他在海滩上抓到一只蟹。
words.en: A crab is a sea creature with a flat round body covered by a shell, and five pairs of legs with large claws on the front pair. Crabs usually move sideways.

words.tr:
v. 避开；躲避
n. 躲避；诡计
words.ex: He dodged the ball quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速躲开了球。
words.en: If you dodge, you move quickly, often to avoid being hit, caught, or seen.

words.ex: The doctor checked the vein in his arm.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了他手臂上的静脉。
words.en: A vein is a tube in your body that carries blood towards your heart. It can also refer to a thin layer of a mineral in rock, or a particular style or mood in writing or speech.

words.tr:
n. 冲天火箭
v. 剧增；猛涨；猛升
words.ex: The price of housing skyrocketed last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年房价急剧上涨。
words.en: To increase very quickly and suddenly.

words.ex: He engraves his name on the ring.
words.ex_cn: 他把名字刻在戒指上。
words.en: To engrave means to cut or carve a design or letters into a hard surface, or to be strongly impressed in someone's memory.

words.tr: adj. 讽刺的；嘲讽的；挖苦的
words.ex: He gave a sarcastic laugh when she said she was perfect.
words.ex_cn: 当她说自己完美时，他讽刺地笑了一声。
words.en: If you describe someone as sarcastic, you mean that they are inclined to say things which are the opposite of what they really mean, especially in order to mock or insult someone.

words.ex: The fish spawn in the river each spring.
words.ex_cn: 鱼每年春天在河里产卵。
words.en: To spawn means to produce or deposit eggs, especially in large quantities, as fish, frogs, etc. do. It can also mean to give rise to or generate something.

words.ex: The police tried to subdue the angry man.
words.ex_cn: 警察试图制服那个愤怒的人。
words.en: To subdue someone or something means to bring them under control by using force or persuasion.

words.ex: The tree produces a sticky gum.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树分泌出一种粘稠的树胶。
words.en: Gum refers to the firm area of flesh in the mouth to which the teeth are attached, or a type of sweet, flavored, synthetic rubber which is chewed for pleasure.

words.tr:
n. 晒成棕褐色的肤色
adj. 棕褐色的；棕黄色的
v. 将皮肤晒成棕褐色
words.ex: He has a deep tan after spending the week at the beach.
words.ex_cn: 他在海滩度过一周后，皮肤晒成了深棕色。
words.en: If you tan, or if the sun tans you, your skin becomes darker because you spend time in the sun.

words.tr:
v. 摘；拔；猛拉；拨弹
n. 胆识；胆量；快而猛地拉
words.ex: He plucked a flower from the garden.
words.ex_cn: 他从花园里摘了一朵花。
words.en: To pluck means to pull something quickly to remove it or to play a musical instrument by pulling the strings with your fingers. As a noun, it refers to the quality of being brave and determined.

words.ex: The movie is a satire about politicians.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影是一部关于政治家的讽刺作品。
words.en: A way of criticizing people or ideas in a humorous way, especially in order to make a political point, or a piece of writing that uses this style.

words.tr:
n. 之字形；锯齿形；
adj. 之字形的；曲折的；锯齿形的；
words.ex: The road makes a zigzag up the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 这条路沿着山呈之字形向上延伸。
words.en: A zigzag is a line that has a series of angles in it, like a continuous series of 'W's. It can also describe a path or route that proceeds by sharp turns in alternating directions.

words.ex: The house has a small annex for storage.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子有一个用于存放物品的小附属物。
words.en: To annex means to take control of a country, region, etc., especially by force; to add an area or region to a country, state, etc. : to take control of (a territory or place).

words.tr: n. 一圈；（人坐着时）大腿部；
words.ex: He ran three laps around the track.
words.ex_cn: 他在跑道上跑了三圈。
words.en: The upper part of the legs of a seated person; a single turn or round in a race or other competition.

words.ex: He has a streak of kindness that makes everyone like him.
words.ex_cn: 他有一种善良的性情，让每个人都喜欢他。
words.en: A streak is a long thin mark that is a different colour from the surfaces next to it. It can also refer to a period of time during which a particular kind of behaviour or activity is consistently shown.

words.tr:
v. 虚张声势；唬人
n. 虚张声势；吓唬；峭壁
adj. 直率的
words.ex: He used a bluff to win the game.
words.ex_cn: 他用虚张声势赢得了比赛。
words.en: If you bluff, you try to make someone believe that you will do something when you do not really intend to do it, or that you know something when you do not really know it.

words.tr:
v. 给…打钩；发出滴嗒声；
n. 钩号；
words.ex: Please tick the box if you agree.
words.ex_cn: 如果你同意，请在方框里打钩。
words.en: The word 'tick' can refer to the sound a clock makes, a very short period of time, a mark used to indicate something, or a type of small insect. As a verb, it can mean to make a ticking sound or to mark something with a tick.

words.ex: He drew a dot on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在纸上画了一个小圆点。
words.en: A dot is a very small round mark, for example one that is used as the top part of the letter 'i', as a full stop, or as a decimal point.

words.ex: Please vacate the room by noon.
words.ex_cn: 请在中午前腾出房间。
words.en: To vacate a place or position means to leave it or give it up, making it available for other people.

words.ex: The children played in the grit near the road.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在路边的沙砾中玩耍。
words.en: Grit is very small pieces of stone. It is often used to make surfaces less slippery. Grit is also a quality of character that enables someone to continue with determination in the face of difficulties.

words.ex: He puffed after running up the stairs.
words.ex_cn: 他跑上楼梯后喘着气。
words.en: If you puff, you breathe in and out quickly and with force, for example because you have been running or because you are out of breath. A puff of something such as air or smoke is a small amount of it that is blown out from somewhere.

words.ex: The company hired an expert to do an audit.
words.ex_cn: 公司聘请了一位专家进行审计。
words.en: An audit is an official examination of the accounts of a business or organization to check that they are accurate and correct.

words.tr:
n. 边；边缘；帽边
v. （装）满；（使）溢出
words.ex: The cup is full to the brim.
words.ex_cn: 杯子装得满满的。
words.en: The top edge of a container or the projecting edge of a hat.

words.ex: The soldier was spying on the enemy camp at night.
words.ex_cn: 这名士兵在夜间秘密侦察敌军营地。
words.en: A spy is a person who secretly collects and reports information about the activities, movements, and plans of an enemy or competitor.

words.ex: The herald announced the king's arrival.
words.ex_cn: 传令官宣布了国王的到来。
words.en: A herald is someone who carries or proclaims important news; a forerunner or harbinger.

words.ex: The teacher gave students discretion to choose their own topic.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了学生自行选择题目的权利。
words.en: Discretion is the quality of behaving in a quiet and controlled way without drawing attention to yourself or giving away personal or private information.

words.tr:
v. 使融解；解冻；变缓和
n. 融雪
words.ex: The ice begins to thaw in spring.
words.ex_cn: 冰在春天开始融化。
words.en: If ice, snow, or something else that is frozen thaws, it melts. A thaw is a period of warmer weather when snow and ice melt, usually at the end of winter.

words.tr:
n. 禁止贸易令；禁运
v. 禁止…的贸易；禁运
words.ex: The country placed an embargo on imported goods.
words.ex_cn: 该国对进口商品实施了禁运。
words.en: An embargo is an official order to stop trade with another country.

words.ex: He skipped the hard question and moved to the next one.
words.ex_cn: 他略过了难题，继续做下一题。
words.en: To move lightly and quickly, making a small jump after each step.

words.tr:
n. 箔；陪衬物
v. 阻止；挫败
words.ex: He used foil to wrap the sandwich.
words.ex_cn: 他用锡纸包住了三明治。
words.en: To prevent someone from succeeding in their plans or intentions, especially by doing something clever or unexpected.

words.tr:
n. 人群；一大群；众多
v. 群集；挤满；涌进
words.ex: A throng of people waited outside the store.
words.ex_cn: 一大群人站在商店外面等候。
words.en: A large, densely packed crowd of people or animals.

words.tr: v. 恢复；修复；改造（罪犯）
words.ex: The hospital will rehabilitate the injured athlete.
words.ex_cn: 医院将帮助受伤的运动员康复。
words.en: To rehabilitate someone who has been ill or in prison means to help them to live a normal life again. To rehabilitate a building or an area means to improve its condition.

words.tr:
v. （使）成波浪状；（使）起涟漪；作潺潺声 
n. 微波；涟漪；潺潺声
words.ex: The wind ripples the surface of the lake.
words.ex_cn: 风使湖面泛起波浪。
words.en: If something ripples, it moves in small waves or if you ripple it, you make it move in small waves.

words.ex: The ship arrived at the dock at sunrise.
words.ex_cn: 船在日出时到达了码头。
words.en: A dock is an enclosed area of water in a port where ships go to be loaded, unloaded, and repaired.

words.tr:
v. （使）突然移动；快速投掷；
n. 镖；
words.ex: The cat darted across the room.
words.ex_cn: 猫突然冲过房间。
words.en: A dart is a small, narrow object with a sharp point which can be thrown or shot. It can also mean to move suddenly and quickly in a particular direction.

words.tr:
v. 掠夺；抢劫
n. 掠夺物；掠夺；赃物
words.ex: The pirates plundered the ship.
words.ex_cn: 海盗劫掠了那艘船。
words.en: If someone plunders a place or plunders things from a place, they steal things from it.

words.tr:
n. 流浪汉；流浪乞丐；徒步旅行
v. 步行；踩；踏
words.ex: The old tramp slept on the park bench.
words.ex_cn: 那个老流浪汉睡在公园的长椅上。
words.en: If you tramp somewhere, you walk there slowly and with regular, heavy steps, especially for a long time.

words.ex: The roof is made of slate.
words.ex_cn: 屋顶是由板岩制成的。
words.en: A slate is a fine-grained, foliated, homogeneous metamorphic rock derived from an original shale-type sedimentary rock composed of clay or volcanic ash through low-grade regional metamorphism. It is the finest grained foliated metamorphic rock. Foliation may not correspond to the original sedimentary layering, but instead is in planes perpendicular to the direction of metamorphic compression.

words.tr:
v. 闪耀；闪烁
n. 闪烁
words.ex: The stars twinkle in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 星星在夜空中闪烁。
words.en: If a star or a light twinkles, it shines with an unsteady light that rapidly and gently changes from bright to faint.

words.tr: v. 废除；取消；宣告无效
words.ex: The court will annul the marriage.
words.ex_cn: 法院将宣布婚姻无效。
words.en: To annul something means to declare it invalid or to officially say that it no longer exists.

words.ex: The queen wore a golden crown on her head.
words.ex_cn: 女王头上戴着一顶金皇冠。
words.en: A crown is a circular ornament, usually made of gold and jewels, which a king or queen wears on their head at official ceremonies. It can also refer to the top part of something, such as a tooth or a hill, or to the act of making someone a king or queen by placing a crown on their head.

words.tr:
n. 手铐；思想上的桎梏
v. 用手铐铐住（某人）；把（某人）铐在（某物、某人）上；限制
words.ex: The police put handcuff on the thief.
words.ex_cn: 警察给小偷戴上了手铐。
words.en: A handcuff is a pair of lockable linked metal rings for securing a prisoner's wrists.

words.ex: He tied a knot in the rope.
words.ex_cn: 他在绳子上打了一个结。
words.en: A knot is a fastening made by tying a piece of string, rope, or something similar. It can also refer to a hard mass formed in a tree trunk at the intersection with a branch, or a unit of speed equal to one nautical mile per hour, used especially by ships and aircraft.

words.ex: The palm tree grows near the beach.
words.ex_cn: 棕榈树长在海滩附近。
words.en: The inner surface of the hand that extends from the wrist to the base of the fingers; also refers to the tropical tree with large divided leaves.

words.ex: There is little intercourse between the two villages.
words.ex_cn: 这两个村庄之间很少交往。
words.en: Intercourse refers to communication or dealings between individuals or groups, or sexual activity between people.

words.tr: n. 美容院；美发厅；沙龙
words.ex: She goes to the salon to get her hair cut.
words.ex_cn: 她去理发店剪头发。
words.en: A salon is a gathering of people under the roof of an inspiring host, held partly to amuse one another and partly to refine the taste and increase the knowledge of the participants through conversation.

words.ex: They had a big banquet after the wedding.
words.ex_cn: 婚礼后他们举办了一场盛大的宴会。
words.en: A banquet is a large formal meal for many people, often followed by speeches in honor of someone.

words.ex: We went to the carnival last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周末去了嘉年华。
words.en: A carnival is a public festival, typically one held annually in a particular place, involving processions, music, and dancing.

words.ex: They shook hands with a firm handshake.
words.ex_cn: 他们以坚定的握手示意友好。
words.en: A handshake is a gesture in which two people grasp one of each other's like hands, in most cases accompanied by a brief up and down movement of the grasped hands.

words.ex: His dog gave him constant companionship.
words.ex_cn: 他的狗给了他不断的陪伴。
words.en: the state of being with someone or having someone to spend time with

words.ex: The door is a gateway to the garden.
words.ex_cn: 这扇门是通往花园的通道。
words.en: A gateway is an entrance or a means of access to a place.

words.tr:
adj. 中途的；中间的
adv. 中途地；中间地
n. 娱乐场；游乐场
words.ex: He stopped midway to rest.
words.ex_cn: 他中途停下来休息。
words.en: Midway is used to describe something that is in the middle of a place or a period of time.

words.ex: He stopped halfway to rest.
words.ex_cn: 他在半路停下来休息。
words.en: At or to a point midway between two others.

words.tr: phrase. 与某人妥协；各让一步；迁就对方
words.ex: If you want to solve the problem, you have to meet someone halfway.
words.ex_cn: 如果你想解决问题，就得和别人各让一步。
words.en: To meet someone halfway means to compromise or make a concession in order to reach an agreement or resolve a disagreement.

words.ex: He lives in a far-off village.
words.ex_cn: 他住在遥远的村庄里。
words.en: Far-off is used to describe something that is a long distance away or a long time in the past or future.

words.tr: adj. 洲际的；洲与洲之间的
words.ex: He flew on an intercontinental flight to New York.
words.ex_cn: 他乘坐了一趟洲际航班前往纽约。
words.en: An intercontinental activity or service involves going from one continent to another.

words.ex: The invention of the wheel was a landmark in human history.
words.ex_cn: 轮子的发明是人类历史上的一个里程碑。
words.en: A landmark is a building or feature of a landscape that is easily seen and recognized from a distance, especially one that enables someone to establish their location.

words.ex: Graduating from high school was a big milestone for him.
words.ex_cn: 从高中毕业对他来说是一个重要的事件。
words.en: A milestone is a significant event or stage in the development of something.

words.ex: Education is the cornerstone of a strong society.
words.ex_cn: 教育是强大社会的基石。
words.en: A cornerstone is an important quality or feature on which a particular thing depends or is based.

words.tr: n. 基础；基本原理；根基
words.ex: The company laid the groundwork for future expansion.
words.ex_cn: 公司为未来的扩展打下了基础。
words.en: The groundwork is the preparation that is necessary before something can be done or begun.

words.tr:
n. 离别；分别；分界线；分界处
adj. 离别时的；逝去的
v. 分离；分开；“part”的现在分词
words.ex: He said goodbye with a sad parting smile.
words.ex_cn: 他带着悲伤的告别微笑说了再见。
words.en: The act of leaving or separating from someone or something.

words.tr: n. 分水岭；集水区；转折点
words.ex: The river forms a watershed between two valleys.
words.ex_cn: 这条河构成了两个山谷之间的分水岭。
words.en: A watershed is an event or period that is important because it represents a big change in how people do or think about something.

words.ex: He stepped fro from the door.
words.ex_cn: 他向后退了一步。
words.en: 'Fro' is used to indicate movement back and forth or from one place to another.

words.ex: The pendulum moves to and fro.
words.ex_cn: 钟摆来回摆动。
words.en: Moving repeatedly from one place to another and back again.

words.tr:
adj. 在前的
adv. 在前面
n. 前头
words.ex: The fore part of the ship is strong.
words.ex_cn: 船的前部很坚固。
words.en: situated or placed in front; the front part of something

words.ex: The foregoing example shows the problem clearly.
words.ex_cn: 上述例子清楚地展示了这个问题。
words.en: You use foregoing to refer to something that has just been mentioned or described.

words.tr:
adv. 向下地；
adj. 向下的；
words.ex: The leaves fell downward slowly.
words.ex_cn: 树叶慢慢向下飘落。
words.en: Moving or leading towards a lower place or level

words.ex: He walked forth to meet the sun.
words.ex_cn: 他向前走去迎接太阳。
words.en: Forward in time, place, or order; onward.

words.ex: The underside of the table is dirty.
words.ex_cn: 桌子的下侧很脏。
words.en: The underside of something is the part of it which normally faces towards the ground or is not normally seen.

words.tr: adv. （用以询问大概的地方）在什么地方；
words.ex: I don't know his whereabouts.
words.ex_cn: 我不知道他在什么地方。
words.en: The place where someone or something is.

words.ex: He walked onwards without stopping.
words.ex_cn: 他不停地向前走。
words.en: If something happens from a particular time onwards or onward, it begins to happen at that time and continues to happen afterward.

words.tr:
adv. 顺时针方向地
adj. 顺时针方向的
words.ex: Turn the knob clockwise to open the jar.
words.ex_cn: 顺时针转动旋钮来打开罐子。
words.en: Moving in the same direction as the hands of a clock.

words.ex: The hind legs of the dog are stronger than the front ones.
words.ex_cn: 狗的后腿比前腿更强壮。
words.en: Located at or forming the back or rear of something.

words.tr: phrase. （尤指为演讲、辩论或抗议而）站着；起身发言；奋起反对
words.ex: The protesters stood on their hind legs to shout their demands.
words.ex_cn: 抗议者站着喊出他们的要求。
words.en: phrase. To stand up on one's hind legs, typically used to describe an animal standing or a person standing up to speak or protest.

words.tr: adv. 直角地；径直地；公平地；直接了当
words.ex: He stood squarely in front of the door.
words.ex_cn: 他直角地站在门前面。
words.en: If something is squarely placed or aimed, it is placed or aimed directly at something.

words.tr:
adj. 正面的；迎头的；头朝前的
adv. 正面地；迎头；头朝前地
words.ex: They had a head-on collision between two cars.
words.ex_cn: 两辆车发生了正面碰撞。
words.en: If two vehicles collide head-on, they hit each other directly from the front.

words.ex: The mirror deflects the light to the wall.
words.ex_cn: 镜子把光线反射到墙上。
words.en: If you deflect something such as criticism or attention, you act in a way that prevents it from being directed towards you or affecting you.

words.ex: The cave paintings are prehistoric.
words.ex_cn: 这些洞穴壁画是史前的。
words.en: Belonging to or existing in times before recorded history.

words.ex: The castle is a medieval building.
words.ex_cn: 这座城堡是一座中世纪的建筑。
words.en: Relating to the Middle Ages, the period in European history from about the 5th century to the 15th century.

words.ex: The millennium began in the year 2000.
words.ex_cn: 一千年始于2000年。
words.en: A millennium is a period of one thousand years.

words.ex: The invention of the internet changed our era.
words.ex_cn: 互联网的发明改变了我们的时代。
words.en: An era is a period of time that is considered as a single unit because of a particular characteristic or event.

words.ex: Hitherto, no one has solved the problem.
words.ex_cn: 迄今为止，没有人解决过这个问题。
words.en: Until now or until the point in time under discussion.

words.tr:
adv. 在夜里；突然；
adj. 整晚的；
words.ex: The baby slept overnight in the crib.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿整夜睡在小床上。
words.en: If something happens overnight, it happens during the night or for the period of one night. It can also mean happening very quickly or suddenly.

words.ex: The birds sing at daybreak.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在黎明时鸣叫。
words.en: The time in the morning when light first appears; dawn.

words.tr: n. 黄昏；薄暮；暮光；衰退期
words.ex: The birds fly home at twilight.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在黄昏时飞回家。
words.en: The time of day immediately following sunset, or the period of time at the end of the day when the sun is just below the horizon, especially the period between sunset and dark.

words.ex: The birds flew home at dusk.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在黄昏时飞回家。
words.en: Dusk is the time just before night when the daylight has almost gone but when it is not completely dark.

words.ex: He will arrive shortly.
words.ex_cn: 他不久就会到。
words.en: In a short time; soon.

words.tr: phrase. 简而言之；长话短说
words.ex: Put it shortly, we need more time.
words.ex_cn: 简而言之，我们需要更多时间。
words.en: To express something in a brief and concise manner.

words.tr: n. 时间表；时刻表；课程表；
words.ex: The school publishes a new timetable every term.
words.ex_cn: 学校每学期都会公布新的时间表。
words.en: A timetable is a detailed plan showing the times at which things are intended to happen, especially the times at which particular events or activities are planned to occur.

words.ex: The closure of the store was sudden.
words.ex_cn: 商店的关闭很突然。
words.en: The act of closing something, or the state of being closed.

words.ex: He duly submitted his homework on time.
words.ex_cn: 他适时地按时交了作业。
words.en: If something is duly done, it is done in the correct way or at the correct time; properly.

words.ex: The storm caused disastrous damage to the village.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴给村庄造成了灾难性的破坏。
words.en: If you describe something as disastrous, you mean that it is very unfortunate or unsuccessful.

words.ex: The pig eats from the wooden trough.
words.ex_cn: 猪从木槽里吃东西。
words.en: A long, narrow open container for animals to eat or drink from; a period of low economic activity.

words.ex: The drought made it hard to grow crops.
words.ex_cn: 旱灾使种植庄稼变得困难。
words.en: A drought is a long period of time during which no rain falls and hence there is a shortage of water.

words.ex: The village suffered from famine last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年这个村庄遭受了饥荒。
words.en: A famine is a serious shortage of food in a country, which may cause many people to get sick or die.

words.ex: The tornado destroyed the small house.
words.ex_cn: 龙卷风摧毁了那座小房子。
words.en: A tornado is a violent windstorm characterized by a twisting, funnel-shaped cloud.

words.ex: The gale knocked down several trees.
words.ex_cn: 大风刮倒了几棵树。
words.en: A gale is a very strong wind.

words.tr:
n. 一阵狂风；突然的一阵
v. （风）猛刮
words.ex: A sudden gust blew the hat off his head.
words.ex_cn: 一阵突然的风把他的帽子吹掉了。
words.en: A gust is a sudden, strong rush of wind.

words.ex: The headwind made the journey much longer than expected.
words.ex_cn: 逆风使得旅程比预期要长得多。
words.en: A headwind is a wind that blows directly against the direction in which you are moving, making it more difficult to move forward.

words.ex: The cyclone destroyed many houses near the coast.
words.ex_cn: 气旋摧毁了沿海的许多房屋。
words.en: A cyclone is a violent tropical storm in which the air goes round and round.

words.ex: Applications arrived in an avalanche after the job posting.
words.ex_cn: 职位发布后，申请纷至沓来。
words.en: An avalanche is a large mass of snow, ice, and rocks that falls quickly down the side of a mountain.

words.ex: The mechanic tightened the bolt with a wrench.
words.ex_cn: 机械师用扳手拧紧了螺栓。
words.en: A bolt is a type of fastener consisting of a threaded pin or rod with a head at one end, designed to be inserted through holes in assembled parts and tightened by a nut from the other end. It can also refer to a sudden dash or run, or to eat food quickly and without chewing.

words.tr: 短语，意为“突如其来的打击或事件”，常用于比喻突然发生的灾难或意外，如“a bolt from the blue”意为“晴天霹雳”
words.ex: The news was a bolt from the blue.
words.ex_cn: 这个消息像晴天霹雳。
words.en: A sudden and unexpected event or piece of news.

words.tr: phrase. 出乎意料地；突然地；晴天霹雳般地
words.ex: She called me out of the blue yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 她昨天突然给我打了电话。
words.en: If something happens out of the blue, it happens unexpectedly.

words.ex: The lightning struck the tree last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚闪电击中了那棵树。
words.en: A flash of light in the sky caused by the discharge of atmospheric electricity from one cloud to another or between a cloud and the earth.

words.ex: There was frost on the grass this morning.
words.ex_cn: 今天早上草地上有霜。
words.en: A thin layer of ice that forms on surfaces when the temperature drops below freezing.

words.tr:
n. 雨夹雪
v. 下雨夹雪；下冰雹
words.ex: The road was slippery after a night of sleet.
words.ex_cn: 经过一夜的冻雨，路面变得很滑。
words.en: Sleet is a form of precipitation consisting of ice pellets, often mixed with rain or snow.

words.tr:
n. 雪橇；大锤
v. 乘雪橇；用大锤敲打
words.ex: The children rode on a sledge down the snowy hill.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们坐在雪橇上滑下雪坡。
words.en: A sledge is a vehicle that is used for traveling over snow and ice. It is typically pulled by animals or a motor.

words.tr:
n. 雪橇
v. 乘雪橇
words.ex: The children enjoyed riding on the sleigh.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢乘雪橇。
words.en: A sleigh is a vehicle which slides over snow, usually pulled by a horse.

words.ex: He likes to ski in the mountains during winter.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在冬天去山里滑雪。
words.en: A ski is one of a pair of long, flat runners attached to the feet for gliding over snow. Skiing is the activity of gliding over snow on skis.

words.tr:
adj. 南极的；
n. 南极地区；
words.ex: The antarctic ice is melting fast.
words.ex_cn: 南极的冰正在迅速融化。
words.en: The Antarctic is the area around the South Pole, characterized by its cold climate and ice-covered landscapes.

words.tr:
n. 北极地区；
adj. 北极的；
words.ex: Polar bears live in the arctic.
words.ex_cn: 北极熊生活在北极地区。
words.en: The Arctic is the area around the Earth's North Pole, characterized by cold temperatures and ice.

words.tr:
adj. 零下的；负的；
n. 缺点；
prep. 减去；
words.ex: The temperature is minus ten degrees Celsius.
words.ex_cn: 气温是零下十摄氏度。
words.en: A minus is a mathematical symbol that represents subtraction or a negative quantity.

words.ex: The iceberg is floating in the cold sea.
words.ex_cn: 冰山在寒冷的海面上漂浮。
words.en: An iceberg is a large piece of ice that has broken off from a glacier and is floating in the sea.

words.ex: The glacier moves slowly down the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 冰川缓慢地沿着山向下移动。
words.en: A glacier is a large, persistent body of ice that forms where the accumulation of snow exceeds its ablation over many years, often centuries.

words.ex: The volcano erupted last year.
words.ex_cn: 这座火山去年喷发了。
words.en: A volcano is a mountain that opens downward to a pool of molten rock below the surface of the earth. When pressure builds up, eruptions occur.

words.ex: The volcano spilled hot lava down the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 火山喷出炽热的岩浆流下山。
words.en: Lava is the molten rock that comes out of a volcano during an eruption.

words.tr: adj. 烧红的；炽热的；激烈的；近期的
words.ex: The iron was red-hot after the fire.
words.ex_cn: 铁在火后烧红了。
words.en: If something is red-hot, it is extremely hot, either in temperature or in enthusiasm and excitement.

words.tr: n. 裂口；深坑；显著差别
words.ex: The earthquake created a deep chasm in the ground.
words.ex_cn: 地震在地面上造成了一道深深的裂口。
words.en: A chasm is a very deep, narrow opening in rock, ice, or the ground.

words.tr: n. 晒黑；日晒后的肤色；晒黑的肤色；
words.ex: He got a suntan after spending the day at the beach.
words.ex_cn: 他在海滩上度过一天后晒黑了。
words.en: A suntan is the brown colour that someone with pale skin goes after they have been in the sun.

words.tr:
n. 日灼；晒伤
v. 晒黑；晒伤
words.ex: He got sunburn after swimming all day.
words.ex_cn: 他整天游泳后得了日灼。
words.en: Sunburn is a condition where the skin becomes red, sore, and sometimes swollen and blistered as a result of overexposure to the ultraviolet rays of the sun.

words.ex: The rain teemed down all night.
words.ex_cn: 雨整晚倾泻而下。
words.en: If a place teems with people, animals, or things, it is full of them and they are all moving around.

words.ex: The king's greed led to his downfall.
words.ex_cn: 国王的贪婪导致了他的没落。
words.en: The collapse of a person or organization's power, status, or success.

words.ex: The downpour soaked everyone outside.
words.ex_cn: 暴雨把外面的每个人都淋湿了。
words.en: A downpour is a sudden and unexpected heavy fall of rain.

words.ex: The raindrops glistened on the windowpane.
words.ex_cn: 雨滴在窗玻璃上闪闪发光。
words.en: A raindrop is a single drop of rain.

words.ex: A gentle breeze blew through the trees.
words.ex_cn: 一阵微风轻轻吹过树梢。
words.en: A breeze is a gentle wind.

words.ex: There was a thin mist over the lake at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 黎明时分，湖面上有一层薄雾。
words.en: Mist is a thin layer of cloud that touches the ground. It is less dense than fog and can make it difficult to see clearly.

words.ex: Dew forms on the grass in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 早晨露水出现在草地上。
words.en: Dew is small drops of water that form on the ground and other surfaces outside during the night.

words.ex: A dewdrop hangs on the grass at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 黎明时分，一滴露珠悬在草叶上。
words.en: A dewdrop is a drop of water that forms on cool surfaces at night, as a result of condensation.

words.ex: The city has heavy smog in winter.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市冬天有严重的雾霾。
words.en: Smog is a mixture of smoke and fog, or a similar mixture of air pollutants, which can be harmful to health.

words.ex: Scientists work at the observatory to study stars.
words.ex_cn: 科学家在天文台工作以研究恒星。
words.en: A building or place equipped for observation of natural phenomena (as in astronomy); also : an institution whose primary purpose is making such observations.

words.tr: n. 星座；一群杰出人物；一系列（相关的想法、事物）
words.ex: He saw the Orion constellation in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 他在夜空中看到了猎户座。
words.en: A constellation is a group of stars which form a pattern and have a name.

words.ex: The Milky Way is our home galaxy.
words.ex_cn: 银河系是我们所在的星系。
words.en: A galaxy is an extremely large group of stars and planets that extends over many billions of light years.

words.ex: Venus is the brightest planet in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 金星是夜空中最亮的行星。
words.en: Venus is the second planet from the Sun, orbiting it every 224.7 Earth days. It is named after the Roman goddess of love and beauty.

words.ex: Jupiter is the largest planet in our solar system.
words.ex_cn: 木星是我们太阳系中最大的行星。
words.en: Jupiter is the largest planet in the solar system, known for its prominent Great Red Spot and numerous moons.

words.ex: The thermometer contains mercury.
words.ex_cn: 温度计里含有水银。
words.en: Mercury is a heavy, silvery-white metal that is liquid at room temperature. It is used in thermometers, barometers, and other scientific apparatus.

words.ex: The rover is exploring mars.
words.ex_cn: 探测器正在探索火星。
words.en: Mars is the fourth planet from the Sun in the Solar System and the second-smallest planet in the Solar System, after Mercury. Named after the Roman god of war, it is often referred to as the 'Red Planet' because the iron oxide prevalent on its surface gives it a reddish appearance.

words.ex: Saturn has beautiful rings around it.
words.ex_cn: 土星周围有美丽的光环。
words.en: Saturn is the sixth planet from the Sun in the Solar System and is known for its prominent ring system, which is composed mainly of ice particles with a smaller amount of rocky debris and dust.

words.ex: The comet shines brightly in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 彗星在夜空中明亮地闪耀。
words.en: A comet is a celestial object consisting of a nucleus of ice and dust and, when near the sun, a 'tail' of gas and dust particles pointing away from the sun.

words.tr: adj. 布满星星的；像星星的；闪闪发光的
words.ex: The night sky is starry and beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 夜空繁星点点，非常美丽。
words.en: A starry sky is one that is full of stars.

words.ex: The old sundial shows time by the sun's shadow.
words.ex_cn: 这个古老的日晷通过太阳的影子显示时间。
words.en: A sundial is a device that tells the time of day by the position of the sun. In common designs such as the horizontal sundial, the sun casts a shadow from its style (a thin rod or a sharp, straight edge) onto a flat surface marked with lines indicating the hours of the day. As the sun moves across the sky, the shadow edge aligns with different hour-lines.

words.ex: He loves to watch the cosmos at night.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在夜晚观看宇宙。
words.en: The cosmos refers to the universe seen as a well-ordered whole, or to any system or structure that is complex and orderly.

words.ex: The cosmic rays come from outer space.
words.ex_cn: 宇宙射线来自外太空。
words.en: Relating to the universe or cosmos, especially as distinct from the earth.

words.ex: The spacecraft landed safely on Mars.
words.ex_cn: 航天器在火星上安全着陆。
words.en: A spacecraft is a vehicle or machine designed to fly in outer space. Spacecraft are used for a variety of purposes, including communications, Earth observation, meteorology, navigation, space colonization, planetary exploration, and transportation of humans and cargo.

words.ex: The solar panel collects energy from the sun.
words.ex_cn: 太阳能板从太阳收集能量。
words.en: Solar means relating to the sun or using the energy from the sun to produce electricity.

words.ex: The city is at a latitude of 40 degrees north.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市位于北纬40度。
words.en: Latitude is the distance of a place north or south of the equator, measured in degrees.

words.ex: The ship's longitude is 45 degrees west.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船的经度是西经45度。
words.en: Longitude is the distance of a place east or west of the Greenwich meridian, measured in degrees.

words.ex: The village is at an altitude of 2,000 meters.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄的海拔是2000米。
words.en: The height of an object or point in relation to sea level or ground level.

words.ex: The equator divides the Earth into two halves.
words.ex_cn: 赤道将地球分为两半。
words.en: The equator is an imaginary line around the Earth, equally distant from the North Pole and the South Pole, dividing the Earth into the Northern Hemisphere and the Southern Hemisphere.

words.ex: The hikers walked along the ridge of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 徒步旅行者沿着山脊行走。
words.en: A ridge is a long, narrow elevation of land, or a raised strip.

words.ex: The sheep graze on a high plateau.
words.ex_cn: 羊群在高高原上吃草。
words.en: A plateau is a large area of high and fairly flat land. It can also refer to a period during which there are no large changes.

words.ex: The sheep graze on the highland.
words.ex_cn: 羊在高地上吃草。
words.en: Highland refers to an area of high or mountainous land, often characterized by its elevation above sea level and distinct geographical features.

words.ex: The small town is located in the hinterland of the country.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇位于该国的内地。
words.en: The area lying inland from a coast or the shore of a river; the backcountry.

words.ex: The birds live in a quiet marsh.
words.ex_cn: 这些鸟生活在一片宁静的沼泽中。
words.en: A marsh is an area of low-lying land which is flooded in wet seasons or at high tide, and typically remains waterlogged at all times.

words.ex: The swamp is full of tall grass and frogs.
words.ex_cn: 这个沼泽里长满了高草和青蛙。
words.en: A swamp is an area of low-lying, uncultivated ground where water collects; a bog or marsh.

words.ex: The sheep graze on the heath.
words.ex_cn: 羊在荒地上吃草。
words.en: A heath is an area of open land covered with rough grass or heather and with very few trees or bushes.

words.ex: The arid land has little rain and no trees.
words.ex_cn: 这片干旱的土地降雨稀少，没有树木。
words.en: An arid area of land has so little rain that it is very dry and cannot support much vegetation.

words.tr: adj. 不能生育的；贫瘠的；
words.ex: The doctor said the man is sterile.
words.ex_cn: 医生说这个人不能生育。
words.en: Something that is sterile is completely clean and free from bacteria or other microorganisms.

words.ex: The lab tested the sterility of the equipment.
words.ex_cn: 实验室检测了设备的无菌性。
words.en: The state of being free from living microorganisms or the inability to produce offspring.

words.ex: The cows graze on the prairie.
words.ex_cn: 牛在草原上吃草。
words.en: A prairie is a large area of flat, grassy land, especially in North America.

words.ex: The cows are grazing in the meadow.
words.ex_cn: 牛群正在草地上吃草。
words.en: A meadow is a field with grass and often wild flowers in it.

words.ex: The gardener laid new turf in the backyard.
words.ex_cn: 园丁在后院铺了新的草皮。
words.en: Turf is a surface layer of earth containing a dense growth of grass and its matted roots; used especially for lawns and sports fields.

words.tr: n. （牧马的）小围场；检阅场；设有围栏的一片土地；
words.ex: The horses graze in a small paddock near the barn.
words.ex_cn: 马儿在马厩附近的小围场里吃草。
words.en: A paddock is a small field or enclosure where horses are kept or exercised.

words.ex: He works on a large ranch in Texas.
words.ex_cn: 他在德克萨斯州的一个大牧场工作。
words.en: A ranch is a large farm, especially in the western United States and Canada, where cattle or other animals are bred and raised.

words.tr: n. 树木生长线（按海拔标示的树木生长上限）
words.ex: The treeline marks the upper limit of tree growth in the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 林木线标志着山中树木生长的上限。
words.en: The treeline is the edge of the habitat at which trees are capable of growing. It is found at high elevations and high latitudes. Beyond the treeline, trees cannot tolerate the environmental conditions (usually cold temperatures, extreme snowpack, or associated lack of available moisture).

words.ex: The sailors swam ashore after the boat sank.
words.ex_cn: 船沉没后，水手们游到了岸上。
words.en: If someone or something comes ashore, they come from the sea onto the shore.

words.ex: The climber scaled the steep crag.
words.ex_cn: 攀岩者爬上了陡峭的岩壁。
words.en: A crag is a steep, rugged rock or cliff.

words.ex: The hiker stood at the edge of the cliff.
words.ex_cn: 徒步者站在悬崖边上。
words.en: A cliff is a high area of rock with a very steep side, often at the edge of the sea or a river.

words.ex: The river flows through a deep canyon.
words.ex_cn: 河流流经一个深峡谷。
words.en: A canyon is a large valley with very steep sides and usually a river flowing along the bottom.

words.ex: The ship sailed through the strait at night.
words.ex_cn: 船在夜间通过了海峡。
words.en: A strait is a narrow passage of water connecting two seas or two large areas of water.

words.ex: The Gulf of Mexico is a large sea area.
words.ex_cn: 墨西哥湾是一个大型海域。
words.en: A gulf is a large area of sea that is partly surrounded by land.

words.ex: The fire engulfed the old house.
words.ex_cn: 大火吞噬了那座老房子。
words.en: If one thing engulfs another, it completely covers or hides it, often in a sudden and unexpected way.

words.ex: The boat is parked in the bay.
words.ex_cn: 船停在海湾里。
words.en: A bay is a body of water partially enclosed by land, typically smaller than a gulf. It can also refer to a compartment for a ship, the color of a horse, or the sound a dog makes.

words.ex: The small boat docked at the inlet.
words.ex_cn: 小船停靠在小水湾。
words.en: An inlet is a narrow strip of water that leads from a sea or lake into the land or between islands.

words.ex: The car crossed the river at a ford.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在浅滩处渡过了河。
words.en: A ford is a shallow place in a river or stream where one can cross by walking or driving through the water.

words.ex: They walked along the waterfront and enjoyed the view.
words.ex_cn: 他们沿着滨水区散步，欣赏景色。
words.en: The part of a town or city that is next to a river, lake, or the sea, especially the part where there are docks and where ships load and unload.

words.ex: The company has an offshore office in Ireland.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司在爱尔兰有一个离岸办公室。
words.en: Located or based in a foreign country, especially to take advantage of lower costs or less stringent regulations.

words.ex: The Nile River forms a large delta before it flows into the sea.
words.ex_cn: 尼罗河在流入大海之前形成了一个巨大的三角洲。
words.en: A delta is an area of low, flat land shaped like a triangle, where a river splits and spreads out into several branches before entering the sea.

words.tr: n. 港湾；河口湾；河口；入海口；
words.ex: The river flows into the estuary before reaching the sea.
words.ex_cn: 河流在入海前流入港湾。
words.en: An estuary is the wide part of a river where it nears the sea; fresh and salt water mix.

words.ex: The fish swim near the coral reef.
words.ex_cn: 鱼在珊瑚礁附近游动。
words.en: A reef is a long line of rocks or sand, the top of which is just above or just below the surface of the sea.

words.ex: The small isle is surrounded by blue sea.
words.ex_cn: 这个小岛被蓝色的海洋环绕着。
words.en: An isle is a small island.

words.ex: The peninsula is surrounded by water on three sides.
words.ex_cn: 这个半岛三面环水。
words.en: A peninsula is a piece of land that is almost entirely surrounded by water but is connected to the mainland on one side.

words.ex: He saw a beautiful panorama from the mountain top.
words.ex_cn: 他从山顶看到了美丽的全景。
words.en: A panorama is a view of a wide area, or a description or study that presents all the different parts or aspects of a particular subject.

words.ex: The old man has a cataract in his right eye.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人右眼有白内障。
words.en: A cataract is a medical condition in which the lens of the eye becomes progressively opaque, resulting in blurred vision. It can also refer to a large waterfall.

words.ex: The rain caused a torrent down the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 大雨在山间形成了一股急流。
words.en: A torrent is a fast-moving stream of water or other liquid.

words.ex: The children played near the creek after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在小河旁玩耍。
words.en: A creek is a small, narrow stream or river.

words.tr:
n. 小河；溪
v. （不）忍受；（不）容忍
words.ex: The child jumps over the brook.
words.ex_cn: 孩子跳过小溪。
words.en: A small stream; to tolerate or allow something.

words.ex: He picked up a small pebble from the ground.
words.ex_cn: 他从地上捡起了一颗小石子。
words.en: A pebble is a small, smooth, round stone, especially one found on a beach or in a river.

words.ex: The hikers walked on a rugged trail.
words.ex_cn: 徒步者走在一条崎岖的小路上。
words.en: A rugged area of land is uneven and covered with rocks, with few trees or plants.

words.ex: The stony path made walking difficult.
words.ex_cn: 这条多石的小路让行走变得困难。
words.en: Something that is stony is covered with stones or contains a lot of stones. It can also describe someone who is unfriendly or unemotional.

words.tr: adj. 不平坦的；不均匀的；
words.ex: The road is uneven and hard to drive on.
words.ex_cn: 这条路不平坦，很难开车。
words.en: Something that is uneven is not regular, consistent, or equal.

words.ex: The village by the lake is picturesque.
words.ex_cn: 湖边的村庄如画般美丽。
words.en: A picturesque place is attractive and interesting, especially in a way that is old-fashioned or unusual.

words.ex: The splendor of the sunset amazed everyone.
words.ex_cn: 日落的壮丽让每个人都惊叹。
words.en: Splendor is the great beauty or impressive appearance of something.

words.tr:
n. 高科技
adj. 高技术的
words.ex: He works in a high-tech company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家高科技公司工作。
words.en: Involving or using advanced technology.

words.ex: The phone has a small microchip inside.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机里面有一个小芯片。
words.en: A microchip is a very small piece of silicon inside a computer. It has electronic circuits on it and can hold large amounts of information or perform mathematical and logical operations.

words.tr: n. 微处理器；微处理机
words.ex: The computer has a fast microprocessor.
words.ex_cn: 这台电脑有一个快速的微处理器。
words.en: A microprocessor is a small chip that can process data and carry out instructions in a computer or other electronic device.

words.ex: The amoeba reproduces by fission.
words.ex_cn: 阿米巴通过分裂生殖进行繁殖。
words.en: Fission is the splitting of an atomic nucleus, resulting in the release of a large amount of energy.

words.ex: Dust particles float in the air.
words.ex_cn: 灰尘微粒漂浮在空气中。
words.en: A particle is a very small piece or amount of something.

words.ex: Water is made of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom in a molecule.
words.ex_cn: 水由两个氢原子和一个氧原子组成一个分子。
words.en: A molecule is the smallest particle in a chemical element or compound that has the chemical properties of that element or compound. Molecules are made up of atoms that are held together by chemical bonds.

words.ex: The atom is the smallest part of matter.
words.ex_cn: 原子是物质的最小单位。
words.en: An atom is the smallest unit of ordinary matter that forms a chemical element. Every solid, liquid, gas, and plasma is composed of neutral or ionized atoms.

words.tr: n. （电解池的）阳极；（原电池的）负极
words.ex: The current flows into the anode during electrolysis.
words.ex_cn: 在电解过程中，电流流入阳极。
words.en: An anode is the positively charged electrode by which the electrons leave a device.

words.ex: He is learning optics in physics class.
words.ex_cn: 他正在物理课上学习光学。
words.en: Optics is the branch of physics that involves the study of light and its interactions with matter, including the construction of instruments that use or detect it.

words.ex: He uses optical lenses to see small objects.
words.ex_cn: 他使用光学镜片来看小物体。
words.en: Relating to sight, especially in relation to the physical action of light.

words.ex: The doctor used a laser to fix her eye.
words.ex_cn: 医生用激光修复了她的眼睛。
words.en: A laser is a device that emits light through a process of optical amplification based on the stimulated emission of electromagnetic radiation.

words.tr: n. 便携式电脑；笔记本电脑；
words.ex: He uses a laptop to work from home.
words.ex_cn: 他用笔记本电脑在家工作。
words.en: A laptop is a computer which is small enough to be carried around easily and is designed for use outside an office.

words.ex: He works on his desktop every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都在台式机上工作。
words.en: The top of a desk; a computer that is designed to be used on a desk.

words.tr: n. 从0到9的任一数字；手指；脚趾；
words.ex: The password has four digits.
words.ex_cn: 这个密码有四位数字。
words.en: A digit is a written symbol for any of the numbers 0 to 9.

words.ex: He uses a digital watch to tell time.
words.ex_cn: 他用一块数字手表看时间。
words.en: Digital systems, devices, or technology use electronic signals that are represented by the numbers 1 and 0, indicating 'on' or 'off'.

words.ex: The hacker broke into the computer system.
words.ex_cn: 这个黑客入侵了计算机系统。
words.en: A hacker is someone who is skilled at using computers and the internet, especially for finding out secret information or for causing damage to computer systems.

words.ex: The cursor moves when I slide my finger on the touchpad.
words.ex_cn: 当我在触控板上滑动手指时，光标会移动。
words.en: A cursor is a movable indicator on a computer screen identifying the point that will be affected by input from the user.

words.ex: He is learning biochemistry at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学学习生物化学。
words.en: The branch of science concerned with the chemical processes occurring within living organisms.

words.ex: He works in a lab that uses biotechnology.
words.ex_cn: 他在一个使用生物技术的实验室工作。
words.en: Biotechnology is the use of living cells and bacteria in industrial and scientific processes.

words.ex: The forest is a healthy ecosystem.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林是一个健康的生态系统。
words.en: An ecosystem is a complex network or interconnected system, especially one that involves a community of living organisms in conjunction with their environment.

words.ex: Telecommunications connect people across the world.
words.ex_cn: 电信连接了全世界的人们。
words.en: Telecommunications is the technology of sending signals and messages over long distances using electronic means, such as radio, telephone, television, and the internet.

words.ex: He sent a telegraph to his family.
words.ex_cn: 他给家人发了一封电报。
words.en: A system for transmitting messages from a distance along a wire, especially one creating signals by making and breaking an electrical connection.

words.tr:
n. 电传
v. 发电传
words.ex: He sent a telex to confirm the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他发了一份电传以确认会议。
words.en: A telex is a communication system consisting of teletypewriters connected to a telephonic network to send and receive signals.

words.ex: He bought a new hi-fi system for his home.
words.ex_cn: 他为家里买了一套新的高保真音响设备。
words.en: High-fidelity sound reproduction, especially in audio equipment.

words.tr:
n. 立体声；立体声音响
adj. 立体声的
words.ex: He plays music on the stereo.
words.ex_cn: 他通过立体声收音机播放音乐。
words.en: A stereo is a sound system that uses two or more separate microphones to record sound and two or more loudspeakers to play it back, so that you hear different parts of the sound coming from different directions.

words.ex: The audio signal was clear and loud.
words.ex_cn: 音频信号清晰响亮。
words.en: Audio refers to sound, especially when recorded, transmitted, or reproduced.

words.ex: The teacher used audiovisuals to teach the lesson.
words.ex_cn: 老师使用视听教具来授课。
words.en: Materials or equipment that involve both hearing and seeing, used especially in teaching or presentations.

words.ex: He passed the aural test by listening carefully.
words.ex_cn: 他通过仔细听通过了听力测试。
words.en: Relating to the ear or the sense of hearing.

words.ex: He spoke into the microphone to be heard clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他对着麦克风说话，以便被清楚地听到。
words.en: A microphone is a device that is used to make sounds louder or to record them.

words.ex: He bought a new gadget to clean his kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一个新的小器具来清洁厨房。
words.en: A gadget is a small device or machine with a particular purpose.

words.tr: n. 机械（总称）；机械装置；
words.ex: The factory uses old machinery to produce goods.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂使用旧机械来生产产品。
words.en: Machinery refers to machines in general or the parts of a machine that make it work.

words.ex: The generator provides electricity during the power outage.
words.ex_cn: 发电机在停电时提供电力。
words.en: A generator is a machine which produces electricity or another form of energy.

words.ex: This house has a modern design.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子具有现代的设计。
words.en: Modern means relating to the present time, for example the present decade or present century.

words.ex: The inventive child made a toy from cardboard.
words.ex_cn: 这个有创造力的孩子用纸板做了一个玩具。
words.en: If you describe someone as inventive, you mean that they are good at inventing things or have clever and original ideas.

words.ex: The bulldozer cleared the path for the new road.
words.ex_cn: 推土机为新道路清理了路径。
words.en: A bulldozer is a large tractor with a blade in front, used for moving earth and rocks in construction work.

words.ex: He looks at the stars through a telescope.
words.ex_cn: 他通过望远镜看星星。
words.en: A telescope is an optical instrument designed to make distant objects appear nearer, containing an arrangement of lenses, or of curved mirrors and lenses, by which rays of light are collected and focused and the resulting image magnified.

words.ex: He took the elevator to the 10th floor.
words.ex_cn: 他乘电梯上了十楼。
words.en: An elevator is a device that moves people or goods up and down inside a building.

words.tr: n. 自动扶梯；电动扶梯；
words.ex: He took the escalator to the second floor.
words.ex_cn: 他乘自动扶梯上了二楼。
words.en: An escalator is a moving staircase that carries people between floors of a building or structure.

words.ex: He pressed the shutter to take a photo.
words.ex_cn: 他按下快门拍了一张照片。
words.en: A shutter is a device used to cover or uncover a window or a camera lens.

words.ex: The old factory uses a dynamo to produce electricity.
words.ex_cn: 这家老工厂使用一台发电机来发电。
words.en: A dynamo is a device for converting mechanical energy into electrical energy, typically by rotating coils of copper wire in a magnetic field.

words.ex: He loves photography and takes pictures every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱摄影，每个周末都拍照。
words.en: Photography is the art, application, and practice of creating durable images by recording light or other electromagnetic radiation, either electronically by means of an image sensor, or chemically by means of a light-sensitive material such as photographic film.

words.tr: v. 由电视播送；用电视放映
words.ex: The news will televise the election results tonight.
words.ex_cn: 今晚电视将播出选举结果。
words.en: To broadcast something on television.

words.tr:
n. 插图说明；标题；字幕
v. 加上说明；加上标题；加上字幕
words.ex: The photo has a caption that says 'Happy birthday'.
words.ex_cn: 这张照片有一个标题，写着‘生日快乐’。
words.en: A caption is a short piece of text under a picture in a book, magazine, or newspaper that describes the picture or explains what is happening in it.

words.ex: He found pornography on the computer.
words.ex_cn: 他在电脑上发现了色情内容。
words.en: Pornography refers to books, magazines, films, or other materials that are intended to cause sexual excitement by showing naked people or describing sexual acts.

words.tr: n. 赛璐珞；电影胶片；假象牙
words.ex: The old movie was made on celluloid.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影是用胶片拍摄的。
words.en: Celluloid is a type of plastic that was used especially in the past for making films, toys, and other objects.

words.tr: n. 新闻广播；新闻节目
words.ex: He watches the evening newscast every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上看晚间新闻播报。
words.en: A newscast is a television or radio broadcast of news reports.

words.tr: n. 时事通讯；业务通讯；简报
words.ex: He reads the weekly newsletter every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周一都读这份周刊。
words.en: A newsletter is a regularly distributed publication that is generally about one main topic of interest to its subscribers.

words.tr:
adj. 多媒体的；
n. 多媒体；
words.ex: The school uses multimedia tools to teach students.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校使用多媒体工具来教学。
words.en: Multimedia is the use of computers to present text, graphics, video, animation, and sound in an integrated way.

words.ex: Climbing the mountain without oxygen was a great feat.
words.ex_cn: 在不吸氧的情况下爬山是一项伟大的壮举。
words.en: A feat is an act or achievement that shows great courage, skill, or strength.

words.tr: adj. 深远的；影响深远的
words.ex: The decision had far-reaching effects on the town.
words.ex_cn: 这个决定对这个城镇产生了深远的影响。
words.en: If you describe actions, events, or changes as far-reaching, you mean that they have a very great influence and affect a great number of things.

words.tr: v. （使）留痕迹；做标记；评分；“mark”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 明显的；显著的；有记号的；
words.ex: The storm marked the old tree with deep scratches.
words.ex_cn: 风暴在那棵老树上留下了深深的划痕。
words.en: A marked change or difference is very obvious and easily noticed.

words.tr:
adj. 巨大的；强大的；
adv. 非常；
words.ex: The mighty river flows through the valley.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的河流流经山谷。
words.en: Possessing great power, strength, or force; formidable.

words.ex: The suitability of the job for her is clear.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作适合她，这一点很明显。
words.en: The quality of being right or appropriate for a particular person, purpose, or situation.

words.ex: The old building had a rebirth as a museum.
words.ex_cn: 这座旧建筑作为博物馆获得了新生。
words.en: Rebirth is the process of being born again, or a period of new growth or revival in something.

words.ex: The newborn baby slept quietly in its mother's arms.
words.ex_cn: 新生的婴儿安静地躺在母亲的怀里。
words.en: A newborn baby or animal has recently been born.

words.ex: The renaissance brought new art and ideas to Europe.
words.ex_cn: 文艺复兴为欧洲带来了新的艺术和思想。
words.en: The Renaissance was a period in European history marking the transition from the Middle Ages to modernity and covering the 15th and 16th centuries, characterized by an effort to revive and surpass ideas and achievements of classical antiquity.

words.ex: He is a Nobel laureate for his poetry.
words.ex_cn: 他因诗歌而获得诺贝尔奖。
words.en: A laureate is someone who has been given a prize or honor for achievement in a particular field, especially in the arts or sciences.

words.tr: v. 注意；备注；“note”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 著名的；闻名的；显著的；
words.ex: He noted the time of the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他记下了会议的时间。
words.en: If someone or something is noted for a particular quality, they are well known for it.

words.tr: adj. 荣誉的；名誉的；道义上的
words.ex: He received an honorary degree for his work.
words.ex_cn: 他因自己的工作获得了荣誉学位。
words.en: Given as an honor without the usual requirements or duties.

words.ex: He follows the orthodox religious practices.
words.ex_cn: 他遵循正统的宗教习俗。
words.en: Orthodox beliefs, methods, or systems are ones which are accepted or used by most people.

words.ex: This movie is a horror genre film.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影是一部恐怖类型影片。
words.en: A genre is a particular type of literature, painting, music, film, or other art form which people consider as a class because it has special characteristics.

words.ex: The stylistic choice of words made the poem more beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 词语的文体选择使这首诗更加优美。
words.en: Relating to the style or manner of something, especially in literature or art.

words.ex: She wears stylish clothes to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿着时髦的衣服去参加派对。
words.en: Something that is stylish is fashionable and attractive.

words.ex: Pop music is part of the mainstream.
words.ex_cn: 流行音乐是主流的一部分。
words.en: The ideas, attitudes, or activities that are shared by most people and regarded as normal or conventional.

words.ex: He loves romanticism in old poems.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢旧诗歌中的浪漫主义。
words.en: Romanticism is a movement in the arts and literature which originated in the late 18th century, emphasizing inspiration, subjectivity, and the primacy of the individual.

words.tr: adj. 史诗的；叙事诗的；宏丽的；
words.ex: The movie tells an epic story of heroes and dragons.
