words.en: To strangle someone means to kill them by squeezing their throat tightly so that they cannot breathe.

words.ex: The hold-up at the bank lasted only five minutes.
words.ex_cn: 银行的抢劫只持续了五分钟。
words.en: A hold-up is a situation in which someone is threatened with a weapon in order to make them hand over money or valuables, or a delay in something happening.

words.ex: He errred when he solved the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他在解这道数学题时犯了错。
words.en: To make a mistake or be incorrect.

words.ex: The teacher punished the boy for his misbehavior.
words.ex_cn: 老师因为他的不良行为惩罚了那个男孩。
words.en: Misbehavior refers to actions or conduct that are considered inappropriate or unacceptable in a given context, especially by children or students in an educational setting.

words.ex: He went to the casino to play poker.
words.ex_cn: 他去赌场玩扑克。
words.en: A casino is a building where people can gamble by playing games of chance or betting on events.

words.ex: The court punished the man for rape.
words.ex_cn: 法院因强奸罪惩罚了那个男人。
words.en: Rape is the crime of forcing someone to have sex with you, especially by using violence.

words.tr: n. 黑社会；犯罪集团；阴间；黑道
words.ex: The crime underworld is dangerous.
words.ex_cn: 犯罪地下世界很危险。
words.en: The underworld refers to the world of crime and criminals, or in mythology, the world of the dead.

words.ex: He tried to shoplift a shirt from the store.
words.ex_cn: 他试图从商店偷一件衬衫。
words.en: To steal goods from a shop while pretending to be a customer.

words.tr: adj. 偷偷摸摸的；不声张的；秘密的
words.ex: The thief moved with stealthy steps.
words.ex_cn: 小偷蹑手蹑脚地移动。
words.en: If you describe someone's behavior as stealthy, you mean that they are quiet and secret in what they do, often because they do not want to be seen or heard.

words.ex: He is a liar because he told a lie.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个骗子，因为他撒了谎。
words.en: A liar is someone who tells lies.

words.tr: v. 杀死；杀害；残害；宰杀
words.ex: He slayed the monster in the dark forest.
words.ex_cn: 他在黑暗的森林里杀死了怪物。
words.en: To kill someone or something in a violent way.

words.ex: He felt trapped in bondage.
words.ex_cn: 他感到被困在束缚中。
words.en: Bondage refers to the state of being a slave or being under the control of another person.

words.ex: He was accused of complicity in the theft.
words.ex_cn: 他被指控参与了这起盗窃案。
words.en: Complicity is involvement with other people in an illegal activity or wrongdoing.

words.tr: v. 恳求；征求；（妓女）拉客
words.ex: He solicits donations for the charity.
words.ex_cn: 他为慈善机构募捐。
words.en: If you solicit money, help, support, or an opinion from someone, you ask them for it.

words.tr:
n. 卖淫者；娼妓；妓女；男妓
v. 卖淫；出卖（名誉等）；糟蹋自己；滥用才能
words.ex: No example sentences
words.ex_cn: 没有例句
words.en: A prostitute is someone who engages in sexual activity for payment.

words.ex: No example sentences
words.ex_cn: 没有例句
words.en: Prostitution is the practice or occupation of engaging in sexual activity with someone for payment.

words.ex: This is the optimal time to plant flowers.
words.ex_cn: 这是种植花卉的最佳时间。
words.en: Most favorable or desirable; best.

words.tr: adj. 像家般舒适的；朴素的；
words.ex: The small cabin had a homely feel with soft blankets and a warm fire.
words.ex_cn: 这座小木屋有柔软的毛毯和温暖的火炉，感觉像家一样舒适。
words.en: If you describe something as homely, you mean that it is simple and plain, often in a way that is comforting. If you describe a person as homely, you mean that they are not very attractive.

words.tr: adj. 回家的；局限家庭的；闲居家中的
words.ex: The old man is homebound because of his illness.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人因为生病而足不出户。
words.en: If someone is homebound, they are unable to leave their home because they are ill or disabled, or because they have to stay at home to care for someone who is ill or disabled.

words.ex: He went to his high school homecoming last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他上周末去了他的高中返校节。
words.en: Homecoming is the act of returning to your home after being away for a long time, or a celebration at a school or college, usually once a year, for former students.

words.ex: The site of the old church is now a park.
words.ex_cn: 旧教堂的位置现在是一个公园。
words.en: A site is a piece of ground that is used for a particular purpose or where a particular thing happens.

words.tr: adv. 在这附近；在这一带
words.ex: I lost my keys hereabout.
words.ex_cn: 我的钥匙丢在这附近。
words.en: In this area or vicinity; around here.

words.ex: The river marks the borderline between the two countries.
words.ex_cn: 这条河标志着两个国家的边界线。
words.en: If you describe something as borderline, you mean that it is only just acceptable as a member of a class or group, or that it is only just good enough to be considered as such.

words.ex: The city's skyline looks beautiful at night.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市的天际线在夜晚看起来很美。
words.en: The outline of land and buildings defined against the sky.

words.ex: The township has a small school and a post office.
words.ex_cn: 这个乡镇有一所小学和一个邮局。
words.en: A township is a division of a county with some corporate powers.

words.ex: This is a no-parking zone.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个禁止停车的地带。
words.en: An area or a region distinguished from adjacent parts by a distinctive feature or characteristic.

words.tr: n. 重建；再发展；重建发展；
words.ex: The city plans redevelopment of the old downtown.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市计划对旧市中心进行重建。
words.en: The process of improving an area by building new houses, shops, or factories, or by repairing old ones.

words.tr: v. 提供新房；供以新住宅
words.ex: The government will rehouse the families after the flood.
words.ex_cn: 政府将在洪水后为这些家庭重新安置住所。
words.en: To provide someone with a new place to live, especially after moving from a previous one.

words.ex: The children play at Nursery 796.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在796号托儿所玩耍。
words.en: A nursery is a place where young children are cared for during the day while their parents are at work.

words.ex: They live in a big villa near the sea.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在海边的一座大别墅里。
words.en: A villa is a fairly large house, especially one that is used for holidays in Mediterranean countries.

words.ex: They live in a small bungalow near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在公园附近的一座小平房里。
words.en: A bungalow is a small house, usually having one story.

words.ex: The house has a small terrace with chairs.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子有一个带椅子的小平台。
words.en: A terrace is a flat area of stone or grass next to a building where people can sit.

words.ex: He lives in a big mansion near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他住在湖边的一座大宅子里。
words.en: A mansion is a very large, impressive house, especially one that is the home of a wealthy or important person.

words.tr:
adj. 高层的（建筑）
n. 高楼；大厦；多层建筑物
words.ex: He lives in a high-rise building near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他住在公园附近的一栋高楼里。
words.en: A high-rise building is a tall building with many floors.

words.tr: n. 故事；小说；轶事；假话；
words.ex: He told a funny story to his children.
words.ex_cn: 他给孩子们讲了一个有趣的故事。
words.en: A story is a description of imaginary people and events, which is written or told in order to entertain.

words.ex: The old temple has four stone pillars.
words.ex_cn: 这座古老的寺庙有四根石柱。
words.en: A pillar is a tall solid structure, which is usually used to support part of a building.

words.ex: The church has a big dome above the altar.
words.ex_cn: 教堂的祭坛上方有一个大穹顶。
words.en: A dome is a rounded vault made of either curved segments or a shell of revolution, meaning an arch rotated around its central vertical axis.

words.ex: They met at a saloon to discuss art and music.
words.ex_cn: 他们在一个沙龙里讨论艺术和音乐。
words.en: A saloon is a public room or building used for a specified purpose, especially a bar in the western U.S. in the 19th century.

words.tr: n. 房间；室；腔；大会议室；
words.ex: He sat in the chamber and waited quietly.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在房间里安静地等待。
words.en: A chamber is a large room, especially one that is used for formal or public events.

words.ex: Children play in the plaza after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在广场上玩耍。
words.en: A plaza is an open public space that is found in the heart of a city or town. It is often surrounded by buildings and may include shops, restaurants, and other amenities.

words.ex: The boxing match took place in an arena.
words.ex_cn: 拳击比赛在竞技场举行。
words.en: An arena is a place or scene of activity, debate, or conflict, especially one where a competition or performance is held.

words.ex: The children were excited to visit the funfair.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们很兴奋去游乐场。
words.en: A funfair is an outdoor event where there are machines to ride on, games to play, and other forms of entertainment.

words.ex: We visited an art gallery on Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们周日参观了一家艺术画廊。
words.en: A gallery is a place where works of art are shown to the public.

words.ex: The children play in the backyard after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在后院玩耍。
words.en: A backyard is an area of land at the back of a house, often used for recreation or gardening.

words.ex: He drinks coffee on the balcony every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都在阳台上喝咖啡。
words.en: A balcony is a platform on the outside of a building, enclosed by walls or balustrades, supported by columns or console brackets. The platform is projected from the wall of a building, usually above the ground floor.

words.ex: They sat on the veranda enjoying the evening breeze.
words.ex_cn: 他们坐在阳台上，享受着晚风。
words.en: A veranda is a roofed platform along the outside of a house, level with the ground floor.

words.ex: The books are on the shelf beside the aisle.
words.ex_cn: 书在过道旁边的架子上。
words.en: An aisle is a long narrow gap that people can walk along between rows of seats in a public building such as a church or between rows of shelves in a supermarket.

words.ex: The boy walked down the long corridor.
words.ex_cn: 男孩走过了长长的走廊。
words.en: A corridor is a long passage in a building, with doors and rooms on one or both sides.

words.tr: n. 客厅；起居室；营业室
words.ex: They sat in the parlor and drank tea.
words.ex_cn: 他们坐在客厅里喝茶。
words.en: A parlor is a room in a house for the special use of visitors, or a room in a public building for a specific purpose.

words.ex: He waited in the foyer before the show started.
words.ex_cn: 演出开始前，他在门厅里等候。
words.en: A foyer is an area at the front of a building, especially a hotel or theater, where people can wait or meet others.

words.ex: He sits on the porch and drinks coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在门廊上喝咖啡。
words.en: A porch is a covered shelter projecting in front of the entrance of a building.

words.ex: The children found old toys in the attic.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在阁楼上找到了旧玩具。
words.en: An attic is a space or room just below the roof of a building, often used for storage or as an extra room.

words.ex: The children built a hut in the woods.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在树林里建了一间小屋。
words.en: A hut is a small, simple building, usually consisting of one room and made of materials such as wood, mud, or grass.

words.tr: n. 着陆；降落；楼梯平台； v. “land”的现在分词；
words.ex: The plane made a smooth landing at the airport.
words.ex_cn: 飞机在机场平稳着陆。
words.en: The act of coming to or bringing something to land, especially an aircraft.

words.tr: n. 栏杆的支柱；楼梯的扶栏
words.ex: He held the banister while walking up the stairs.
words.ex_cn: 他上楼梯时扶着栏杆的支柱。
words.en: A banister is the handrail on the side of a staircase, which people can hold onto for support.

words.ex: He keeps apples in the cellar.
words.ex_cn: 他把苹果存放在地窖里。
words.en: A cellar is a room underneath a house, often used for storing things such as wine or coal.

words.ex: The trucks stop at the depot to load goods.
words.ex_cn: 卡车在仓库停靠以装载货物。
words.en: A depot is a place where large amounts of raw materials, manufactured goods, or equipment are stored until they are needed.

words.ex: The city became an important entrepot for goods from the East.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市成为了来自东方货物的重要贸易中心。
words.en: An entrepot is a port, city, or other center to which goods are brought for import and export, and for collection and distribution.

words.ex: The boxes are stored in the warehouse.
words.ex_cn: 这些箱子存放在仓库里。
words.en: A warehouse is a large building where raw materials or manufactured goods may be stored before their export or distribution for sale.

words.tr: n. （铁路或公路下的）地下通道
words.ex: The dog ran under the underpass.
words.ex_cn: 狗从立交桥下跑过去了。
words.en: An underpass is a road or path that goes under another road or a railway.

words.tr: n. 迷宫；难解的事件；错综复杂；
words.ex: The child got lost in the labyrinth.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在迷宫里迷路了。
words.en: A labyrinth is a complicated irregular network of passages or paths in which it is difficult to find one's way; a maze.

words.ex: The farmer stores hay in the barn.
words.ex_cn: 农夫把干草存放在谷仓里。
words.en: A barn is a large building on a farm in which crops or animals are kept.

words.ex: They stayed at a motel near the highway.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在高速公路旁的一家汽车旅馆。
words.en: A motel is a hotel which is designed for people who are travelling by car, usually with parking spaces next to each room.

words.tr: n. （校外）学生宿舍；旅社；招待所；
words.ex: The students live in a cheap hostel near the university.
words.ex_cn: 学生们住在大学附近的一家便宜的学生宿舍里。
words.en: A hostel is a budget-oriented, shared-room accommodation that attracts a diverse clientele, including backpackers, students, and travelers seeking an economical place to stay.

words.ex: He bought a magazine at the bookstall.
words.ex_cn: 他在报摊上买了一本杂志。
words.en: A bookstall is a small stand or shop, often outdoors, where books and sometimes magazines and newspapers are sold.

words.ex: He bought a hot dog from a food booth.
words.ex_cn: 他从一个小吃亭买了个热狗。
words.en: A booth is a small area separated from a larger public area by screens or thin walls where, for example, people can make a phone call or vote in private.

words.tr: n. 售货亭；报刊亭；公用电话亭
words.ex: He bought a ticket from the kiosk.
words.ex_cn: 他从自动售票机买了一张票。
words.en: A kiosk is a small open-fronted hut or cubicle from which newspapers, refreshments, tickets, etc., are sold.

words.tr: n. 举办地点；（比赛）地点；会场；
words.ex: The concert will be held at a new venue.
words.ex_cn: 这场音乐会将在一个新的举办地点举行。
words.en: A place where an event or meeting is held, such as a concert hall or conference center.

words.ex: The pagoda stands on the hill near the temple.
words.ex_cn: 塔矗立在寺庙附近的山上。
words.en: A pagoda is a tiered tower with multiple eaves, built in traditions originating in East Asia or with respect to those traditions, most often Buddhist religious purposes.

words.ex: The beacon shines at night to guide ships.
words.ex_cn: 灯塔在夜晚发光以引导船只。
words.en: A beacon is a light or a fire, usually on a hill or tower, which acts as a signal or a warning.

words.ex: The signpost shows the way to the village.
words.ex_cn: 路标指示了去村庄的路。
words.en: A signpost is a post with a sign on it, giving information such as the direction to a place or the distance to it.

words.ex: The lighthouse shines light at night.
words.ex_cn: 灯塔在夜晚发出光亮。
words.en: A lighthouse is a tower or other structure containing a beacon light to warn or guide ships at sea.

words.ex: The rod is a long shaft made of metal.
words.ex_cn: 这根杆是一根长金属杆。
words.en: A shaft is a long, narrow part or section forming the handle of a tool or club, the body of a spear or arrow, or a long, narrow, typically vertical hole that gives access to a mine, accommodates a lift, or provides ventilation.

words.ex: The wheelchair goes up the ramp easily.
words.ex_cn: 轮椅可以轻松地走上坡道。
words.en: A ramp is a sloping surface connecting two levels, such as a road or a path.

words.ex: The reservoir provides water for the nearby town.
words.ex_cn: 这个水库为附近的城镇提供水源。
words.en: A reservoir is a large quantity of a substance that is stored and can be used when needed.

words.ex: The farmer dug a ditch to water the fields.
words.ex_cn: 农夫挖了一条沟来给田地浇水。
words.en: A ditch is a long narrow trench or furrow dug in the ground, especially for drainage or irrigation.

words.tr:
n. 堤坝；排水沟
v. 筑堤；开排水沟
words.ex: The dike was built to prevent flooding.
words.ex_cn: 修建堤坝是为了防止洪水泛滥。
words.en: A dike is a long wall or embankment built to prevent flooding from the sea or a river.

words.ex: The farmers built a dyke to stop the river from flooding the fields.
words.ex_cn: 农民们修了一道堤坝，以防止河水淹没田地。
words.en: A dyke is a thick wall that is built to stop water flooding onto very low-lying land from a river or from the sea. In informal use, it can also refer to a lesbian, though this usage is considered offensive by many.

words.tr: n. 下水道；排水沟；缝纫者
words.ex: The sewer smells bad after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 下雨后，下水道闻起来很难闻。
words.en: A sewer is a large underground channel that carries off waste water and refuse.

words.ex: The city cleaned the sewage from the streets.
words.ex_cn: 城市清理了街道上的污水。
words.en: Sewage is waste matter such as faeces or dirty water from homes and factories, which flows away through sewers.

words.ex: The city improved its sewerage system last year.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市去年改进了其排水系统。
words.en: The system of removing waste water and human excrement from homes and other buildings, and the waste material that is removed.

words.ex: The stench from the trash made me sick.
words.ex_cn: 垃圾的臭味让我恶心。
words.en: A strong, very unpleasant smell.

words.ex: The smelly trash made everyone cover their noses.
words.ex_cn: 那堆难闻的垃圾让每个人都捂住了鼻子。
words.en: Having a strong, unpleasant smell.

words.tr:
n. 恶臭；难闻气味；吵闹；争吵
v. 发臭；极低劣；不受欢迎
words.ex: The garbage gave off a bad stink.
words.ex_cn: 垃圾散发出一股恶臭。
words.en: To stink means to smell very unpleasant.

words.ex: The street was full of filth after the storm.
words.ex_cn: 风暴过后，街道上满是污秽。
words.en: Filth is a noun that refers to disgusting dirt or refuse, or obscene and offensive language or printed material.

words.ex: The floor was filthy after the storm.
words.ex_cn: 暴风雨过后，地板变得非常肮脏。
words.en: Something that is filthy is extremely dirty.

words.ex: The grime on the window made it hard to see outside.
words.ex_cn: 窗户上的尘垢让外面看不清楚。
words.en: Grime is dirt which has collected on the surface of something.

words.tr:
n. 污点；渍痕；浓烟
v. （使）变脏；（使）模糊
words.ex: There is a smudge on the window.
words.ex_cn: 窗户上有一个污点。
words.en: A smudge is a dirty mark or smear. As a verb, to smudge means to make something dirty or to blur it by rubbing.

words.ex: The ink blot ruined his homework.
words.ex_cn: 墨水污点弄脏了他的作业。
words.en: A blot is a mark or stain that spoils the appearance of something. It can also refer to an act that damages someone's reputation.

words.ex: He felt the stigma of being unemployed.
words.ex_cn: 他感受到了失业的耻辱。
words.en: A stigma is a strong feeling of disapproval that most people in a society have about something, especially when this is unfair.

words.ex: The smell of the food made her feel nausea.
words.ex_cn: 食物的气味让她感到恶心。
words.en: A feeling of sickness with an inclination to vomit.

words.ex: She added bleach to the white shirt to make it brighter.
words.ex_cn: 她往白衬衫里加了漂白剂，让它更亮。
words.en: To bleach something means to make it white or pale by using a chemical or by exposing it to sunlight.

words.tr: n. 洗涤剂；洗衣粉；去垢剂；
words.ex: She uses detergent to wash the clothes.
words.ex_cn: 她用洗涤剂洗衣服。
words.en: A detergent is a substance that is used for cleaning things, especially clothes and dishes.

words.ex: The water is toxic to fish.
words.ex_cn: 这种水对鱼是有毒的。
words.en: If a substance is toxic, it is poisonous.

words.tr: adj. 未达到标准的；不达标的；不合格的
words.ex: The food was substandard and made us sick.
words.ex_cn: 这些食物质量低劣，让我们生病了。
words.en: Below the usual or required standard.

words.tr: adj. 第三的；高等教育的
words.ex: He works in the tertiary sector as a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他作为一名教师在第三产业工作。
words.en: In the context of an economy, the tertiary sector is the part of the economy that provides services rather than producing goods. In geology, the Tertiary period is a former term for the period of time now called the Paleogene and Neogene periods, which followed the Cretaceous period.

words.ex: He buys milk and bread from the grocer.
words.ex_cn: 他从杂货店买牛奶和面包。
words.en: A grocer is a person who sells food and small household goods.

words.ex: He buys milk and bread at the grocery.
words.ex_cn: 他在杂货店买牛奶和面包。
words.en: A grocery is a store where food and small items for the house are sold.

words.ex: He bought ham and cheese at the delicatessen.
words.ex_cn: 他在熟食店买了火腿和奶酪。
words.en: A delicatessen is a shop where foods such as cooked meats, cheeses, and unusual or foreign foods are sold.

words.ex: I bought fresh bread from the bakery.
words.ex_cn: 我从面包房买了新鲜面包。
words.en: A bakery is a place where bread, cakes, and pastries are made or sold.

words.tr: n. 罐头食品厂；罐头工厂
words.ex: The cannery processes fresh produce into canned goods.
words.ex_cn: 这家罐头工厂将新鲜农产品加工成罐头食品。
words.en: A cannery is a factory where food is canned.

words.ex: This store sells many kinds of foodstuff.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售许多种类的食品。
words.en: Foodstuffs are substances that are used as food.

words.tr: n. 早午餐（早午两餐并作一餐）
words.ex: We had brunch at a small café on Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们在周日去一家小咖啡馆吃早午餐。
words.en: Brunch is a meal that is eaten in the late morning. It is a combination of breakfast and lunch.

words.ex: We had a quick luncheon at the café.
words.ex_cn: 我们在咖啡馆简单吃了顿午餐。
words.en: A luncheon is a formal lunch, or a formal word for lunch.

words.tr: n. 外卖餐馆；外卖食物；
words.ex: We ordered dinner from the Chinese takeaway.
words.ex_cn: 我们从一家中餐外卖店点了晚餐。
words.en: A takeaway is a main point or piece of information that you learn from something such as a meeting, discussion, or document.

words.ex: He follows a dietary plan to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他遵循一种饮食计划来保持健康。
words.en: Relating to the diet or the kinds of food that a person, animal, or community habitually eats.

words.tr: adj. 可食用的；可以吃的；
words.ex: These mushrooms are edible and safe to eat.
words.ex_cn: 这些蘑菇是可食用的，安全可以吃。
words.en: Fit to be eaten as food.

words.tr: v. 帮助；“help”的现在分词； n. 帮助；支持；
words.ex: She is helping her brother with his homework.
words.ex_cn: 她正在帮她的弟弟做作业。
words.en: A helping is an amount of food that is given to one person at a meal.

words.tr: n. 剩菜；吃剩的食物；“leftover”的复数
words.ex: He ate the leftovers for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃了剩饭。
words.en: Food remaining after a meal; something that remains unused or unconsumed.

words.ex: The remainder of the cake was given to the neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 蛋糕的剩余部分给了邻居。
words.en: The remainder is what is left over after other parts have been taken away or used.

words.ex: He eats gourmet food at a fancy restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家高档餐厅吃精致美食。
words.en: A gourmet is someone who knows a lot about food and cooking, and who enjoys eating high-quality food.

words.ex: The chef cooked a delicious dinner for the guests.
words.ex_cn: 主厨为客人做了一顿美味的晚餐。
words.en: A chef is a professional cook, typically the chief cook in a restaurant or hotel.

words.ex: Italian cuisine is famous for pasta and pizza.
words.ex_cn: 意大利烹调风格以意大利面和披萨闻名。
words.en: A style or method of cooking, especially as characteristic of a particular country, region, or establishment.

words.ex: She learned cookery from her grandmother.
words.ex_cn: 她向祖母学习烹调法。
words.en: Cookery is the activity or skill of preparing and cooking food.

words.ex: He kneaded the dough for bread.
words.ex_cn: 他揉了做面包的生面团。
words.en: Dough is a thick, malleable mixture of flour and liquid, used for baking into bread or pastry. It can also informally refer to money.

words.ex: She adds yeast to make bread rise.
words.ex_cn: 她加入酵母使面包发酵膨胀。
words.en: Yeast is a type of fungus which is used to make bread rise and to make beer and wine.

words.ex: The enzyme helps break down food in the stomach.
words.ex_cn: 这种酶帮助分解胃里的食物。
words.en: An enzyme is a protein that acts as a catalyst to bring about a specific biochemical reaction.

words.tr:
n. 淀粉；淀粉浆
v. 给（布）上浆
words.ex: The potato contains a lot of starch.
words.ex_cn: 土豆含有大量淀粉。
words.en: A carbohydrate that is the chief form of stored energy in plants, especially in seeds and tubers. It is also used in cooking and as a stiffening agent in textiles.

words.ex: He bought a warm pastry from the bakery.
words.ex_cn: 他从面包店买了一个热乎乎的点心。
words.en: Pastry is a food made from flour, fat, and water that is mixed together, rolled flat, and baked in an oven. It is used as a base or covering for pies, tarts, and other dishes.

words.ex: He ate a donut for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了一个甜甜圈。
words.en: A donut is a small, circular cake, typically with a hole in the center, fried and often covered with sugar or icing.

words.ex: He ate a bun for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了一个面包卷。
words.en: A bun is a small, usually round piece of bread. It can also refer to a hairstyle in which the hair is gathered into a tight coil or knot at the back of the head.

words.ex: A crumb fell on the table after he ate the bread.
words.ex_cn: 他吃完面包后，掉了一小块碎屑在桌子上。
words.en: A crumb is a very small piece of bread, cake, or biscuit.

words.ex: The earth's crust is made of rock.
words.ex_cn: 地球的地壳由岩石组成。
words.en: The crust is the hard outer layer of something, such as bread or the Earth's surface.

words.tr:
n. 结霜；霜状白糖；无光泽
v. 结霜；“frost”的现在分词
words.ex: She carefully applied the frosting to the cake.
words.ex_cn: 她小心翼翼地在蛋糕上涂抹糖霜。
words.en: A sweet glaze made of sugar and liquid, often flavored and colored, that is spread over cakes and other baked goods.

words.ex: She loves to eat toffee apples.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢吃太妃糖苹果。
words.en: A sweet made by boiling sugar and butter together, often with nuts or other ingredients added.

words.ex: He poured syrup on his pancakes.
words.ex_cn: 他把糖浆倒在煎饼上。
words.en: A thick, sweet liquid made by dissolving sugar in boiling water, often used as a topping for desserts or as a sweetener in drinks.

words.tr:
n. 素食者；食草动物；
adj. 素食者的；素菜的；
words.ex: He is a vegetarian and doesn't eat meat.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名素食者，不吃肉。
words.en: A vegetarian is someone who does not eat meat or fish, and sometimes other animal products, especially for moral, religious, or health reasons.

words.tr: n. 果菜商；蔬菜水果店
words.ex: The greengrocer sells fresh apples and carrots.
words.ex_cn: 蔬果商贩出售新鲜的苹果和胡萝卜。
words.en: A greengrocer is a person who owns or works in a shop that sells fresh vegetables and fruit.

words.ex: He picked a red raspberry from the garden.
words.ex_cn: 他从花园里摘了一颗红树莓。
words.en: A raspberry is a small, soft red fruit that grows on bushes. It is also used to denote a sound made to express derision or contempt.

words.ex: He picked a red berry from the bush.
words.ex_cn: 他从灌木丛中摘了一颗红色浆果。
words.en: A berry is a small, round fruit that grows on a bush or a tree. Some berries are edible and can be eaten raw or used in cooking.

words.tr: adj. 多汁的；利润丰厚的；有趣味的
words.ex: The apple is juicy and sweet.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果多汁又甜。
words.en: If you describe something as juicy, you mean that it is very interesting or exciting, especially because it involves scandalous or personal information.

words.tr:
n. 梅子；李子；紫红色；青紫色；令人垂涎的东西
adj. 令人垂涎的；吸引人的
words.ex: He ate a ripe plum for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了一个熟透的李子。
words.en: A plum is a sweet, juicy fruit with a smooth, red or purple skin and a stone in the middle.

words.ex: She eats olive every day with bread.
words.ex_cn: 她每天和面包一起吃橄榄。
words.en: An olive is a small oval fruit with a hard stone and bitter flesh, green when unripe and bluish black when ripe, used as food and as a source of oil.

words.tr:
n. 杏；杏树；杏黄色
adj. 杏黄色的
words.ex: He ate a sweet apricot for snack.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一个甜杏子当点心。
words.en: An apricot is a small, soft, round fruit with yellowish-orange flesh and a stone inside.

words.ex: He eats a raisin every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃一粒葡萄干。
words.en: A raisin is a dried grape.

words.ex: He ate a tangerine for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了一个柑橘。
words.en: A tangerine is a type of small, sweet orange with a loose skin that is easy to peel.

words.ex: Farmers grow grain like wheat and rice.
words.ex_cn: 农民种植小麦和大米等谷物。
words.en: A grain is a small, hard seed of a food plant such as wheat, rice, or corn, or the plant itself.

words.ex: He put sesame on his bread.
words.ex_cn: 他在面包上撒了芝麻。
words.en: Sesame is a plant grown for its seeds, which are used in cooking and for their oil.

words.ex: Farmers grow barley for animal feed.
words.ex_cn: 农民种植大麦作为动物饲料。
words.en: Barley is a cereal grain that is used as food and also in making beer and whiskey.

words.ex: He eats oats for breakfast every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃燕麦。
words.en: Oats are a type of cereal grain grown for its seed, which is known by the same name. They are used for food for people and as fodder for animals, especially horses and cattle.

words.ex: He ate bread made from rye.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了用黑麦做的面包。
words.en: Rye is a type of cereal plant grown in cool climates. It is used for making bread, whiskey, and animal feed.

words.ex: He grows maize on his farm.
words.ex_cn: 他在农场种植玉米。
words.en: Maize is a tall plant which produces long objects covered with yellow seeds called sweetcorn. It is often grown as a food crop.

words.ex: He grows soyabean in his field.
words.ex_cn: 他在田里种植大豆。
words.en: A widely cultivated plant of the pea family, grown for its edible seeds and oil.

words.ex: He eats a peanut for a snack.
words.ex_cn: 他吃一颗花生当零食。
words.en: A peanut is a small, oval, edible seed that grows underground in a pod and is widely eaten as food.

words.ex: He grows sorghum on his farm.
words.ex_cn: 他在农场种植高粱。
words.en: A cereal plant that is widely cultivated in warm regions, used for grain, fodder, and syrup.

words.ex: The almond grows in warm climates.
words.ex_cn: 杏树生长在温暖的气候中。
words.en: An almond is the seed of the almond tree, which is often eaten as a nut.

words.ex: He eats cauliflower with dinner every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚餐都吃花椰菜。
words.en: Cauliflower is a large, round, white vegetable that is eaten cooked or raw.

words.ex: He eats spinach every day for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚餐都吃菠菜。
words.en: Spinach is a leafy green vegetable that is high in iron and vitamins, often eaten cooked or raw in salads.

words.ex: He bought an eggplant at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了一个茄子。
words.en: An eggplant is a plant with large, egg-shaped, dark purple fruit that is eaten as a vegetable.

words.ex: He eats celery every day for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他每天午餐都吃芹菜。
words.en: Celery is a vegetable with long pale green stalks. It is eaten raw in salads or cooked as a vegetable.

words.ex: He eats a cucumber for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃了一根黄瓜。
words.en: A cucumber is a long, green vegetable with a high water content, used in salads and for pickling.

words.ex: He carved a big pumpkin for Halloween.
words.ex_cn: 他为万圣节雕刻了一个大南瓜。
words.en: A pumpkin is a large, round, orange vegetable with a thick skin.

words.ex: He ate a sweet melon for dessert.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一块甜瓜当甜点。
words.en: A melon is a large, juicy fruit with a hard rind, belonging to the gourd family, typically eaten fresh.

words.ex: He cooked beet soup for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他为晚餐煮了甜菜汤。
words.en: A beet is a plant with a round dark red root that is eaten as a vegetable.

words.ex: The pea grows inside a green pod.
words.ex_cn: 豌豆长在绿色的荚里。
words.en: A pod is a case that holds the seeds of certain plants, such as peas and beans.

words.ex: He eats a turnip for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐吃一个萝卜。
words.en: A turnip is a round root vegetable with a white or purple skin and white flesh.

words.ex: She added lettuce to her sandwich.
words.ex_cn: 她在三明治里加了莴苣。
words.en: Lettuce is a plant with large green leaves that is eaten in salads.

words.ex: He adds garlic to the soup for flavor.
words.ex_cn: 他往汤里加蒜来提味。
words.en: A strong-smelling pungent-tasting bulb, used as a flavoring in cooking and in herbal medicine.

words.ex: He eats spicy chilli with his rice.
words.ex_cn: 他吃辣辣椒配米饭。
words.en: A chilli is the small, red or green fruit of a type of pepper plant. It is used in cooking to give a hot taste to food.

words.ex: He adds ginger to his tea for flavor.
words.ex_cn: 他往茶里加姜来调味。
words.en: Ginger is a plant with a thick, knobby root that is used as a spice in cooking. It has a strong, spicy flavor and is also used in traditional medicine.

words.ex: He put mustard on his sandwich.
words.ex_cn: 他在三明治上加了芥末。
words.en: A pungent yellow or brown paste made from the ground seeds of certain plants, used as a condiment.

words.tr:
n. 调味品；佐料
v. 给 ... 调味；适应；风干；“season”的现在分词
words.ex: She added seasoning to the soup.
words.ex_cn: 她给汤里加了调味料。
words.en: Seasoning is a substance that is added to food to improve its flavor.

words.ex: He poured sauce on his pasta.
words.ex_cn: 他把酱汁倒在意大利面上。
words.en: A sauce is a thick liquid which is served with other food.

words.ex: The soup is tasty and hot.
words.ex_cn: 这汤美味又热。
words.en: If you describe food as tasty, you mean that it has a pleasant and attractive flavour.

words.tr:
v. 品味；细品；享用；体会
n. 风味；滋味
words.ex: He savord the taste of the chocolate slowly.
words.ex_cn: 他慢慢地品味着巧克力的味道。
words.en: To enjoy or appreciate (something) completely.

words.tr:
adj. 咸的；辛辣的；好吃的；好闻的
n. 咸味小吃
words.ex: The savory snack made her thirsty.
words.ex_cn: 这道咸味小吃让她口渴了。
words.en: Savory food is pleasantly salty or spicy and not sweet in taste.

words.tr:
n. 酸；
adj. 酸性的；
words.ex: The acid in lemon juice tastes sour.
words.ex_cn: 柠檬汁中的酸味道很酸。
words.en: An acid is a chemical substance, usually a liquid, which contains hydrogen and can react with other substances to form salts. Some acids burn or dissolve other substances that they come into contact with.

words.ex: The soup was too bland for me.
words.ex_cn: 这汤太淡了，我不喜欢。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as bland, you mean that they are rather dull and unexciting.

words.tr:
adj. 牛奶的；乳品的；
n. 乳品店；
words.ex: She bought dairy products from the local farm.
words.ex_cn: 她从当地农场买了乳制品。
words.en: A dairy is a place where milk and cream are kept or where butter and cheese are made.

words.ex: I eat yogurt for breakfast every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早餐吃酸奶。
words.en: Yogurt is a slightly sour thick liquid made from milk with bacteria added to it, often eaten with fruit or used in cooking.

words.tr: n. 人造黄油；人造奶油
words.ex: He puts margarine on his bread every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上在面包上抹人造黄油。
words.en: Margarine is a yellow substance made from vegetable oil and animal fats that is similar to butter. You spread it on bread or use it for cooking.

words.ex: The yolk of the egg is yellow.
words.ex_cn: 鸡蛋的蛋黄是黄色的。
words.en: The yellow part in the middle of an egg.

words.ex: He eats eggs for protein.
words.ex_cn: 他吃鸡蛋来获取蛋白质。
words.en: Proteins are large, complex molecules that play many critical roles in the body. They are necessary for the structure, function, and regulation of the body's tissues and organs.

words.ex: The milk looks milky and smooth.
words.ex_cn: 这牛奶看起来乳状且顺滑。
words.en: Resembling milk in color or consistency; containing milk.

words.ex: The milky way is bright in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 银河在夜空中很明亮。
words.en: The Milky Way is the galaxy that contains our Solar System, with the name describing the galaxy's appearance from Earth: a hazy band of light seen in the night sky formed from stars that cannot be individually distinguished by the naked eye.

words.tr: adj. 含乳脂的；奶油色的；乳脂状的
words.ex: The soup has a creamy texture.
words.ex_cn: 这汤有奶油般的质地。
words.en: Something that is creamy contains a lot of cream or is similar to cream in texture or color.

words.ex: He drinks a cold beverage after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后喝一杯冷饮。
words.en: A drink, especially one other than water; a liquid for drinking.

words.ex: They drank champagne at the wedding.
words.ex_cn: 他们在婚礼上喝了香槟。
words.en: Champagne is an expensive French white wine with bubbles in. It is often drunk to celebrate something.

words.ex: The scientist created a cocktail of chemicals for the experiment.
words.ex_cn: 科学家为实验配制了一种化学混合物。
words.en: A cocktail is a mixed drink typically made with a combination of alcoholic beverages and other ingredients such as fruit juices, syrups, or cream.

words.ex: He drank a glass of ale at the pub.
words.ex_cn: 他在酒吧喝了一杯麦芽酒。
words.en: Ale is a type of beer that is brewed using a warm fermentation method, resulting in a sweet, full-bodied and fruity taste.

words.ex: He drinks a glass of sherry after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后喝一杯雪利酒。
words.en: Sherry is a type of fortified wine originally from southern Spain.

words.ex: He drinks gin with ice.
words.ex_cn: 他喝加冰的杜松子酒。
words.en: A clear strong alcoholic drink flavoured with juniper berries.

words.tr:
n. （葡萄酒）制造年份；
adj. 古老的；
words.ex: This wine is from a vintage of 2015.
words.ex_cn: 这款葡萄酒产自2015年的酿造年份。
words.en: Vintage is used to describe something that is not just old, but is also of high quality and typical of the best of its kind.

words.ex: She used a mixer to make the cake batter.
words.ex_cn: 她用搅拌器来做蛋糕面糊。
words.en: A mixer is a machine or device used for mixing things together, especially in cooking or in music production.

words.ex: He drank a glass of cider at the farm party.
words.ex_cn: 他在农场聚会上喝了一杯苹果酒。
words.en: Cider is an alcoholic drink made from apples, or a non-alcoholic drink made from apples which is similar to apple juice.

words.tr: n. 柠檬汽水；柠檬饮料
words.ex: He drinks lemonade every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 他每天下午喝柠檬水。
words.en: A drink made from lemon juice, water, and sugar.

words.ex: He ate jelly with bread for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃面包配果冻。
words.en: A sweet, clear, semisolid, somewhat elastic spread or dessert made from fruit syrup and pectin or gelatin.

words.ex: He eats bread with marmalade for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃涂了果酱的面包。
words.en: Marmalade is a sweet food made from fruit, sugar, and water, especially oranges, which is spread on bread or used in cooking.

words.ex: He put ketchup on his fries.
words.ex_cn: 他在薯条上放了番茄酱。
words.en: A thick, smooth sauce made from tomatoes, vinegar, sugar, and spices, used as a condiment.

words.ex: The orange was squeezed into a sweet pulp.
words.ex_cn: 橙子被榨成了甜美的浆状物。
words.en: The soft, wet, shapeless mass of material that is left after the juice has been removed from fruit or vegetables, or the soft inner part of a tooth.

words.tr:
v. 炖；焖；烦恼
n. 炖煮的菜肴；忧虑
words.ex: He is stewing vegetables on the stove.
words.ex_cn: 他正在炉子上炖蔬菜。
words.en: A stew is a meal made by cooking meat, fish, or vegetables slowly in liquid.

words.tr: v. 做得过分；使…过度；过多使用
words.ex: Don't overdo the sugar in your tea.
words.ex_cn: 别在茶里放太多糖。
words.en: To do something to an excessive degree; to exaggerate or overuse something.

words.ex: He eats curry every Friday night.
words.ex_cn: 他每周五晚上吃咖喱。
words.en: Curry refers to a variety of dishes originating in the Indian subcontinent that use a complex combination of spices or herbs, usually including ground turmeric, cumin, coriander, ginger, and fresh or dried chilies. It also refers to the act of grooming a horse with a special comb.

words.ex: He eats mutton for dinner every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日吃羊肉当晚餐。
words.en: Mutton is the meat of an adult sheep eaten as food.

words.ex: We ate turkey for Thanksgiving dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我们在感恩节晚餐上吃了火鸡。
words.en: A turkey is a large bird that is often eaten at Christmas or Thanksgiving.

words.ex: He ate a sausage for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了一根香肠。
words.en: A sausage is a type of meat product usually made from ground meat, often pork, beef, or poultry, along with salt, spices, and other flavorings. Other ingredients such as grains or breadcrumbs may be included as fillers or extenders.

words.ex: He ordered fried prawn for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐点了炸对虾。
words.en: A prawn is a small shellfish with a long tail and many legs, which can be eaten.

words.ex: He ate grilled shrimp for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐吃了烤虾。
words.en: A shrimp is a small shellfish with a long tail and many legs, which can be eaten as food.

words.ex: He bought a fresh lobster at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了一只新鲜的龙虾。
words.en: A lobster is a sea creature with a hard shell, two large claws, and eight legs, or the flesh of this animal eaten as food.

words.ex: He found a clam on the beach.
words.ex_cn: 他在海滩上发现了一只蛤。
words.en: A clam is a type of shellfish with a shell in two parts that can open and close. Clams can be eaten as food.

words.ex: He ate a fresh oyster for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐吃了一个新鲜的牡蛎。
words.en: An oyster is a large flat shellfish. Some oysters can be eaten and others produce valuable objects called pearls.

words.ex: He is allergic to shellfish.
words.ex_cn: 他对贝类过敏。
words.en: Shellfish are sea creatures that live in shells and are eaten as food.

words.tr: n. 沙丁鱼；沙丁鱼罐头
words.ex: He ate a sardine for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃了一条沙丁鱼。
words.en: A small fish that is often canned and eaten as food.

words.tr: n. 鲑鱼；三文鱼；大马哈鱼；
words.ex: He grilled salmon for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他烤了鲑鱼当晚餐。
words.en: A salmon is a large silver-coloured fish which lives in the sea and rivers.

words.ex: The eel slid quietly through the water.
words.ex_cn: 鳗鱼静静地滑过水里。
words.en: An eel is a long, thin fish that looks like a snake. Some eels live in rivers and others live in the sea.

words.ex: He eats tuna for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃金枪鱼。
words.en: A tuna is a large fish that lives in warm seas and is caught for food.

words.ex: He caught a trout in the river.
words.ex_cn: 他在河里钓到了一条鳟鱼。
words.en: A trout is a fairly common fish that lives in rivers and streams.

words.ex: We ate grilled cod for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我们晚餐吃了烤鳕鱼。
words.en: Cod is a type of large sea fish that lives in cold parts of the North Atlantic.

words.ex: He bought a fresh herring at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了一条新鲜的青鱼。
words.en: A herring is a long silver-colored fish. Herring live in large groups in the sea.

words.ex: The fish swam fast using its fin.
words.ex_cn: 鱼用它的鳍快速游动。
words.en: A fin is a thin flat part that sticks out from the body of a fish, used for swimming and balancing.

words.ex: The warrior threw a spear at the enemy.
words.ex_cn: 战士向敌人投掷了一支矛。
words.en: A spear is a weapon consisting of a long pole with a sharp point at one end, used for thrusting or throwing.

words.ex: The fishermen trawl the sea for fish.
words.ex_cn: 渔民们用拖网在海里捕鱼。
words.en: To trawl means to fish with a trawl net or to search through something thoroughly.

words.tr: n. 水族馆；水族箱；养鱼缸；
words.ex: We visited the aquarium to see the fish.
words.ex_cn: 我们去水族馆看鱼。
words.en: A tank or building in which fish and other water creatures and plants are kept.

words.tr: adj. 水生的；水栖的；水中的；
words.ex: The fish live in aquatic plants.
words.ex_cn: 这些鱼生活在水生植物中。
words.en: Relating to water; living in or near water or taking place in water.

words.tr:
n. 淡水；
adj. 淡水的；
words.ex: Fish live in freshwater lakes.
words.ex_cn: 鱼生活在淡水湖中。
words.en: Freshwater refers to water that is not salty, especially water in rivers and lakes.

words.ex: The pond is full of green alga.
words.ex_cn: 池塘里充满了绿色的藻类。
words.en: A simple, nonflowering, and typically aquatic plant of a large group that includes the seaweeds and many single-celled forms. Algae contain chlorophyll but lack true stems, roots, leaves, and vascular tissue.

words.ex: The fish swim among the coral in the sea.
words.ex_cn: 鱼在海中的珊瑚间游动。
words.en: A hard stony substance secreted by certain marine coelenterates as an external skeleton, typically forming large reefs in warm seas.

words.tr: n. 收集；采集；聚会；聚集； v. 聚集；集合；“gather”的现在分词；
words.ex: The gathering of old books took him years.
words.ex_cn: 收集旧书花了他多年时间。
words.en: A gathering is a group of people meeting together for a particular purpose.

words.ex: He used a yardstick to measure the length of the cloth.
words.ex_cn: 他用码尺测量布料的长度。
words.en: A yardstick is a standard used for comparison or measurement.

words.tr:
adj. 梯状的；分等级的；数量的；标量的
n. 标量；数量
words.ex: In physics, a scalar is a quantity that has magnitude but no direction.
words.ex_cn: 在物理学中，标量是一个只有大小而没有方向的量。
words.en: A scalar is a quantity that is fully described by a magnitude (or numerical value) alone.

words.tr: n. 克拉（宝石重量单位）；开（含纯金的量）
words.ex: The diamond weighs 2 karats.
words.ex_cn: 这颗钻石重2克拉。
words.en: A unit used to measure the purity of gold, with 24 karats representing pure gold.

words.ex: The old machine is a deadweight on the factory's progress.
words.ex_cn: 这台旧机器是工厂进步的重负。
words.en: The total weight that a ship can carry, including the cargo, fuel, passengers, and crew, but not including the weight of the ship itself.

words.ex: He bought a gallon of milk from the store.
words.ex_cn: 他从商店买了一加仑牛奶。
words.en: A gallon is a unit of measurement for liquids that is equal to eight pints. In Britain, it is equal to about 4.546 litres. In America, it is equal to about 3.785 litres.

words.ex: The noise was 80 decibels.
words.ex_cn: 噪音是80分贝。
words.en: A decibel is a unit used to measure the intensity of a sound or the power level of an electrical signal by comparing it with a given level on a logarithmic scale.

words.ex: He added an ounce of salt to the soup.
words.ex_cn: 他往汤里加了一点盐。
words.en: An ounce is a unit of weight used in Britain and the USA. There are sixteen ounces in a pound.

words.ex: He owns five acres of farmland.
words.ex_cn: 他拥有五英亩的农田。
words.en: A unit of area used in the US Customary and the British Imperial systems, equal to 4,840 square yards or 4,046.86 square meters.

words.ex: The car has 200 horsepower.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车有200马力。
words.en: A unit of power equal to 550 foot-pounds per second (about 750 watts), used in measuring the power of engines or motors.

words.ex: The battery gives out 9 volts.
words.ex_cn: 这节电池输出9伏特。
words.en: A volt is a unit used to measure the force of an electric current.

words.ex: The battery has a voltage of 9 volts.
words.ex_cn: 这节电池的电压是9伏特。
words.en: Voltage is the electrical force measured in volts that is needed to make a current flow in a circuit.

words.ex: The farmer owns five hectares of land.
words.ex_cn: 这位农民拥有五公顷土地。
words.en: A hectare is a unit of measurement of area, equal to 10,000 square metres or approximately 2.471 acres.

words.tr:
n. 英寻（长度单位）
v. 测深；推测；揣摩；搞懂；彻底了解
words.ex: The ship's anchor sank to a depth of ten fathoms.
words.ex_cn: 船的锚沉到了十英寻的深度。
words.en: If you cannot fathom something, you are unable to understand it, although you think carefully about it.

words.ex: This bulb uses 60 watts.
words.ex_cn: 这个灯泡使用60瓦。
words.en: A watt is a unit of power, in the International System of Units (SI), defined as one joule per second and used to quantify the rate of energy transfer.

words.ex: He bought a quart of milk at the store.
words.ex_cn: 他在商店买了一夸脱牛奶。
words.en: A quart is a unit of measurement for liquids, equal to two pints or approximately 1.14 liters.

words.tr: n. 吨位；(某物的)总重量
words.ex: The ship has a tonnage of 5,000 tons.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船的吨位是5000吨。
words.en: Tonnage is the size of a ship or the amount of goods it can carry, measured in tons.

words.ex: The car has high mileage.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车行驶的英里数很高。
words.en: Mileage refers to the distance traveled, measured in miles, or the benefits or advantages gained from a particular situation or activity.

words.tr: n. 蒲式耳（谷物计量单位）
words.ex: He bought a bushel of apples at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了一蒲式耳的苹果。
words.en: A unit of measure for grains, fruit, etc., equivalent to eight gallons in the US and to approximately 36.4 liters in the UK.

words.ex: The weather report said it's 90 degrees Fahrenheit today.
words.ex_cn: 天气预报说今天是90华氏度。
words.en: Of or relating to a temperature scale that registers the freezing point of water as 32° and the boiling point as 212° at one atmosphere of pressure.

words.ex: The water boils at 100 degrees Celsius.
words.ex_cn: 水在100摄氏度时沸腾。
words.en: Celsius is a scale for measuring temperature, in which water freezes at 0 degrees and boils at 100 degrees.

words.ex: The water freezes at zero centigrade.
words.ex_cn: 水在零摄氏度时结冰。
words.en: Centigrade is a scale for measuring temperature, in which water freezes at 0 degrees and boils at 100 degrees.

words.ex: The thermal blanket keeps you warm.
words.ex_cn: 这个保暖毯让你暖和。
words.en: relating to heat or temperature

words.ex: He checked the thermometer to see the temperature.
words.ex_cn: 他看了温度计来查看温度。
words.en: A thermometer is an instrument for measuring and indicating temperature.

words.ex: He set the thermostat to 22 degrees.
words.ex_cn: 他把恒温器调到了22度。
words.en: A thermostat is a device that automatically regulates temperature, or that activates a device when the temperature reaches a certain point.

words.ex: The barometer shows that the weather will be fine.
words.ex_cn: 晴雨表显示天气会很好。
words.en: A barometer is an instrument that measures atmospheric pressure, used especially in forecasting the weather and determining altitude.

words.tr: n. 先令（英国1971年以前的辅币，等于12便士）
words.ex: He paid five shillings for the bread.
words.ex_cn: 他花了五个先令买面包。
words.en: A shilling was a coin used in Britain before the decimalization of the currency in 1971, worth one twentieth of a pound or twelve pence.

words.tr: n. 安培计；电表；电流表
words.ex: The electrician used an ammeter to measure the current in the circuit.
words.ex_cn: 电工使用安培计来测量电路中的电流。
words.en: An ammeter is a device that measures the electric current in a circuit.

words.ex: The wire carries one ampere of current.
words.ex_cn: 这根导线承载一安培的电流。
words.en: The ampere is the base unit of electric current in the International System of Units (SI).

words.ex: A byte stores one letter like 'A'.
words.ex_cn: 一个字节存储一个字母，比如 'A'。
words.en: A byte is a unit of digital information that most commonly consists of eight bits.

words.ex: The file is 5 kilobytes big.
words.ex_cn: 这个文件有5千字节大小。
words.en: A kilobyte is a unit of digital information storage or transmission with the value of 1,024 bytes.

words.ex: The metallic spoon felt cold in her hand.
words.ex_cn: 金属勺子在她手中感觉很冷。
words.en: Metallic means relating to or resembling metal or metals.

words.ex: The country uses metric units for weight and distance.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家使用米制单位来衡量重量和距离。
words.en: A metric is a system of measurement that uses meters, liters, and grams as its basic units.

words.ex: He found a dime on the ground.
words.ex_cn: 他在地上找到一枚一角硬币。
words.en: A dime is a coin worth ten cents, one tenth of a United States dollar.

words.ex: The Earth rotates around its axis.
words.ex_cn: 地球围绕其轴旋转。
words.en: An axis is an imaginary line through the middle of something, especially one that it turns around.

words.ex: He draws triangles in geometry class.
words.ex_cn: 他在几何课上画三角形。
words.en: Geometry is the branch of mathematics concerned with the properties and relations of points, lines, surfaces, solids, and higher dimensional analogs.

words.ex: He solves algebra problems every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天解代数题。
words.en: Algebra is a branch of mathematics in which letters and symbols are used to represent numbers and quantities in formulae and equations.

words.tr: n. 微积分学；（人体内的）结石
words.ex: He is learning calculus at school.
words.ex_cn: 他正在学校学习微积分。
words.en: Calculus is a branch of mathematics that deals with the finding and properties of derivatives and integrals of functions, by methods originally based on the summation of infinitesimal differences.

words.ex: The denominator is 5 in the fraction 3/5.
words.ex_cn: 在分数 3/5 中，分母是 5。
words.en: The number below the line in a fraction that shows the number of equal parts into which the whole is divided.

words.tr:
n. 数字
adj. 数的；表示数的
words.ex: He wrote the numeral five on the board.
words.ex_cn: 他在黑板上写了数字五。
words.en: A numeral is a symbol or group of symbols that represents a number.

words.ex: The test has only numerical answers.
words.ex_cn: 这个测试只有数字答案。
words.en: Numerical means relating to numbers or consisting of numbers.

words.ex: There are innumerable stars in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 夜空中有数不清的星星。
words.en: Too many to be counted; very many.

words.tr:
adj. 小数的；十进位的
n. 小数
words.ex: The decimal point separates the whole number from the decimal part.
words.ex_cn: 小数点将整数部分与小数部分分开。
words.en: A decimal is a fraction that is written in a special form. It is based on powers of ten, and it uses a decimal point to separate the whole number part from the fractional part.

words.ex: The company used a new formula to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 公司使用了一个新方案来解决问题。
words.en: A formula is a plan or method that is used to achieve a particular goal, especially in science or mathematics.

words.ex: The table has an oval shape.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是椭圆形的。
words.en: An oval is a shape that is like a circle but is longer in one direction than the other.

words.ex: He drew an ellipse on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在纸上画了一个椭圆。
words.en: An ellipse is a regular oval shape, traced by a point moving in a plane so that the sum of its distances from two other points (the foci) is constant.

words.ex: The track is elliptical in shape.
words.ex_cn: 这个跑道是椭圆形的。
words.en: Something that is elliptical has the shape of an ellipse or is characterized by the omission of words that are understood to be obvious.

words.ex: The engine has four cylinders.
words.ex_cn: 发动机有四个气缸。
words.en: A cylinder is a geometric figure with straight parallel sides and a circular or oval cross section.

words.ex: The ice cream is in a conical cup.
words.ex_cn: 冰淇淋装在一个圆锥形的杯子里。
words.en: Something that is conical is in the shape of a cone.

words.tr:
adj. 矩形的；长方形的；椭圆形的；椭圆体的
n. 矩形或椭圆形（的物体）
words.ex: The table is oblong in shape.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是长方形的。
words.en: An oblong shape is a shape that is longer than it is wide, with straight sides and right angles.

words.ex: The box has a rectangle shape.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子是长方形的。
words.en: A rectangle is a four-sided flat shape where every interior angle is a right angle (90°). Opposite sides are parallel and of equal length.

words.ex: The table has a rectangular shape.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是矩形的。
words.en: Something that is rectangular has the shape of a rectangle.

words.ex: The pentagon is a five-sided shape.
words.ex_cn: 五边形是一个五边的形状。
words.en: A pentagon is a five-sided polygon.

words.ex: The bee built a hexagon with wax.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂用蜡建造了一个六边形。
words.en: A hexagon is a six-sided polygon.

words.tr: n. 球果；松球；圆锥体；圆锥形物；
words.ex: The pine tree dropped a brown cone on the ground.
words.ex_cn: 松树掉下一个棕色的球果在地上。
words.en: A cone is a shape with a circular base that narrows to a point at the top.

words.ex: The teacher drew a histogram to show the students' test scores.
words.ex_cn: 老师画了一个矩形图来显示学生的考试成绩。
words.en: A histogram is a graphical representation of the distribution of numerical data.

words.ex: The graph shows a linear relationship between time and distance.
words.ex_cn: 这张图显示了时间与距离之间的线性关系。
words.en: Linear means involving or relating to a straight line or lines.

words.tr:
v. 成弧线；
n. 弧；弧形物；
words.ex: The rainbow arcs across the sky.
words.ex_cn: 彩虹在天空中形成一道弧线。
words.en: An arc is a smoothly curving line or movement.

words.ex: The new policy has a wide radius of influence.
words.ex_cn: 这项新政策的影响范围很广。
words.en: A straight line from the center to the circumference of a circle or sphere.

words.ex: The diameter of the circle is 10 cm.
words.ex_cn: 这个圆的直径是10厘米。
words.en: A straight line passing from side to side through the center of a body or figure, especially a circle or sphere.

words.ex: The circumference of the circle is 31.4 cm.
words.ex_cn: 这个圆的周长是31.4厘米。
words.en: The circumference of a circle is the distance around it.

words.tr: adj. 角的；有角的；尖角的；
words.ex: The angular shape of the triangle is clear.
words.ex_cn: 三角形的角形很清晰。
words.en: having angles or sharp corners; lean and bony

words.tr:
adj. 垂直的；笔直的
n. 垂直线
words.ex: The lines are perpendicular to each other.
words.ex_cn: 这些线互相垂直。
words.en: At right angles to the plane of the horizon or a base line; vertical.

words.tr:
adj. 竖直的；直立的；
adv. 笔直地；
words.ex: The picture is hanging upright on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画垂直地挂在墙上。
words.en: If you are sitting or standing upright, you are sitting or standing with your back straight, rather than bending or lying down.

words.ex: The width of the table is one meter.
words.ex_cn: 桌子的宽度是一米。
words.en: The width of something is the distance it measures from one side to the other.

words.ex: The course covers a wide breadth of topics.
words.ex_cn: 这门课程涵盖了广泛的主题。
words.en: The distance or measurement from side to side of something; width.

words.ex: The ball has a convex surface.
words.ex_cn: 这个球有一个凸出的表面。
words.en: A convex surface curves outward in the middle.

words.ex: He drew a loop with the pencil.
words.ex_cn: 他用铅笔画了一个圈。
words.en: A loop is a shape produced by a curve that bends round and crosses itself, or a piece of wire, string, etc. that has this shape. It can also refer to a repeated sequence of operations or events in a computer program or in a process.

words.ex: The bike has a shiny metal rim.
words.ex_cn: 这辆自行车有一个闪亮的金属轮圈。
words.en: The outer edge of something, especially a circular object.

words.ex: The guitarist played a C major chord.
words.ex_cn: 吉他手弹了一个C大和弦。
words.en: A chord is a group of three or more musical notes played together.

words.tr: phrase. 引起共鸣；触动心弦（常用于比喻打动人心或引发情感共鸣）
words.ex: His kind words touch the right chord in her heart.
words.ex_cn: 他友善的话语触动了她内心深处的情感。
words.en: To evoke a strong emotional response or to resonate deeply with someone.

words.ex: The baby smiled at the sweet melody.
words.ex_cn: 宝宝听到了甜美的旋律，笑了。
words.en: A melody is a sequence of single notes that is musically satisfying.

words.ex: He caught a big bass in the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他在湖里钓到了一条大鲈鱼。
words.en: The lowest adult male singing voice; or the musical part that is the lowest in pitch.

words.ex: He plays the cello every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上拉大提琴。
words.en: A cello is a large stringed instrument of the violin family, tuned an octave below the viola.

words.ex: He plays violin in a local orchestra.
words.ex_cn: 他在一个本地管弦乐队中拉小提琴。
words.en: An orchestra is a large group of musicians who play a variety of different instruments together. Orchestras usually play classical music.

words.tr:
n. 小提琴；骗局
v. 摆弄；虚度时光；拉小提琴；篡改
words.ex: He bought a fiddle at the music shop.
words.ex_cn: 他在音乐店买了一把小提琴。
words.en: A fiddle is a musical instrument with strings that you play with a bow. It is the same as a violin.

words.ex: He plays the accordion at the street festival.
words.ex_cn: 他在街头音乐节上演奏手风琴。
words.en: An accordion is a musical instrument that you play by pressing keys or buttons on one side and pulling and pushing a bellows on the other side to force air through reeds, producing notes.

words.ex: He plays the trombone in the school band.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校乐队里吹长号。
words.en: A trombone is a large brass musical instrument that you play by blowing into it and sliding a U-shaped tube in and out to change the length of the tube and produce different notes.

words.tr:
n. 鲁特琴；古琵琶；诗琴；封泥
v. 用封泥盖、包或密封
words.ex: He plays the lute in the evening.
words.ex_cn: 他晚上弹鲁特琴。
words.en: A lute is a stringed musical instrument with a body shaped like a pear and a neck with a fretted fingerboard, played by plucking the strings.

words.ex: He listened to a beautiful symphony last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚听了一首美妙的交响乐。
words.en: A symphony is a long piece of music that is usually in four parts and is performed by an orchestra.

words.ex: He bought a brass lamp at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了一个黄铜制品台灯。
words.en: Brass is a yellow-coloured metal made from copper and zinc. It is used especially for making ornaments and musical instruments.

words.ex: He plays the flute every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上吹长笛。
words.en: A flute is a musical instrument of the woodwind family. You play it by blowing over a hole at one end while holding it sideways.

words.tr: n. 横笛吹奏者；长笛演奏者
words.ex: The flutist plays beautifully in the orchestra.
words.ex_cn: 这位长笛演奏家在管弦乐队中演奏得非常优美。
words.en: A flutist is someone who plays the flute.

words.tr: n. 三人一组；三个一组；三重唱；三重奏；
words.ex: The trio sang a beautiful song together.
words.ex_cn: 这三人一组一起唱了一首动听的歌。
words.en: A trio is a group of three people who are performing together, especially in music.

words.ex: The Christian church teaches the doctrine of the Trinity.
words.ex_cn: 基督教教会教导三位一体的教义。
words.en: In Christianity, the Trinity is the union of the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit in one Godhead.

words.ex: The computer uses binary code to process data.
words.ex_cn: 计算机使用二进制代码来处理数据。
words.en: Relating to, composed of, or involving two things.

words.ex: He uses binoculars to watch birds in the park.
words.ex_cn: 他用望远镜在公园里看鸟。
words.en: Binoculars are an instrument that you hold up to your eyes to look at objects that are far away. It consists of two small telescopes joined together.

words.ex: He has a dual role as teacher and coach.
words.ex_cn: 他同时担任老师和教练的双重角色。
words.en: Having two parts or aspects.

words.ex: He won the chess tournament last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周赢得了国际象棋锦标赛。
words.en: A tournament is a competition in which players who win a match continue to play further matches in the competition until just one person or team is left.

words.ex: He became a finalist in the singing competition.
words.ex_cn: 他成为了歌唱比赛的决赛选手。
words.en: A finalist is a competitor who reaches the final stage of a competition.

words.ex: Victor won the race last Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 维克多上周日赢得了比赛。
words.en: A victor is someone who wins a competition, battle, or game.

words.ex: He felt victorious after winning the race.
words.ex_cn: 他在赢得比赛后感到胜利。
words.en: Having won a victory; conquering.

words.ex: He was the runner-up in the race.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中获得了亚军。
words.en: A runner-up is someone who finishes in second place in a competition.

words.ex: The player scored a touchdown in the final minute.
words.ex_cn: 球员在最后一分钟达阵得分。
words.en: In American football, a touchdown is a scoring play worth six points, achieved by carrying the ball into the opponent's end zone or catching a pass in the end zone.

words.ex: He is an ace at playing basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他是打篮球的好手。
words.en: If you describe someone such as a sports player as an ace, you mean that they are very good at what they do.

words.ex: He plays snooker every weekend with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都和朋友打斯诺克台球。
words.en: Snooker is a cue sport that is played on a baize-covered table with pockets in each of the four corners and in the middle of each of the long side cushions. It is played using a cue and snooker balls: one white cue ball, 15 red balls worth one point each, and six balls of different colours worth between two and seven points each.

words.ex: He plays hockey every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末打冰球。
words.en: Hockey is a sport played on ice or on a field, in which two teams try to hit a small hard object called a puck or a ball into the other team's goal using long curved sticks.

words.tr: n. 羽毛球运动；羽毛球；
words.ex: He plays badminton every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末打羽毛球。
words.en: A game played with rackets and a shuttlecock, which is hit back and forth across a high net.

words.ex: He plays polo on weekends with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他周末和朋友们打马球。
words.en: Polo is a sport played on horseback where the objective is to hit a ball into the opponent's goal using a long-handled mallet. It is also a type of shirt with a collar and a few buttons at the neck.

words.ex: He plays rugby every Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 他每个星期六打橄榄球。
words.en: Rugby is a sport played by two teams of 15 players each, using an oval ball that players kick, pass, or carry in order to score points by grounding the ball behind the opponent's goal line or kicking it between the goalposts.

words.tr:
v. 摔跤；扭斗；奋力对付
n. 摔跤；角力；扭斗
words.ex: He tries to wrestle the dog away from the trash.
words.ex_cn: 他试图把狗从垃圾桶旁拉开。
words.en: To engage in a physical contest, typically involving grappling and trying to throw or immobilize the opponent, or to struggle with a difficult problem or decision.

words.ex: He practices karate every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上练习空手道。
words.en: A Japanese martial art in which sharp blows and kicks are administered to pressure-sensitive points on the body of an opponent.

words.ex: He practices gymnastics every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上练习体操。
words.en: Gymnastics is a sport that involves exercises and movements that require physical strength, flexibility, balance, and control.

words.ex: This project is a springboard for his future career.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目是他未来职业的出发点。
words.en: A springboard is a flexible board from which someone may jump into water or onto a mat in gymnastics. It can also refer to something that provides an opportunity to achieve something.

words.ex: The cat ran down the alley.
words.ex_cn: 猫跑进了小巷。
words.en: An alley is a narrow passage between buildings or other structures.

words.tr: n. 重量级选手；体重超过平均水平的人；有影响力的人或事
words.ex: He is a heavyweight boxer.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名重量级拳击手。
words.en: A heavyweight is a person or thing that is of great importance or influence, especially in a particular field or area.

words.tr:
n. 激浪；拍岸浪花；
v. 冲浪；（互联网上）冲浪；
words.ex: He bought a new surf for the beach trip.
words.ex_cn: 他为海滩之旅买了一块新的激浪。
words.en: To surf means to ride on the crest of a wave towards the shore, typically on a surfboard. It can also mean to browse the internet.

words.tr: phrase. 国际长途公路汽车赛；大奖赛
words.ex: He won the Grand Prix last year, making him a champion in the racing world.
words.ex_cn: 他去年赢得了格兰披治大奖赛，这使他成为了赛车界的冠军。
words.en: A Grand Prix is one of a series of races for very powerful cars, especially Formula One cars.

words.ex: He practices kung fu every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上练习功夫。
words.en: Kung fu refers to the Chinese martial arts, which are a series of fighting styles that have developed over the centuries in China.

words.tr: n. 对抗；对立；敌对状态（行为）
words.ex: There is antagonism between the two neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 这两个邻居之间有敌意。
words.en: Antagonism is a strong feeling of dislike or opposition towards someone or something.

words.tr: n. 对手；对立者；对抗者
words.ex: The antagonist in the story is a greedy king.
words.ex_cn: 故事中的反派是一个贪婪的国王。
words.en: An antagonist is someone who opposes another person.

words.ex: The horses run fast on the racecourse.
words.ex_cn: 马在赛马场跑得很快。
words.en: A racecourse is a track or ground where races are held, especially horse races.

words.ex: The fans sat in the pavilion to watch the game.
words.ex_cn: 观众坐在看台上观看比赛。
words.en: A pavilion is a building or tent used for a specific purpose, such as entertainment or exhibitions, often found in parks or at fairs.

words.tr:
n. 正面看台；大看台
v. 哗众取宠；为博取观众喝彩而卖弄技巧
words.ex: The grandstand was filled with cheering fans.
words.ex_cn: 正面看台上挤满了欢呼的粉丝们。
words.en: A grandstand is a large, usually roofed structure for spectators at a sports ground or racecourse. It can also refer to the act of behaving in a way intended to attract attention and impress others.

words.ex: The children are playing hide-and-seek in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正在花园里玩捉迷藏。
words.en: A children's game in which one player tries to find and catch others who are hiding.

words.tr: n. 纵横字谜；纵横填字游戏
words.ex: He solves a crossword every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都做填字游戏。
words.en: A crossword is a word puzzle that usually takes the form of a square or a rectangular grid of white-and black-shaded squares. The goal is to fill the white squares with letters, forming words or phrases, by solving clues which lead to the answers.

words.tr:
n. 谜语；费解的事
v. 解谜；出谜；使布满窟窿；打洞
words.ex: He told me a riddle and I solved it.
words.ex_cn: 他给我出了一道谜语，我解出来了。
words.en: A riddle is a question or statement that is deliberately very confusing and has a clever or amusing answer.

words.tr:
n. 记数；
v. 合计；
words.ex: He kept a tally of how many goals he scored.
words.ex_cn: 他记录了自己进了多少球。
words.en: A tally is a record of amounts or numbers which you keep changing and adding to as the activity which affects it progresses.

words.ex: Reading books is his favorite pastime.
words.ex_cn: 读书是他最喜欢的消遣。
words.en: A pastime is something that you do because you enjoy it or are interested in it, rather than as a job.

words.tr:
v. 闲逛；漫步
n. 闲逛；漫步
words.ex: We decided to saunter along the beach.
words.ex_cn: 我们决定沿着海滩漫步。
words.en: If you saunter somewhere, you walk there in a slow, relaxed way.

words.ex: The cat likes to roam around the garden.
words.ex_cn: 这只猫喜欢在花园里游荡。
words.en: To roam means to move about or travel without any definite purpose or destination.

words.tr:
n. 华尔兹舞
v. 跳华尔兹舞
words.ex: They waltz slowly in the ballroom.
words.ex_cn: 他们在舞厅里缓缓跳华尔兹。
words.en: A waltz is a dance in which two people hold each other and move around the floor together in a series of three steps. It is also a piece of music with three beats in each bar which is played for this dance.

words.ex: He knocked down the domino with a finger.
words.ex_cn: 他用一根手指推倒了多米诺骨牌。
words.en: A domino is a small, flat, rectangular block used as a gaming object. Dominoes are typically made of bone, wood, or plastic and are used in various games.

words.tr: n. 桑拿浴室；桑拿浴；蒸汽浴
words.ex: He relaxes in the sauna after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后在桑拿房里放松。
words.en: A sauna is a small room used as a hot-air or steam bath for cleaning and refreshing the body.

words.ex: He gave his mother a massage after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后给妈妈做了按摩。
words.en: The act of rubbing and pressing someone's body with the hands to reduce tension or pain in the muscles.

words.tr: n. 矿泉疗养地；矿泉城；水疗中心；
words.ex: They went to the spa to relax and drink mineral water.
words.ex_cn: 他们去矿泉疗养地放松并饮用矿泉水。
words.en: A spa is a place where people go to improve their health and relax by having treatments such as massages and facials, and by exercising and swimming.

words.ex: They sunbathe on the beach every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他们每周末在海滩上沐日光浴。
words.en: To lie or sit in the sun in order to make your skin darker.

words.tr: n. 紫外线辐射；紫外光；
words.ex: The ultraviolet from the sun can hurt your skin.
words.ex_cn: 太阳的紫外线会伤害你的皮肤。
words.en: Ultraviolet light or radiation has a wavelength shorter than that of visible light but longer than X-rays.

words.ex: The radar shows a plane coming near.
words.ex_cn: 雷达显示一架飞机正在靠近。
words.en: A system for detecting the presence, direction, distance, and speed of aircraft, ships, and other objects, by sending out pulses of radio waves which are reflected off the object back to the source.

words.tr:
adj. 辐射状的；放射式的；径向的；星形的
n. 子午线轮胎；辐射式轮胎
words.ex: The wheels have radial tires.
words.ex_cn: 这些车轮装有径向轮胎。
words.en: Relating to or situated near the radius or the radial side of the forearm or hand.

words.tr:
adj. 放射化学的
n. 已含放射性同位素的化学物质
words.ex: The lab uses radiochemical methods to detect traces of radiation.
words.ex_cn: 实验室使用放射化学方法检测微量辐射。
words.en: Relating to or involving the chemistry of radioactive substances.

words.ex: Radium glows in the dark.
words.ex_cn: 镭在黑暗中发光。
words.en: Radium is a chemical element with the symbol Ra and atomic number 88. It is the sixth element in group 2 of the periodic table, also known as the alkaline earth metals. Pure radium is silvery-white, but it readily reacts with nitrogen (rather than oxygen) upon exposure to air, forming a black surface layer of radium nitride.

words.ex: Milk has a lot of calcium.
words.ex_cn: 牛奶含有大量的钙。
words.en: A chemical element that is present in teeth and bones and is necessary for their health.

words.ex: He adds sodium to his food for taste.
words.ex_cn: 他为了味道在食物里加钠。
words.en: Sodium is a soft, silvery-white, highly reactive metal. Sodium is an alkali metal, being in group 1 of the periodic table, because it has a single electron in its outer shell that it readily donates, creating a positively charged ion—the Na⁺ cation.

words.ex: The ring is made of platinum.
words.ex_cn: 这个戒指是铂金做的。
words.en: Platinum is a precious metal, silver-white in color, that is used especially in jewelry and in industry.

words.ex: The wire is made of copper.
words.ex_cn: 这根电线是铜制的。
words.en: Copper is a reddish-brown metal that is used especially for making wire and coins.

words.ex: Magnesium helps muscles work properly.
words.ex_cn: 镁有助于肌肉正常运作。
words.en: Magnesium is a silver-white metallic element that is essential for human nutrition and is used in various industrial applications.

words.ex: The coin is made of nickel.
words.ex_cn: 这枚硬币是镍制的。
words.en: A hard silver-white metal that is used in making alloys and is a chemical element. It is also a coin worth five cents in the US and Canada.

words.ex: He uses aluminum foil to wrap the food.
words.ex_cn: 他用铝箔纸包食物。
words.en: A light, silvery metal that is used especially for making cooking equipment and aircraft parts.

words.ex: The bottle contains zinc to help your body stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 这个瓶子里含有锌，有助于你的身体健康。
words.en: Zinc is a bluish-white metal that is used in making other metals or for covering other metals to protect them.

words.tr:
n. 合金
v. 把…铸成合金
words.ex: He made a strong alloy from copper and zinc.
words.ex_cn: 他用铜和锌制造了一种坚固的合金。
words.en: An alloy is a metal made by combining two or more metallic elements, especially to give greater strength or resistance to corrosion.

words.ex: The computer needs new hardware to run faster.
words.ex_cn: 这台电脑需要新的硬件来运行得更快。
words.en: In computing, hardware refers to the physical parts of a computer and related devices. In general, hardware can be any equipment, especially tools, used for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The miners dug deep to find iron ore.
words.ex_cn: 矿工们深入地下寻找铁矿石。
words.en: Ore is rock or earth from which metal can be obtained.

words.ex: The phone has a silicon chip inside.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机内部有一个硅芯片。
words.en: Silicon is a chemical element with the symbol Si and atomic number 14. It is a hard, brittle crystalline solid with a blue-grey metallic lustre, and is a tetravalent metalloid and semiconductor.

words.tr: n. 坚硬；难度；艰难；冷酷
words.ex: The hardness of the rock surprised him.
words.ex_cn: 这块岩石的硬度让他感到惊讶。
words.en: The quality or condition of being hard.

words.ex: Sulphur smells like rotten eggs.
words.ex_cn: 硫磺闻起来像臭鸡蛋。
words.en: Sulphur is a yellow chemical element that is found in various forms and is used in industry and medicine.

words.ex: The water contains sulphate from the rocks.
words.ex_cn: 水中含有来自岩石的硫酸盐。
words.en: A sulphate is a salt or ester of sulphuric acid, containing the anion SO₄²⁻ or the divalent group —OSO₂O—.

words.ex: Farmers spread lime on the soil to make it less acidic.
words.ex_cn: 农民在土壤上撒石灰以降低其酸性。
words.en: Lime is a white substance obtained by heating limestone, used in making cement and in farming to improve soil. It is also a small green fruit that is similar to a lemon.

words.ex: The building is made of limestone.
words.ex_cn: 这座建筑是由石灰岩建造的。
words.en: Limestone is a sedimentary rock composed largely of the mineral calcite (calcium carbonate: CaCO3).

words.ex: The table is made of granite.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是花岗岩做的。
words.en: Granite is a very hard rock that is often used in building.

words.ex: Ammonia has a strong smell.
words.ex_cn: 氨有一种刺鼻的气味。
words.en: Ammonia is a colorless gas with a characteristic pungent smell. It is used in the manufacture of fertilizers and as a refrigerant.

words.ex: Hydrogen is the lightest element.
words.ex_cn: 氢是最轻的元素。
words.en: Hydrogen is a chemical element with symbol H and atomic number 1. With a standard atomic weight of 1.008, hydrogen is the lightest element in the periodic table.

words.ex: Plants need nitrogen to grow.
words.ex_cn: 植物需要氮来生长。
words.en: A chemical element with the symbol N and atomic number 7. It is a colorless, odorless, tasteless gas that is the most plentiful element in Earth's atmosphere and is a constituent of all living tissues.

words.ex: Rust is an oxide of iron.
words.ex_cn: 铁锈是铁的氧化物。
words.en: An oxide is a chemical compound that contains at least one oxygen atom and one other element in its chemical formula.

words.ex: The ozone layer protects us from the sun's harmful rays.
words.ex_cn: 臭氧层保护我们免受太阳有害射线的伤害。
words.en: Ozone is a form of oxygen that has three atoms in each molecule, and it is a pale blue gas with a pungent smell. It is found in the Earth's atmosphere and absorbs ultraviolet radiation, which is harmful to living organisms.

words.ex: The magnet picks up the iron nail.
words.ex_cn: 磁铁吸起了铁钉。
words.en: A magnet is a piece of iron or other material which attracts iron or steel towards it.

words.ex: The electromagnet pulls metal objects when it is turned on.
words.ex_cn: 当电磁铁通电时，它会吸起金属物体。
words.en: An electromagnet is a type of magnet in which the magnetic field is produced by an electric current. The magnetic field disappears when the current is turned off.

words.ex: The electron moves around the nucleus.
words.ex_cn: 电子围绕原子核运动。
words.en: An electron is a tiny particle with a negative charge that is found in all atoms and plays a key role in electricity.

words.ex: The house has good insulation to keep warm in winter.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子有良好的绝缘层以在冬天保暖。
words.en: Insulation is a material or substance that is used to stop heat, electricity, or sound from going from one place to another.

words.tr: n. 隔热（或绝缘、隔音等的）材料（或装置）；
words.ex: Glass is a good insulator for heat.
words.ex_cn: 玻璃是良好的隔热材料。
words.en: An insulator is a material or device that prevents or reduces the passage of heat, electricity, or sound.

words.tr:
n. 微粒；斑点；少量
v. 使有斑点
words.ex: There is a speck of dust on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌子上有一粒灰尘。
words.en: A speck is a very small stain, mark, or container of something.

words.tr:
n. 尖细碎片；尖片；裂片
v. （使）裂成碎片
words.ex: He got a splinter in his finger from the wooden board.
words.ex_cn: 他从木板上弄了一块尖细碎片到手指里。
words.en: A splinter is a small, sharp piece of wood, glass, or other hard material that has broken off from a larger piece. As a verb, it means to break or cause to break into small sharp fragments.

words.tr:
n. 沥青；柏油
v. 用沥青铺
words.ex: The workers laid new asphalt on the road.
words.ex_cn: 工人们在道路上铺了新的沥青。
words.en: Asphalt is a black, sticky substance used especially for making the surface of roads.

words.ex: The road was covered with black tar.
words.ex_cn: 这条路铺满了黑色的焦油。
words.en: A black viscous liquid used for paving roads and waterproofing.

words.tr:
n. 蘸有柏油的碎石；柏油碎石地面；停机坪
v. 以柏油碎石铺筑（路面）
words.ex: The plane taxied down the tarmac before coming to a stop.
words.ex_cn: 飞机在柏油碎石路面上滑行，然后停了下来。
words.en: A tarmac is a road surface or airport runway made of tar and broken stones.

words.ex: The potter shaped the clay into a bowl.
words.ex_cn: 陶匠把黏土塑造成一个碗。
words.en: Clay is a type of fine-grained natural soil material that contains hydrous aluminium phyllosilicates (clay minerals) that develops plasticity when wet.

words.ex: The cake has three layers of chocolate.
words.ex_cn: 这个蛋糕有三层巧克力。
words.en: A layer of a substance or material is a quantity or piece of it that covers a surface or that is between two other things.

words.ex: Farmers protect the topsoil to grow healthy crops.
words.ex_cn: 农民保护表土以种植健康的作物。
words.en: Topsoil is the upper layer of soil, usually the top 2 inches (5.1 cm) to 8 inches (20 cm). It has the highest concentration of organic matter and microorganisms and is where most of the Earth's biological soil activity occurs.

words.ex: He ate a chunk of cheese for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃了一大块奶酪。
words.en: A chunk of something is a large piece or amount of it.

words.ex: They laid new tile in the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 他们在厨房铺了新的瓷砖。
words.en: A tile is a flat piece of baked clay, carpet, cork, or other material, used especially for covering roofs and floors.

words.ex: He bought a porcelain cup at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了一个瓷杯。
words.en: A hard, white, translucent ceramic that is made by firing a pure clay and then glazing it.

words.tr: n. 炻器；粗陶器；缸瓦器
words.ex: He bought a stoneware bowl at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了一个陶器碗。
words.en: Stoneware is a type of pottery that is fired at a high temperature and is nonporous and opaque.

words.tr: n. 陶器；制陶手艺；陶器作坊；
words.ex: He makes pottery in his backyard studio.
words.ex_cn: 他在后院的工作室制作陶器。
words.en: Objects such as pots, dishes, and vases that are made out of clay and then baked at high temperatures to make them hard.

words.tr:
n. 陶瓷制品；陶瓷器；
adj. 陶质的；制陶的；
words.ex: He bought a ceramic bowl at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了一个陶瓷碗。
words.en: Ceramic is a hard material that is made by baking clay or similar substances at high temperatures. It is used to make things such as tiles, dishes, and statues.

words.ex: He brushed his teeth to protect the enamel.
words.ex_cn: 他刷牙以保护牙釉质。
words.en: A hard, glossy substance that is applied to metal, glass, or pottery for decoration or protection.

words.ex: The tailor used a dummy to fit the new coat.
words.ex_cn: 裁缝用人体模型来试穿新外套。
words.en: A dummy is a model of a person, often used for displaying clothes or for use in tests to see how something will work or fit.
